programme.desc: Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman go head-to-head with cakes portraying Santa's workshop; Team Buddy creates a nighttime scene with a napping Santa surrounded by toys and elves; Team Duff builds a realistic tree that morphs into a finished toy train.

programme.title: Holiday: The Nutcracker
programme.desc: Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman create cakes capturing scenes from the classic Christmas ballet, "The Nutcracker"; both teams feature the Rat King in their creations.

programme.title: Holiday: Winter Wonderland
programme.desc: For their final battle, Buddy and Duff create their own winter wonderlands; the teams construct arctic creatures and their habitats to decide the contest winner.

programme.title: When the Elves Call in Sick
programme.desc: Three teams of confectionery artists face off to see who can make a holiday display that shows who steps in to save the day after Santa's elves call in sick on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Stealing the Naughty List
programme.desc: Jonathan Bennett asks the five teams to create a jolly depiction of a heist involving the world's naughtiest kids stealing Santa's famous Naughty List.

programme.title: Elf Auditions
programme.desc: The four remaining teams of cake masters and sugar artists create their most festive vision of how Santa Claus auditions his next crop of elves.

programme.title: Santa's New Gig
programme.desc: Jonathan Bennett challenges the three remaining teams of cake and sugar artists to show how Santa celebrates the off-season with a side job.

programme.title: Elves vs. Reindeer
programme.desc: The two remaining teams of cake masters and sugar artists face off for their final festive battle for a grand prize of $25,000.

programme.title: Surprise Holiday Parade
programme.desc: Five teams of cake and sugar artists compete to impress the judges as Santa makes a spur-of-the-moment decision to throw a holiday parade.

programme.title: Santa to the Rescue!
programme.desc: Five teams of cake and sugar artists must imagine what happens outside the North Pole and make a creation symbolizing Santa Claus as a world hero.

programme.title: The Great Turkey Escape
programme.desc: Five teams of master cake and sugar artists create what happens when all the Thanksgiving turkeys decide to make a break for it.

programme.title: When Toys Come Alive
programme.desc: The five teams show the judges what happens when too much holiday magic happens and newly minted toys come alive, escape from their boxes and go crazy.

programme.title: Critter Christmas
programme.desc: The four remaining teams of cake and sugar artists must create the most bizarre visions of a Christmas party in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: North Pole Wedding
programme.desc: Raven-Symoné challenges the four remaining teams of master cake and sugar artists to imagine the most romantic wedding the world has ever seen at the North Pole; judges Shinmin Li and Erin Acevedo decide which team will go home with $25,000.

programme.title: Reindeer Auditions
programme.desc: In the first qualifying round, the three teams of cake and sugar artists must showcase an unlikely understudy who dreams of winning a spot to pull Santa's sleigh; two teams move on in the competition and the judges send one team home.

programme.title: A Cake-mas Carol
programme.desc: In the second qualifying round, three teams are challenged to showcase Charles Dickens' "A Christmas Carol" in a way the world has never seen before by completely reimagining the iconic ghost of Christmas past, present or future.

programme.title: Wild Thanksgiving
programme.desc: In the final qualifying round, three teams have to showcase how two animals that don't ordinarily get along can celebrate Thanksgiving together in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: The Ultimate Snowball Fight
programme.desc: With the qualifying rounds complete, six teams of masterful cake and sugar artists face off in a challenge to imagine the perfect way to win the ultimate snowball fight.

programme.title: Intergalactic Holidays
programme.desc: The five remaining teams of cake and sugar artists are challenged to imagine friendly aliens celebrating their own holidays on another planet; at the end of the face-off, the field of competition narrows with one team's elimination.

programme.title: Holiday Sing-Along
programme.desc: The four remaining teams of master cake and sugar artists are challenged to bring the story of a carol to life using their imagination, with cake.

programme.title: Merry Grinchmas!
programme.desc: In the penultimate battle, three teams of master cake and sugar artists bring Dr. Seuss' iconic "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" to life by re-imagining the world-famous story as a big-screen epic in a whole new movie genre.

programme.title: Santa's New Ride
programme.desc: With $25,000 and the title of Holiday Wars Champion at stake, the last two teams of cake and sugar artists must showcase the wildest, most powerful, modernization imaginable for Santa's new ride.

programme.title: Champion Cake Off
programme.desc: The reigning champions of "Halloween Wars" and "Holiday Wars" face off in a New Year's themed battle involving team mascots and champagne-inspired cakes; the winning team gets a trip to New York City for the biggest New Year's party in the world.

programme.title: Elf's Downhill Derby
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro welcomes three teams to the first qualifying round; the talented cake and sugar artists must create a derby car fit for Santa's elves; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide who will move on and who heads home for the holidays.

programme.title: Hanging with Old St. Nick
programme.desc: Three new teams face off in the second qualifying round as Jeff Mauro challenges them to imagine how Santa spends time with his BFF; Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira send two more teams to the main competition and one group goes dashing home.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Turkey Trot
programme.desc: In the final qualifier, Jeff Mauro tasks three new teams with crafting a turkey and rider to race in the first annual Turkey Trot; Judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide whose Thanksgiving creations will move on and whose will not.

programme.title: Reindeer's New Hobby
programme.desc: The six remaining teams face off as Jeff challenges them to envision a hobby for Santa's reindeer to enjoy when they aren't pulling the sleigh; Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira judge the designs before flying one team home.

programme.title: Ugly Sweater Party
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro challenges the five remaining teams to create a woodland creature that is throwing an ugly sweater party for all its forest friends; at the end of the festive fiesta, judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira eliminate one more team.

programme.title: Time Travelin Santa
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro and the Holiday Wars time machine send the remaining four teams back in time; each group must create a Santa from a specific period in history; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide who will move forward.

programme.title: A Very Peanuts Christmas Tree
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro invites the remaining teams to create a Christmas tree featuring Charles Schulz's beloved Peanuts characters; two teams will face off in the finale for a trip to Iceland.

programme.title: North Pole Talent Show
programme.desc: Santa throws a North Pole talent show and the final two teams showcase the secret talents of the town's brave residents; Jeff Mauro, Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira crown the champion.

programme.title: Tricked-Out Turkey
programme.desc: A giant edible skating rink with fondant figurines for a surprise party; a non-profit organization requests a unique way to get kids excited about seasonal fruits and veggies for an upcoming cooking class.

programme.title: Main Street Winter Wonderland
programme.desc: A company commissions a five-foot replica of their local town Main Street decked out as a winter wonderland for their Christmas party; touring Reptile Company wants their company mascot, an Asian water monitor lizard, made for their holiday party.

programme.title: The Nutcracker Sweet
programme.desc: Brenda and Alisha create a larger-than-life-sized Nutcracker for a local dance academy's performance of the eponymous ballet; a non-profit organization commissions a turn-of-the-century house in Haiti for their annual fundraiser auction.

programme.title: Slam-Dunking Santa
programme.desc: The Osmond family asks Brenda and Alisha to build a replica of their 150-year-old log cabin for a fundraiser to benefit the National Multiple Sclerosis Society; Alisha's relatives surprise their son with a basketball-themed Santa Claus cookie.

programme.title: A Christmas Carol Creation
programme.desc: Hale Centre Theatre in Salt Lake City is launching its 34th season of "A Christmas Carol," and Brenda and Alisha are asked to create their grandest build yet; a build to thank a local firehouse.

programme.title: Countdown to Cookie
programme.desc: Brenda and Alisha use a drone to help them design a shortbread replica of the City County Clock Tower and its Romanesque architecture; a replica of an English cottage-style home as the centerpiece for a holiday brunch.

programme.title: Naughty or Nice
programme.desc: Bakers vie to create the definitive gingerbread showpiece; they receive a competition curveball mid-challenge that requires them to switch gears from assembling gingerbread to creating holiday treats to act as functional parts of their final pieces.

programme.title: Santa's Most Incredible Workshop
programme.desc: Three bakers race to create their take on a gingerbread North Pole; the judges hand out some praise and some cold critiques while trying to decide whose gingerbread piece is good enough to give its creator a trip to the grand finale.

programme.title: Ultimate Holiday Celebration
programme.desc: Three finalists create their biggest Ultimate Holiday Celebration scene; the competitor that wows the judges the most will win the grand prize and be featured in Food Network Magazine as the first Holiday Gingerbread Showdown Champion.

programme.title: Canine Christmas
programme.desc: Paige Davis unleashes the three bakers on a challenge to make gingerbread showpieces that tell quite a tail; they also create holiday treats delicious enough to prove the bite is as big as their bark.

programme.title: Worst Christmas Ever
programme.desc: The three bakers use their sense of humor to make their best gingerbread creations while envisioning the worst Christmas ever.

programme.title: Santa's Day Off
programme.desc: A cookier, a caker and a gingerbread book maker use their baking skills to give the big man a much-needed day off; classic gingerbread techniques, showstopping icing artwork and tropical decorations on full display.

programme.title: Winter Wonderland
programme.desc: Casey Webb challenges three teams of Christmas bakers to create fantasy snow globe cakes that capture the magic and joy of the holidays; each team uses ice sculpture to enhance the glitz and glam of their display and impress the judges.

programme.title: Mrs. Claus' Night Off
programme.desc: Casey Webb challenges three teams of master holiday bakers and their ice sculptors to show off a new side of Santa's better half in out-of-this-world cake designs and displays.

programme.title: Countdown to Christmas
programme.desc: Casey Webb challenges three teams of Christmas bakers and their ice sculptors to create colossal Christmas tree cake displays complete with edible presents, ornaments and pyrotechnics.

programme.title: Santa's Christmas Eve
programme.desc: The three remaining baking teams and their ice sculptors must create the ultimate "Night Before Christmas" cake display featuring Santa.

programme.title: Holiday Cookie Madness
programme.desc: Eight bakers have to prove their cookie baking skills in the first two challenges. The first challenge requires the bakers to use an assigned baking tool and the second challenge has the bakers using different holiday ingredients.

programme.title: Classic Holiday Flavors
programme.desc: The seven remaining bakers take classic flavors to a new level; a swirled treat using eggnog; different versions of sugar and spice for a special dessert.

programme.title: It's not the Holidays Without Pie
programme.desc: The six remaining bakers take on making pies; the first challenge has the bakers using a store-bought crust; the second challenge involves three different pies and three different crusts.

programme.title: The Great Holiday Cake-Over
programme.desc: The five bakers left in the competition take the fruitcake to a new place.

programme.title: Great Holiday Traditions
programme.desc: The four bakers must use the classic holiday flavors of peppermint and hot chocolate in a dessert and then create a holiday breakfast complete with three sweet dishes.

programme.title: Gingerbread Worlds
programme.desc: The three remaining bakers face one challenge, but it's a massive one, constructing gingerbread worlds filled with all sorts of treats.

programme.title: We're Nuts for the Holidays
programme.desc: Nutcrackers reveal assigned classic holiday nuts which then must be incorporated into a chocolate-nutty confection; the contestants highlight their favorite holiday memory in the form of a decorated pie.

programme.title: Holiday Craftiness
programme.desc: The remaining nine bakers try to amp up the visual impact of holiday baked goods by creating festive candy cane and holiday wreath desserts.

programme.title: Stuffing Is the Best Part
programme.desc: The eight remaining bakers begin by making their best holiday whoopie pies; the bakers must create stuffed holiday cakes that reveal a surprise center when sliced open.

programme.title: Thanksgiving's Just Around the Corner
programme.desc: Thanksgiving-inspired desserts; in the first round, canned cranberry sauce; in the main heat, the bakers must invent a dessert highlighting their assigned harvest ingredient.

programme.title: Ginger and Spice and Everything Nice
programme.desc: The six remaining bakers revel in the warm flavor of ginger; for their first challenge they create mini desserts highlighting candied ginger, then create three different types of holiday cookies inspired by family traditions.

programme.title: World Class Classics
programme.desc: The five remaining bakers reinvent two Hanukkah classics, rugelach and macaroons; a unique version of a holiday croquembouche.

programme.title: Re-Gifting
programme.desc: The four remaining bakers must make a candy apple dessert inspired by a candy apple gift, then figure out how turn the contents of a traditional gift basket into a delicious dessert.

programme.title: Holiday Hoopla
programme.desc: The last three bakers must show off their decorating chops by baking and beautifully decorating a sugar cookie tree; in the final heat, the bakers need to transform their assigned holiday tradition into an intricately decorated cake.

programme.title: Signs of the Season
programme.desc: Host Bobby Deen challenges the nine bakers to turn seasonal beverages like hot chocolate and apple cider into desserts; in the main heat, the chefs make decorative filled Bundt cake wreaths.

programme.title: Grandma's Thanksgiving Favorites
programme.desc: Clash of the Grandmas star Norma Zager joins Bobby Deen to lend her expertise; for the pre-heat, the contestants must make two types of cookies; the bakers compete to create the best pie without the use of appliances.

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Winx Club is a fantasy saga revolving around six fairies and their adventures. The protagonists Bloom, Stella, Flora, Aisha, Tecna and Musa live their daily life on Magix world, among lessons, loves, quarrels and moments of strong friendship. At any moment, when needed, they can transform into super-heroines, ready to defeat evil and save who is in danger.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happil

programme.title: Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie's photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn't stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer

programme.title: Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR

programme.title: Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT

programme.title: Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK - ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO

programme.title: Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Progeny

programme.title: Rage
programme.desc: The probe of a Wall Street executive's murder leads to a top broker who has a history of criminal behavior.

programme.title: Performance
programme.desc: The investigation of a pornographer leads to a gang of teens who videotape their sexual exploits with female classmates.

programme.title: Seed
programme.desc: The probe of a woman's attempt on her husband's life leads to a fertility doctor with a high rate of success.

programme.title: Wannabe
programme.desc: Expelled from an exclusive boys school, an underprivileged youth, a gifted student, is suspected of a trustee's murder.

programme.title: The Corporate Veil
programme.desc: A pacemaker manufacturer stands trial for murder after a wearer has a heart attack at the wheel and plows into a crowded park.

programme.title: Wedded Bliss
programme.desc: The bodies of two teen immigrants and a garment inspector found in the harbor point to sweatshop conditions.

programme.title: Helpless
programme.desc: An investigation begins when Dr. Olivet (Carolyn McCormick) says she was molested by her gynecologist.

programme.title: Self-Defense

programme.title: Bad Faith
programme.desc: The death of a fellow detective and childhood friend forces Logan to deal with repressed memories about the school he attended.

programme.title: Purple Heart
programme.desc: The investigations of seemingly unrelated murders of a cab driver and a hit man lead Briscoe and Logan to the cabbie's wife.

programme.title: Switch
programme.desc: The detectives arrest the father of a woman with multiple personalities for the murder of a psychiatrist.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: A newly elected, gay councilman's companion and his ousted opponent are suspects in the politician's murder.

programme.title: Bitter Fruit
programme.desc: A murder victim's mother fatally wounds the prime suspect in the case; then evidence suggests the woman hired her daughter's assailant.

programme.title: Rebels

programme.title: Savages

programme.title: Humiliation

programme.title: Angel
programme.desc: The detectives investigate a kidnapping case involving a woman's claim that her infant vanished from a church while she was in the confessional.

programme.title: Blood Libel
programme.desc: An art teacher's murder leads the detectives to an anti-Semitic student and exposure of a pay-for-grades scandal.

programme.title: Day Of The Outlaw
programme.desc: In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

programme.title: Along Came Jones
programme.desc: Gary Cooper gives a marvelous, tongue-in-cheek performance as a fumble-fingered cowpoke who is mistaken for a notorious bandit and almost gets killed by both sides of the law...all while managing to capture the attention of Loretta Young.

programme.title: Man Of The West
programme.desc: Screen legend Gary Cooper demonstrates why he will always be remembered as one of the most authentic stars of the screen. Capable yet vulnerable, Cooper's portrayal of a former outlaw whose past returns to haunt him ranks among his very best.

programme.title: Vera Cruz
programme.desc: In this epic Western, two shady mercenaries (Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster) in Mexico during the 1866 revolution are hired to escort a Countess and her gold to the Mexican army in Vera Cruz and find themselves at odds with the army... and each other!

programme.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

programme.title: ¡Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Three singing caballeros blaze a side-splitting trail across the western frontier!

programme.title: The Claim
programme.desc: Twenty years after an unforgivable act, a pioneer has amassed immense wealth and a thriving mining town. But the blind ambition and greed that drove him to succeed finally catch up to him with the unexpected arrival of three apparent strangers.

programme.title: Breakheart Pass
programme.desc: As a train races through the Rocky Mountains, the passengers are being murdered! The only hope is John Deakin (Charles Bronson) who uncovers a secret that explodes in a torrent of shocking revelations, explosive brawls, and blazing gun battles.

programme.title: The White Buffalo
programme.desc: Charles Bronson and Will Sampson star as Wild Bill Hickok and Chief Crazy Horse in this one-of-a-kind western that finds both western legends braving the snowy wilderness in search of the demon that haunts them both, the fabled White Buffalo!

programme.title: Ned Kelly
programme.desc: Mick Jagger makes his dynamic screen debut in this explosive tale based on the true-life story of the 19th-century Australian "Armored Bandit," who would become a mythic sagebrush hero even as the law closes in and prepares for an all-out war.

programme.title: Lawman
programme.desc: In Michael Winner's unique take on the western, a sheriff (Burt Lancaster) is determined to bring to justice a rancher (Lee J. Cobb) and his hands who accidentally killed an old man during a drunken spree. Robert Ryan and Robert Duvall co-star.

programme.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster, Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane star in this offbeat western about two aspiring outlaws who join what's left of the Doolin-Dalton gang.

programme.title: Fort Bowie
programme.desc: Attempting to affect peace between his men and the Apaches, the commander of a fort unwittingly inspires an Indian massacre.

programme.title: Fort Defiance

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: When a peaceful mission to move the Sioux to reservations turns into an ambitious general's vicious vendetta, a captain and his cavalry recruits are led towards a bloody fate. Written by Sam Peckinpah and starring Tom Tryon and Harve Presnell.

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers
programme.desc: John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

programme.title: Michael Cimino's Heaven's Gate
programme.desc: This lavish, epic western retells the true story of Wyoming's infamous Johnson County War, a brutal, late 19th century conflict during which wealthy cattlemen, backed by the U.S. government, hired mercenaries to murder 125 immigrant settlers.

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dynamite

programme.title: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die
programme.desc: From director Tonino Valerii comes this top-notch spaghetti western set during the Civil War where eight condemned Union prisoners attempt to capture a Missouri fort from Confederate soldiers. James Coburn, Telly Savalas and Bud Spencer star.

programme.title: Cannon For Cordoba
programme.desc: Set against the 1912 Mexican Revolution, Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) leads a small band of misfits into Mexican territory to destroy six cannons, stolen by bloodthirsty revolutionaries and their infamous leader Hector Cordoba (Raf Vallone).

programme.title: The King And Four Queens
programme.desc: Clark Gable is a smooth as ever in this unique blend of action, comedy and western intrigue as he romances the stunning Eleanor Parker -- and three other women -- in the hopes that one of them knows the location of a hidden cache of stolen gold.

programme.title: Billy Two Hats

programme.title: The Indian Fighter

programme.title: The Abduction
programme.desc: Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.

programme.title: The Mill
programme.desc: Ben tries to help his paraplegic neighbor Tom by setting up a grain mill on his unused land; Tom's hired hand raises his suspicion about Ben's plan.

programme.title: Bitter Water
programme.desc: When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.

programme.title: That Was No Lady
programme.desc: Kate wears a strapless dance.

programme.title: The Marriage Broker
programme.desc: McCoys arrange wedding for Sam.

programme.title: Her Flaming Youth
programme.desc: Old photo of Flora scantily clad.

programme.title: Grampa's Date
programme.desc: Grandpa asks Flora MacMichael on a date because she is a good cook.

programme.title: A Bundle From Japan
programme.desc: Men hire a girl to help Kate.

programme.title: The Insurance Policy
programme.desc: Luke and Kate get some insurance.

programme.title: Hassie's European Trip
programme.desc: A neighbor offers to send Hassie on a European trip as his granddaughter's companion.

programme.title: The Perfect Swine
programme.desc: Grampa and George duel over pigs.

programme.title: The Jinx
programme.desc: Grampa thinks a family member is a jinx.

programme.title: Money in the Bank
programme.desc: The family opens a bank account.

programme.title: Little Luke's Education
programme.desc: Little Luke called a hillbilly.

programme.title: Batter Up!
programme.desc: Luke urged to coach Little League.

programme.title: When a Fellow Needs a Friend
programme.desc: Grampa needs a character witness.

programme.title: Somewhere in the Vultures
programme.desc: A former prospector agrees to search the mountains for a woman's missing fiancé.

programme.title: Old Stape
programme.desc: An old thief outwits lawmen by returning to his rundown shack, which straddles the US-Republic of Texas border.

programme.title: Loss of Faith
programme.desc: Lawmen Pete Gabriel and Joe Phy were friends, then Kitty Bolton comes along; Kitty pits Joe and Gabe against each other, as she convinces Joe to run against Gabe for sheriff of Pima County.

programme.title: Spring Rendezvous
programme.desc: Kit Carson seeks to wed an Arapaho girl.

programme.title: The $275,000 Sack of Flour
programme.desc: Ruel Gridley donates a bag of flour to a Civil War veterans' fund as part of a bet.

programme.title: Samaritans, Mountain Style
programme.desc: While serving as scouts for Fremont's expedition, Carson and Godey come across a man who has lost everything in a native raid; they face a choice between helping him or moving on with their jobs.

programme.title: Solid Foundation
programme.desc: A prospector runs into robbers.

programme.title: The Friend
programme.desc: A new marshal battles his predecessor.

programme.title: The Melancholy Gun
programme.desc: Johnny Ringo is an expert gunslinger with a mysterious past; his arrival in town brings concern, but he confides in Myra he wants a more respectable life; but too many want to build their reputation by gunning Ringo down.

programme.title: The Vintage Years
programme.desc: A woman falls in love with a man.

programme.title: An Organ for Brother Brigham
programme.desc: A man transports a pipe organ to Utah.

programme.title: Coffin for a Coward
programme.desc: A veteran tries to eliminate terrorists.

programme.title: Serial Griller - Friends and Family
programme.desc: Matt Moore grills for friends, serving sausage, blade steaks, redneck potatoes, and a Bardstown Buck cocktail.

programme.title: Serial Griller - All the Courses
programme.desc: In "All the Courses," Matt Moore celebrates East Nashville's Tomato Fest with a feast-Breakfast Pizzette, Tuna Nicoise, Scored Flank Steak with Dijon Caper Sauce, and Grilled Watermelon. A multi-course grilling adventure with Southern flair!

programme.title: Serial Griller - East Meets West
programme.desc: Host Matt Moore brings East and West together over charcoal on the Ammo Grill. Inspired by his travels to Japan and the renowned Hikiniku To Come experience, Matt serves up juicy Wagyu Hamburger Steaks alongside a lineup of crowd-pleasing favorites. The menu includes Chili Cheese Dawgs, Salmon Kabobs, and Bacon-Bratwurst Fried Rice, each showcasing bold flavors and live-fire cooking techniques.

programme.title: Serial Griller - Americana-ish
programme.desc: Matt Moore fires up his Hasty Bake grill outside his airplane hangar, surrounded by his Piper Cherokee and vintage military aircraft, for an Americana-inspired feast cooked over live fire. Drawing from his Lebanese and Syrian heritage, Matt starts with grilled beef kefta pitas before serving a smoky grilled Caesar salad and juicy grilled chicken thighs topped with vibrant salsa verde.

programme.title: Serial Griller - All Day Eats
programme.desc: Matt Moore showcases the versatility and convenience of gas grilling on the Napoleon Rogue Pro-S in an all-day celebration of outdoor cooking. The menu begins with family-favorite griddled breakfast smashburgers before moving to a grilled greens salad and grilled shrimp tostadas. Then, a Greek-inspired rotisserie beer can chicken with drip potatoes delivers a flavorful one-pan feast.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - London
programme.desc: Billy and Dom learn the secrets behind the perfect traditional English roast dinner in London's historic Borough Market, explore the best of the diverse food offerings in Brick Lane and pop in to see their friend, Sir Ian McKellen, in his pub in East London.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Scotland
programme.desc: Billy and Dom traverse the Isles of Lewis and Harris, where they attend an agricultural show and are invited to a traditional Scottish cèilidh. They meet the Hebridean Baker who treats them to an alfresco dinner on the Isle of Taransay, and visit the Isle of Harris Distillery to try their offering of gin and whisky.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - California
programme.desc: Billy and Dom share their favorite haunts in Los Angeles, including the famous Mel's Diner in Santa Monica. They take a trip to Sonoma County for a farm-to-table adventure and get a rare opportunity to take a fascinating glimpse at the world's most advanced lab-grown meat facility in Oakland.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Texas
programme.desc: Billy and Dom go on a Texas road trip, and absorb the very best of its Southern Hospitality. In Dallas they taste an array of delights offered at the State Fair of Texas. They learn about ranching and how to cook and eat like a real cowboy, and learn the secret behind Austin's best BBQ.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Kyushu
programme.desc: Billy and Dom explore Kyushu, the most southerly of the Japanese main islands. They master the art of making the world famous Tonkotsu Ramen, fashion their own sushi knives with the help of a blacksmith who ordinarily has an eight-year waiting list for his product, and participate in a traditional Japanese tea ceremony.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Manchester
programme.desc: Billy and Dom head to Dom's hometown of Manchester, the world's first industrialised city and now a vibrant food capital. They brunch at cult diner Gooey, learn to cook curry at a classic "Rice & Three" café, explore the science behind ice cream cones, and enjoy a special tour of Manchester United's iconic stadium.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Let Food be Thy Medicine
programme.desc: Diane embraces the words of Hippocrates, "Let food be thy medicine and medicine be thy food." She explores Greek staples-olive oil, herbs, nuts, veggies-as health foundations. Plus, three simple recipes and a chat with Dr. William Li, author of Eat to Beat Disease.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Changing the Geography of the Dinner Plate
programme.desc: How do you take a meat-centric plate and shift things around so that vegetables take up the prominent place and meat plays a secondary role? Diane and her son Yiorgos explore the geography of the dinner plate by recreating classic Greek recipes for meat with, well, less of it!

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Greens Rule the Day
programme.desc: Diane shares how shopping for, cleaning and cooking greens is easy and accessible. She visits her 96-year-old cousin's garden, this vibrant produce may hold the key to her longevity. In the kitchen, Diane prepares a green storm and sips a surprising elixir from cooked greens.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Plant-Based in Ancient Greece
programme.desc: Inspired by the ancient Greek philosopher and mathematician, Pythagoras, Diane explores plant-based cooking rooted in his ancient vegetarian philosophy. She discusses modern nutrition's alignment with Pythagorean principles and chats with Prof. John Wilkins on Ancient Greek foods and medicines.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Influential Grilling
programme.desc: Influential Grilling: Scroll through the images on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, and you'll find grilled and smoked dishes of astonishing ingenuity. In the spirit of this new style of barbecue, we've invited three of my favorite influencers to grill with me - Derek Wolf from Over the Fire Cooking, Scott Thomas from Grillin' Fools, and Susie Bulloch from Hey Grill Hey.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Wagyu Demystified
programme.desc: Wagyu Demystified: Wagyu, "Japanese cow" literally, was once an obscure cattle breed from Japan. Today, it's on restaurant menus and in butcher shops around the world. Get ready for a sumptuous Japanese A5 Rib-Eye with sesame salt and grilled rice cakes, followed by wagyu steak tomahawks with fire-roasted marrow. Then feast your eyes on wagyu smash burgers with parmesan crisps.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Barbecue Takes Flight
programme.desc: Barbecue Takes Flight: What's America's most popular meat? It's Poultry. Americans consume more than 112 pounds per person each year. Today Steven prepares an astonishing array of grilled poultry from brandy brined rotisserie chicken to duck legs flame roasted Peking-style. And with a special guest a Project Fire first: turkey "ribs"-found in St. Louis, and virtually nowhere else.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Zagreb
programme.desc: The old ladies selling their baskets full of vegetables and cheese on the Dolac market in Zagreb bring us back in time. At the market, we go from the breathtaking Mediterranean islands to the Austrian Alps, from freshly caught hake and simple Baltic snacks to internationally awarded cheese and a unique Turkey breed.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Firenze
programme.desc: At the Mercato Centrale in San Lorenzo, one can taste the best food treasures Tuscany has on offer: from the olive oil of the Fiesole hills to the onions of the medieval borough of Certaldo and up to the Natural Reserve of San Marcello with its Tuscan cured meats. Here the simple and genuine tastes are king.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Budapest
programme.desc: The largest indoor market in Budapest is also the most elegant in Europe! Spanning over three levels, the impressive central food market is long recognized as a marvel. Whether it be the freshest fish, the richest goose liver, or the sweetest paprika that you're looking for, you'll find it. But don't forget the basement: this is where you will find the very best pickled cabbage in the country!

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Palermo
programme.desc: Placed in the middle of Palermo's ancient streets, it is almost difficult to walk. All around there is a swarm of colors and perfumes. There is everything the Mediterranean island, so rich in agricultural traditions, has to offer. Street food here is a must, including dozens of roasted, salted, pickled, and fried specialties one can count on.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cork
programme.desc: Ireland's third-largest city has one of Northern Europe's market gems: The English Market. It supplies high-quality food to affluent English families unlike the Irish market, which no longer exists. The best Irish produce today remains on the island and can be found here.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Valencia
programme.desc: Perhaps one of the most beautiful and well-organized food market buildings in Europe is the Mercado Central of Valencia. Built on the area where an open-air market stood for centuries, the Valencian style Art Noveau construction is a 'Cathederal of senses'.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Heritage of the Lowcountry
programme.desc: Georgia heads to South Carolina to meet the many talented artisans that define Lowcountry. From a basket weaver who is keeping the sweetgrass tradition of the Gullah Geechee people alive, to an intercoastal inspired shrimp recipe served in ironware crafted right down the street. Find out why the Lowcountry is defined by its character as much as it is a spot on the map.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Into the Garden
programme.desc: Georgia brings us into her garden and teaches us about small space gardening, container gardening, and how to make the most of the land around you, no matter your constraints. Along the way she talks with community leaders on what it takes to compost and start a community garden. Georgia also takes us back to her kitchen to share some of her favorite garden recipes.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Discover Your Roots
programme.desc: Georgia travels to a festival in the Ozarks where she is teaching a cooking class. We follow her as she prepares and gathers her ingredients - we meet a small town chicken farmer, gather produce at the local farmers market, and set the table at a local textile studio where Georgia learns to dye napkins.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Into the Wild
programme.desc: Join Georgia on an urban foraging expedition and learn from an edible and medicinal plants expert as he and Georgia collect a variety of items during a walk through the neighborhood. From flower studded ice cubes, to honeysuckle tea, to dandelion green salad, Georgia is making the most of what is around her.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Go West, Young Woman
programme.desc: Women from around the country convene in west Texas for a transformative experience in the wild. During the episode, Georgia teaches viewers about the different cuts of venison and the ways to cook them, as well as how to save money by grinding your own meat. The guests and viewers will leave feeling empowered and with a different perspective on what it is to be a human and an omnivore.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Entertaining at Home
programme.desc: Georgia hosts a dinner party at her home in Austin, Texas, focusing on ingredients that are as locally sourced and homemade as possible. Pulling produce from her own garden, she turns it into pickled vegetables, tomato bread salad, a lemon balm cocktail and more! Georgia even decorates the dinner table entirely with items she has found in nature.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Artisans of Charleston
programme.desc: Georgia is in Charleston, South Carolina where she is preparing a dinner at historic Fenwick Hall. She invites a legendary queen of Southern cooking to come by and teach her the secret to her two ingredient biscuits, learns a Nigerian inspired cocktail from a local sommelier, and heads out on the water to harvest oysters. Georgia also shares her tips for setting a southern outdoor table.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Traditions in Tuscany
programme.desc: Georgia visits Tuscany to get back to her own roots, and learn about the generations of families who are carrying on their family's traditions, some for centuries. She goes truffle hunting, learns to make fresh pasta, how to taste wine, and samples the incredible cheeses from the sheep grazing in front of her - experiencing the true value in living off the land.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - France: The Noble Olive
programme.desc: Georgia travels back to the South of France, where she once cooked at a Michelin restaurant, and spends time in the olive harvest with a family who is carrying on the tradition of making olive oil. We learn about the herbs that are grown by a farmer late in the season to be infused in the olive oil, and how the oil is used by the baker who is baking bread using heirloom wheat.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Lakota Nation: A Story of Empowerment
programme.desc: Georgia travels to the Rosebud Native American Reservation in South Dakota and spends time with the Lakota people who are pursuing the "7-generation framework" - their vision for the next 150 years. She learns about the work they are doing to reclaim their food sovereignty, their culture and language, to bring their people back to that sacred place of equilibrium that is essential in building a strong and sovereign tribal nation - where they are physically, spiritually, and mentally whole.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - From Earth to Art
programme.desc: Georgia brings the audience into the kitchen with her to share delicious garden to table recipes. Along the way she pays a visit to an artisan beeswax candle maker who teaches her the art of candle making. Georgia then goes to sit at the pottery wheel with a gifted ceramicist to create candle holders and elements for a table setting.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Earth, Women, Fire
programme.desc: In preparation for a dinner party, Georgia searches for wild edibles in unlikely places, and pays a visit to a pair of women glass blowers who create works of usable art in their glass studio in Brooklyn, New York. They work together to make glass pieces for the dinner table. Georgia brings us back to the kitchen to cook delicious dishes and set a table with their glassware.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Apples
programme.desc: In the orchards of upstate New York, Georgia Pellegrini explores the idea of "uncultivation"--a way of working with nature rather than controlling it. From regenerative apple growing to slow-crafted cider and brandy, she meets makers who transform fruit into something lasting, revealing how time, patience and imperfection shape both flavor and meaning.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Maine
programme.desc: In Maine, Georgia Pellegrini explores the delicate balance between wild ecosystems and the people who steward them. From ancient wild blueberry barrens to regenerative oyster farms and cutting-edge marine research, she follows a network of growers, fishers and scientists working in sync with nature -- revealing how diversity, care and innovation can sustain both food systems and the future.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Uplands
programme.desc: In the Western Catskills, Georgia Pellegrini follows a young couple who return to a childhood home and reimagine it as a regenerative farm. Through soil, animals and shared meals, they rediscover a deeper connection to land and community -- revealing how staying, tending and working with nature can transform both a place and the people who call it home.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Yaupon
programme.desc: In Texas, Georgia Pellegrini traces the story of yaupon -- North America's only native source of caffeine. Once dismissed as a nuisance, this plant reveals a deeper story: of land out of balance, of restoration through stewardship and of Indigenous traditions nearly lost. As farmers, scientists and communities reconnect with yaupon, it becomes a bridge between ecology, culture and renewal.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - East Wind
programme.desc: In the Ozark hills of Missouri, Georgia Pellegrini steps inside East Wind Community -- an egalitarian experiment in shared living. Here, land, labor and resources are held in common, and decisions are made collectively. As she joins daily life and conversation, she explores what it means to build a life rooted in cooperation and a more connected, communal way of living.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Christmas
programme.desc: In a quiet winter landscape, Georgia Pellegrini explores a more thoughtful holiday -- one rooted in simplicity, sustainability and handmade tradition. From repurposed treasures to shared meals and creative rituals, she visits kindred spirits who reveal how small, meaningful moments -- the "glimmers" -- can transform the season into something lasting.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Vienna
programme.desc: Lying in the culinary heart of Vienna like an island, a little world of treats rises in the midst: the Naschmarkt food market. A throng of buyers and curious onlookers meander through the stalls all consumed by the scent of spices, distracted by the smell of sausage, and stunned by the diversity of turnips, tubers, foliage, and fruit on display. The Naschmarkt truly is Vienna's most popular belly.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Valencia
programme.desc: Perhaps one of the most beautiful and well-organized food market buildings in Europe is the Mercado Central of Valencia. Built on the area where an open-air market stood for centuries, the Valencian style Art Noveau construction is a 'Cathederal of senses'.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Thessaloniki
programme.desc: The Kapani market is situated just behind the Aristotelous square of the city of Thessaloniki, facing the Aegean Sea. Exploring this market is exploring the city and its history: a tasteful mix of Sephardic, Balkan, Turkish, and Greek delights. All can be found in the intricate streets of the market or tasted at the many cafés and tavernas operating there daily.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cagliari
programme.desc: The market of San Benedetto in Cagliari is the island's belly. It is one of the biggest fresh produce markets in Europe and arguably said to be the biggest fish market in Europe. A paradise for food lovers, where every stall keeper has a story to tell.

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Spring Sensations
programme.desc: Today's show is a special celebration of Julie's favorite season, Spring! This refreshing time of year puts a smile on Julie's face focusing her cooking on springtime offerings. What better way for Julie to cook, create and celebrate this sensational season than with her crown roasted leg of lamb infused with a bouquet of fresh herbs, slowly roasted, makes the centerpiece on the springtime table!

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Magical Mezze Amidst the Moonlight
programme.desc: Julie makes her Mezze magical in a stunning and scrumptious presentation of her Lebanese cultures most famous small plates perfectly plated for her loving Lebanese family to savor! Mezze, internationally known all over the world as one of the most distinctive and delicious display of dishes to discover originating from Lebanon and Middle East. Julie Taboulie's Mezze makes entertaining enchanting.

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Meet Me At The Market
programme.desc: On today's show, a fresh farmer's market is inspiring Julie to make her marvelous Makbouseh, a Lebanese-style summertime squash stew. Julie's Makbouseh, a magnificent medley of fresh vegetables and array of amazing aromatics slowly simmer into a scrumptious squash stew, sure to be a staple at your table. Fresh from the farmer's market to a mouthwatering Lebanese masterpiece you won't want to miss.

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - It's Taboulie Time
programme.desc: Join the "Queen of Lebanese Cuisine", Julie Taboulie, as she pays a special tribute to her namesake dish and her culinary traditions. Throughout this visually vibrant show, Julie takes viewers back to memory lane of her Lebanese heritage and authentic dishes she grew up eating ever since she was a young girl at her family's Lebanese table. It's tart, it's tangy, it's tasty. It's Julie's Taboulie!

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Garden of Dreams
programme.desc: In this sensational season opener, Julie finds herself in a garden of dreams in Mama's Glorious Garden. Special Mama and garden serves as Julie's number one source of inspiration, ideas influencing her to cook, create and celebrate her impressive line-up of fresh, flavorful, fabulous Lebanese foods. More garden, more glory, most of all more Mama in Julie's garden of dreams, dig into deliciousness!

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Stop & Smell The Roses
programme.desc: STOP! And, smell the roses with Julie's rose water signature scented sweets hailing from Lebanon and the Middle East. Beautiful and breathtaking rose gardens inspire Julie's baking. Julie's rose water signature sweets will surely have you stopping to smell the roses, inspiring you to create her sweets for yourself right at home as she simply shows you how step-by-step in true Julie Taboulie style.

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Lebanese Sweets for the Holiday Season
programme.desc: Special seasonal sweets straight from Lebanon and Middle East always signify the holiday season for Julie as she warmly welcomes you into her home for Christmas and the Holiday season. This special show Julie is masterfully making and baking some of the most famous sweets, her personal favorite and most popular requested recipes, Baklawa and Knefeh pastries from Julie's Lebanese kitchen to yours!

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Falling for Fattoush
programme.desc: Julie's falling for Fattoush and you will be too. Her Lebanese peasant-style bread salad is sure to become your new favorite, it's full of flavor and fresh surprises! This spectacular salad is tossed together with Julie's homemade crispy crunchy, toasted-to-perfection pita bread, tossed in Julie's lemony vinaigrette, seasoned with sumac, it's key ingredient, makes this famous salad so satisfying.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Crazy Schedule Dinner Challenge
programme.desc: It can be a challenge to put dinner together in a working household. And then what happens when you're working opposite shifts? Ellie helps a frazzled couple trying to get healthy weeknight dinners on the table when conflicting schedules and priorities intervene. Recipes include Shrimp with Spinach, Garlic and Smoked Paprika, Peach Chicken with Crispy Bread Crumbs, and Mango-Coconut Sorbet.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Herbivore VS Carnivore
programme.desc: He's a meat eater. She's a vegetarian. Their kitchen has become a battleground. Can this marriage be saved? It's Ellie to the rescue with flexible recipes that will bring them together. Recipes include Warm Spinach Salad with grilled sirloin, Panzanella with White Beans with chicken sausage, Forbidden Rice Bowl, and Grilled veggies & lamb kabobs served with Tahini Sauce.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - It's My Party
programme.desc: Ellie prepares an ensemble of make-ahead dishes that are designed so that both party-giver and partygoers can equally enjoy the festivities. These dishes can be cooked and frozen ahead of time and then reheated at party time. Go ahead: enjoy your own party. Recipes include Asian Shrimp Cakes served with Avocado-Wasabi Sauce, Chicken Phyllo Pies, Broccoli & Sun-Dried Tomato Flatbread, and more.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Snack Attack
programme.desc: Americans get more than 25% of calories from snacks. Ellie shows how to make them count with some great ways to satisfy the cravings we get around the clock. Recipes include 3-ingredient Chocolate Grape Banana Skewers, Nutty Oatmeal Bars, Spring Cottage Peas with Basil, and Hummus with Cumin-Roasted Carrots.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - How To Fish
programme.desc: Are you floundering when it comes to adding fish to your menu? Ellie is your fishing guide as she demystifies the choosing, prepping, and cooking of fish. Recipes include 3-Ingredient seasoned breadcrumbs, Tilapia Milanese with breadcrumbs, Green Tea Poached Salmon with Asian Slaw, and Bouillabaisse.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Unboring Salads
programme.desc: Tired of snoring through your salad? Shake up the same-old same-old with some recipes that awaken all the senses. Recipes include Spinach Salad with Roasted Squash, Pumpkin Seeds and Roasted Grapes, Green Salad with Chicken & Buttermilk Dressing, Cauliflower Tabbouleh, and 3 Ingredient pickled red onions.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Desserts With Benefits
programme.desc: On the menu, desserts with a one-two punch-they satisfy your sweet tooth and deliver significant health benefits at the same time. Recipes include Blackberry Sage Ice Pops, Honey Yogurt Tart with Graham Cracker Crust, Pear Brown Betty, and 3-ingredient recipe Chocolate Almond Bark with Cherries.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Flavors of the High Country - Boone, North Carolina
programme.desc: Journey back in time to uncover Boone's historic roots and savor its vibrant culinary scene. Chef Walter Staib tries his hand at fly-fishing and connects with modern pioneers shaping the region's food culture. Delve into the historic Tatum Cabin, where delightful recipes are prepared, capturing the essence of Boone's heritage.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Paris of the Pacific - New Caledonia
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib travels to the enchanting Pacific island of New Caledonia and discovers the harmonious fusion of French and indigenous Kanaky culture and the mouthwatering cuisine born from this blend. From a centuries-old Bougna recipe to the French pastry shops that dot the capital city, New Caledonia is a culinary treasure.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Melting Pot Metropolis - New York City
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib explores the rich cultural heritage of New York City. From the diverse influences that have shaped the city for centuries, to a visit to a downtown restaurant that embodies its multicultural spirit. At the historic Harriton house, Chef Staib prepares recipes that pay homage to New York's roots.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Tides of a Revolution - The Battle of Machias Bay
programme.desc: Embark on a captivating history of Machias, Maine and the first naval battle of the Revolutionary War. Gain insight into the region's sustainable practices and the symbiotic relationship between the land and sea. Inspired by the local bounty, Chef Staib creates mouthwatering recipes that celebrate this remarkable coastal town.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Birthplace of Kentucky - Harrodsburg, Kentucky
programme.desc: Travel to Old Fort Harrod in Harrodsburg, Kentucky to explore the history of the fort and life of James Harrod. Joined by Mary Barlow, Chef Walter Staib pays tribute to the culinary heritage in the George Rogers Clark Cabin, they prepare historic recipes including a Kentucky Elk roast and a delightful Stack Cake, showcasing the traditional flavors of the region.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Grilling Down Under - New South Wales, Australia
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib takes a journey Down Under to Sydney, Australia, where he learns of the regenerative techniques Australian Farmers use to create delicious-tasting Beef and support a sustainable future for the planet. Get ready for a sizzling adventure that celebrates the flavors of Australia in true "Barbie" style!

programme.title: A Taste of History - A Multicultural Menu - Victoria, Australia
programme.desc: Join Chef Staib on a flavorful journey through Melbourne, Australia, as he dives into the vibrant culinary scene of this multicultural city. From meeting talented local chefs to uncovering the source of Australian lamb in the countryside, experience the diverse flavors and cultural pulse that make Melbourne a true food lover's paradise.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Flavors of the First State - Delaware
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib explores Delaware's pivotal role in American history while savoring mouthwatering dishes like Spicy Corn Relish, Stewed Codfish, and Macaroons. Discover how Delaware's small but significant contributions helped shape American culture and politics, from its early Dutch and Swedish settlements to its crucial involvement in the Revolutionary War.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Savoring Oaxaca - The Spirit of Mezcal
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib travels into the heart of Oaxaca, Mexico to embark on a captivating journey that uncovers the art of Mezcal making, guided by local experts who reveal the secrets behind this beloved spirit. The mysteries of the ancient city of Monte Albán await discovery, while renowned Mexican Chef, Rodolfo Castellanos showcases the vibrant flavors of the central market's local cuisine.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Applejack - The Original Colonial Elixir
programme.desc: Join us on a spirited journey as we explore the rich history of Applejack and Apple Brandy, discovering their colonial origins and witnessing the meticulous distillation process at America's oldest distillery. Chef Walter Staib returns to the historic Harriton House to fire up some apple-inspired recipes, including Scallopini of Pork with Stuffing, a sizzling Apple Flambé, and more.
