programme.title: Saguaro: Sentinel of the Desert
programme.desc: Undisturbed the saguaro cactus can grow to 60 feet, weigh 10 tons and live 150 years.

programme.title: Deep Jungle: Monsters of the Forest
programme.desc: The history of a giant Brazil nut tree in a Peruvian jungle; British tarantula expert; rainfall generated by the trees.

programme.title: Deep Jungle: The Beast Within
programme.desc: Expeditions to the Central African Republic, Guatemala and Cambodia to explore primates of the rain forests.

programme.title: Great Wood of Caledon
programme.desc: Emmy-winning filmmaker Hugh Miles presents a lyrical portrait of Scotland's Caledonian Forest.

programme.title: Ireland
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, the advance and retreat of ice shaped the mountains, coastlines, gorges and inland waterways of Ireland.

programme.title: Wild Way of the Vikings
programme.desc: Traveling from Norway to Newfoundland just as seafarers did in A.D. 1,000 to get a sense of how the Vikings lived in the Americas; narrator Ewan McGregor.

programme.title: In the Beginning
programme.desc: The origins of the solar system and life on Earth; how life is affected by the forces of nature. Host: George Page. Narrator: James Earl Jones.

programme.title: Perpetual Motion
programme.desc: The importance of the atmosphere and the oceans both in creating and destroying life. Host: George Page. Narrator: James Earl Jones.

programme.title: Heavenly Partners
programme.desc: The influence the sun and moon have on the seasons and the tides. Host: George Page. Narrator: James Earl Jones.

programme.title: Living Volcanoes
programme.desc: The varied activity, both human and natural, that occurs on the slopes of active volcanoes.

programme.title: Krakatoa: Day That Shook the World
programme.desc: The 1883 eruption of Krakatau blows open a six-and-a-half mile hole and causes tsunamis killing more than 40,000 people.

programme.title: The Good, the Bad, and the Grizzly
programme.desc: Grizzly bears cause social and environmental problems at Yellowstone National Park.

programme.title: Grizzly Country
programme.desc: Rangers at Denali National Park in Alaska train hikers for planned encounters with grizzlies; bears fish for salmon.

programme.title: Bears of the Last Frontier: City of Bears
programme.desc: Bear biologist Chris Morgan tracks grizzlies in the Alaskan wilderness.

programme.title: Bears of the Last Frontier: The Road North
programme.desc: Chris Morgan studies black bears caught between urban development in Anchorage, Alaska, and the wilderness.

programme.title: Bears of the Last Frontier: Arctic Wanderers
programme.desc: As winter approaches, polar bears wait to hunt on sea ice in Kaktovik, Alaska; in late spring, grizzlies await caribou on the northern slope of Alaska's Brooks Range.

programme.title: Clash: Encounters of Bears and Wolves
programme.desc: Each time the grizzly and the wolf meet in Yellowstone National Park, one of them has a tactical advantage.

programme.title: The Wolf That Changed America
programme.desc: See how a man's mission to kill a wolf had a lasting impact on wilderness preservation.

programme.title: In the Valley of the Wolves
programme.desc: The Druids are the first wolves reintroduced into Yellowstone National Park.

programme.title: Dogs in the Land of Lions
programme.desc: An intimate portrayal of motherhood centers on an African wild dog family in the Zimbabwean wilderness.

programme.title: Jaguar: Year of the Cat
programme.desc: Researchers and filmmakers set out to produce the first comprehensive film chronicle of the jaguar.

programme.title: Siberian Tiger Quest
programme.desc: Siberian tigers in remote Russia.

programme.title: The Story of Cats: Asia to Africa
programme.desc: How the first cats arose in Asia and eventually came to conquer Africa; an in-depth look at lions, servals, caracals, cheetahs, tigers, fishing and sand cats.

programme.title: The Story of Cats: Into the Americas
programme.desc: Cats in the Americas, including the rise of domestic cats; an in-depth look at the jaguar, urban mountain lion, ocelot, Canada lynx, margay, Siamese cat and the Sphynx.

programme.title: Cloud: Wild Stallion of the Rockies
programme.desc: The life of a wild horse in Montana proceeds from birth, through rites of passage and survival.

programme.title: Cloud: Wild Stallion of the Rockies
programme.desc: The life of a wild horse in Montana proceeds from birth, through rites of passage and survival.

programme.title: Cloud: Challenge of the Stallions
programme.desc: Cloud, the wild white stallion now in his prime, rules Arrowhead Mountain in Montana.

programme.title: America's Wild Horses
programme.desc: Cinematographer Wolfgang Bayer compares mustangs with the settling of North America.

programme.title: Origins
programme.desc: Discovering what makes humans and horses so perfect for each other And how the wild horses that were tamed 6,000 years ago became over 400 specialized breeds.

programme.title: Chasing the Wind
programme.desc: How humans saved the wild horse from extinction and how mankind created over four hundred specialized breeds over time.

programme.title: The Private Life of Deer
programme.desc: White-tailed deer in the U.S.

programme.title: Hummingbirds: Magic in the Air
programme.desc: Hummingbirds, the tiniest of birds, qualify as some of the toughest and most energetic creatures in the world.

programme.title: Super Hummingbirds
programme.desc: High-speed cameras capture hummingbirds as they mate, fight and raise families.

programme.title: The Real Macaw
programme.desc: The future of the macaw, whose survival may depend on the poachers who brought them to the brink of extinction.

programme.title: Parrots in the Land of Oz
programme.desc: The colors, behaviors and habitats of the parrots occupying Australia.

programme.title: Parrot Confidential
programme.desc: Owners and rescuers discuss the pros and cons of caring for parrots; conservation efforts in the wild.

programme.title: Bonebreakers' Mountain
programme.desc: A bearded vulture, the bonebreaker, feeds atop the harsh Pyrenees separating Spain and France.

programme.title: Hunters of the Sky
programme.desc: Hugh Miles films Europe's great birds of prey and notes how man's actions endanger them and their habitats.

programme.title: The Reptiles: Lizards
programme.desc: The world of lizards.

programme.title: Snakes
programme.desc: The snake is either vilified or revered.

programme.title: The Reptiles: Turtles and Tortoises
programme.desc: The diversity and abilities of turtles.

programme.title: The Reptiles: Lizards
programme.desc: The world of lizards.

programme.title: Supersize Crocs
programme.desc: Some croc species have exceeded 20 feet -- Nile crocs, American crocs and the Asian-Pacific saltwater croc; hosted by Romulus Whitaker.

programme.title: Invasion of the Giant Pythons
programme.desc: Florida's Everglades National Park is a protected wilderness where predatory pythons thrive.

programme.title: Frogs: The Thin Green Line
programme.desc: Scientists try to save populations of frogs, as large-scale die-offs of the amphibian continue around the world.

programme.title: Bloody Suckers
programme.desc: Fleas, flies, ticks, leeches, mosquitoes, birds and bats drink blood for survival.

programme.title: Superfish
programme.desc: Marlin, sailfish, spearfish and swordfish are the largest and most highly prized of all game fish.

programme.title: Smart and Smarter
programme.desc: Animals, big or small, must remain smart to survive as they navigate without a map, build homes out of living bodies and catch prey in their unforgiving surroundings.

programme.title: The Art of Seduction
programme.desc: Takes a look at how various species in the animal kingdom utilize the art of seduction in finding a mate.

programme.title: Masters of Disguise
programme.desc: The filmmakers explore how animals disguise themselves with their skin, fur and feathers to hunt their prey and fend off their predators.

programme.title: The Power of the Velvet Paw
programme.desc: A look at the big cats of the jungle and how they embody the attributes of power, elegance and being imposing.

programme.title: Freaky Feathers
programme.desc: Focus on exotic species of birds and take a look at their prominent calls, iridescent colors and acrobatic flying skills.

programme.title: Planet of the Primates
programme.desc: A closer look at primates, the closest relatives of human beings in terms of biology, behavior and evolution.

programme.title: Katabatic
programme.desc: The Katabatic shapes Antarctica.

programme.title: Free Spirit
programme.desc: After a botched military experiment some four years earlier resulted in the death of one of the test subjects, a doctor now believes the deceased test subject's vengeful spirit is able to jump from one body to another...and is after her.

programme.title: Mindreacher
programme.desc: In an effort to help the mentally ill, a psychiatrist (Jamie Lunar) creates a device that allows her to enter the subconscious of her patients. But when things go wrong, she finds that her own sanity -- and possibly her life -- may be in danger.

programme.title: Time To Time
programme.desc: A time traveler recruits a young woman from present day to join a team of time travelers-for-hire, but when she ends up attempting to change her own past, doing irreparable damage to the present and the future, the institute must race to stop her.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: When an alien abducts five students and transports them to a reproduction of their school, it informs them that they are part of a grand experiment. But as part of that experiment, together they must decide which of the five should be killed.

programme.title: Rule Of Law
programme.desc: A circuit court judge (Dennis Haysbert) agrees to preside over a case on a colonized planet that has never had any organized rule of law. On a world in which humans and aliens live side by side, he finds his first case is one of murder.

programme.title: Lion's Den
programme.desc: A desperate high school wrestling coach gives his team an untested performance-enhancing inhalant. Of course, the team suddenly starts winning...but their victory may be short-lived as the drug comes with killer side effects.

programme.title: The Tipping Point
programme.desc: An employee of a computer company uncovers a plot by its CEO/founder to take control of the world's computer network by having computers communicate at a more sentient level and, if successful, set himself up for world domination

programme.title: Dark Child
programme.desc: A woman who was abducted by aliens 17 years earlier tries to move past the mental scars, especially for the sake of her daughter, and finds love with a new teacher at her daughter's school. But she soon learns he is not the man he appears to be.

programme.title: The Human Factor
programme.desc: A rogue android who is part of the crew on Ganymede outpost threatens to destroy Earth's last hope of survival, claiming that human beings are no better than an infestation in the universe and not worthy of survival. And perhaps he is right...

programme.title: Human Trials
programme.desc: A test to find the right soldier for a secret mission pushes the limits of each of the candidates. Placed in seemingly real and very dangerous situations, the candidates soon find the line between reality and simulation inexorably blurred.

programme.title: Sandkings (Parts One and Two)
programme.desc: Beau Bridges stars in this bone-chilling thriller. A ride of harrowing suspense, this taut film is packed with heart-stopping tension that faithfully fulfills the tradition of the ground-breaking series upon which it is based, the "Outer Limits."

programme.title: Valerie 23
programme.desc: Can jealousy be a good thing? Not for Rachel Rose, a physical therapist whose life is threatened when she come between her paraplegic patient and his amorous robotic companion who is programmed to remove any obstacle that stands in her way.

programme.title: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: Two brothers wrestle for control of their father's million-dollar pharmaceutical company. But when one brother discovers a drug which may hold the secret to eternal life, the battle for control becomes a rapid trip toward self-destruction.

programme.title: The Second Soul
programme.desc: A dying race of aliens come to Earth to stop its own extinction...by reanimating human corpses. But a government doctor (Mykelti Williamson) senses that there may be more to their plans than mere survival! D. W. Moffett and Rae Dawn Chong also star.

programme.title: White Light Fever
programme.desc: An experiment at St. Peter's Hospital threatens the natural order of things when an embittered billionaire (William Hickey) pays brilliant cardiologist (Bruce Davidson) to help him cheat death. But is death willing to be cheated so easily?

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Aggie (Thora Birch) is an outcast at her elementary school because strange things seem to happen around her. When she is suspended from school, her parents hire a nanny who seems to good to be true. Will they lose their only child to keep her safe?

programme.title: Virtual Future
programme.desc: When a college student (Josh Brolin) experimenting with time travel takes job with a prestigious lab, he doesn't realize that the lab's billionaire owner understands completely the financial and political benefits of seeing into the future.

programme.title: Living Hell
programme.desc: Ben Kohler's (Sam Robards) life is saved after having an experimental microchip implanted in his brain, but when he starts seeing murders as if through the eyes of the killer, it becomes clear that something is desperately wrong.

programme.title: Corner Of The Eye
programme.desc: When Father Anton, a priest who has been questioning his faith, stumbles and hits his head, he suddenly begins to see demons all about him. When those demons bestow upon him the power over life and death, he uses it...but nothing comes without a cost.

programme.title: Under The Bed
programme.desc: When Sharon Rosman's son is abducted his 6-year-old sister in the only witness but is far too traumatized to speak. When psychologist John Holland comes to work with the young girl, she tells him it was the boogeyman...from under the bed.

programme.title: Dark Matters
programme.desc: Dropped out of space by a chunk of dark matter, pilot Paul Stein (John Heard) discovers a derelict ship lost ten years ago with all hands, including his long-lost brother. Only it seems that the crew may not quite be dead...or alive.

programme.title: The Conversion
programme.desc: Henry Marshall (Frank Whaley) is a greedy man. Recently released from prison, Marshall has learned little from his experiences. But an encounter with alien beings (Rebecca De Mornay and John Savage) may just teach him a thing or two.

programme.title: Quality Of Mercy
programme.desc: On a remote planet, Major Stokes (Robert Patrick), one of Earth's best warriors, has been captured by aliens and placed in a cell with a woman who is slowly being transformed into one of the aliens. Can he escape before he suffers a similar fate?

programme.title: Caught In The Act
programme.desc: Hanna Velasic (Alyssa Milano) has a killer body...literally! When the formerly chaste beauty is taken over by a mysterious force, he appetite for men becomes insatiable...and murderous. Can her loving boyfriend put an end to her killing spree?

programme.title: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: When a group of astronauts returning to Earth after an expedition to Mars discover what appears to be a dangerous alien life form on their ship, they must decide whether to return to Earth or sacrifice themselves for the sake of all humanity?

programme.title: The New Breed
programme.desc: To cure his cancer, a man (Peter Outerbridge) secretly injects himself with experimental nanobots that his scientist friend (Richard Thomas) developed. The trial is successful -- too successful -- when the super 'bots try to create a superhuman!

programme.title: The Message
programme.desc: Jennifer (Marlee Matlin), deaf since birth, has had a revolutionary implant in her ear, to help her hear for the first time. The device doesn't help her to hear normal conversation and sounds, but she does hear...something...from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: I, Robot
programme.desc: When a robot named Adam is accused of killing his own creator, it's up to a civil liberties attorney (Leonard Nimoy) to defend him. Is Adam capable of murder? Or did a military retrofit of the docile robot turn him into a ruthless killing machine?

programme.title: If These Walls Could Talk
programme.desc: Lynda is a grieving mother who feels her son's spirit is haunting her. Levi is a scientist out to prove that ghosts do not exist. Can her faith and his skepticism come together to solve the mystery of a haunted house and a senseless death?

programme.title: Birthright
programme.desc: An environmentally friendly U.S. Senator's life changes when, after a freak accident, he suddenly starts to believe he is an alien in disguise, with a "mission" to surreptitiously reconfigure the Earth's atmosphere. But is it for the better?

programme.title: Voice Of Reason
programme.desc: Randall Strong (Gordon Clapp) is on a mission to convince the US Military that aliens are threatening Earth, but committee Chairman Thornwell (Daniel J. Travanti) seems to be Strong's biggest stumbling block. Could Thornewll be one of... "them"?

programme.title: A Stitch In Time
programme.desc: FBI agent Jamie Pratt (Michelle Forbes) investigates a perplexing case when her best friend becomes a killer's next victim. The mystery takes her through five decades of time, where reality changes at each and every turn...in the Outer Limits.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: Life on Earth has been wiped out by biological warfare, with androids the only survivors. Two such androids (Heather Graham, Dana Ashbrook) recreate a human from DNA and must protect him from a military force which wants humankind annihilated.

programme.title: Unnatural Selection
programme.desc: Howard (Alan Ruck) and Joanne (Catherine Mary Stewart) are happily expecting their first child. They live in a world where genetic alteration is rampantly purchased on the black market...but nothing comes without a price in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: I Hear You Calling
programme.desc: After intercepting a strange phone call, a tenacious reporter (Ally Sheedy) finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The only clues to the mystery: a strange man with violet eyes and missing persons who leave behind a pile of purple ash.

programme.title: Mind Over Matter
programme.desc: When an accident puts Dr. Stein's (Mark Hamill) colleague, Rachel, in a coma, he uses his newly-created invention to reach her brain and tell her he loves her. However, Stein discovers that love takes strange turns when it enters the virtual world.

programme.title: Beyond The Veil
programme.desc: After flashbacks of an alien abduction lead him to attempt suicide, Eddie Wexler (Michael O'Keefe) is institutionalized, with a doctor who seems intent on forcing him to relive his "memories." Is Eddie insane? Or is the doctor more than he seems?

programme.title: First Anniversary
programme.desc: As he celebrates his first anniversary, Norman (Matt Frewer) thinks he's the luckiest man alive. But suddenly, his lovely wife doesn't seem the same and he can't stand to be around her. Is he going crazy or are his instincts telling him something?

programme.title: Straight And Narrow
programme.desc: Problem child Rusty (Ryan Phillippe) finds himself thrown into a private school bent on straightening him out with some unorthodox methods. Rusty has eluded their control so far, but can he escape from this prison of the mind?

programme.title: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: On the first day of his presidency, Charles Halsey (Robert Foxworth) is faced with the first galactic foreign policy decision. As aliens are approaching Earth, the peace-loving president must determine if they are invaders or benevolent explorers.

programme.title: Worlds Apart
programme.desc: In a bizarre twist of fate, Nancy McDonald (Bonnie Bedelia) receives a distress call from Lindy (Chad Willett), a former lover, who was lost in space twenty years earlier. And he has a message: He's alive...and he desperately needs her help.

programme.title: The Refuge
programme.desc: A man (James Wilder) finds himself in what seems to be a refuge in a post-apocalyptic world, lorded over by a sadistic industrialist (M. Emmet Walsh) who pits his guests against one another for enjoyment...but all is not what it seems to be.

programme.title: Inconstant Moon
programme.desc: When a lonely physics professor Stanley Hurst (Michael Gross) realizes the sun is going to burn out, he knows that he and humanity have only a few hours to live. In that time, Stan resolves to make up for lost years.

programme.title: From Within
programme.desc: Howie (Neil Patrick Harris), a boy with intellectual disabilities, is the last unaffected person in a town overrun by a strange, parasitic madness. On his own for the first time, Howie has only himself to rely upon if he wants to save his sister!

programme.title: The Heist
programme.desc: After a friend's betrayal cost him his Army career, Lee Taylor (Costas Mandylor) helps a self-styled militia Major hijack an Army shipment. Expecting missiles, they find a mysterious cargo and a lone Army Guard who warns of its deadly capability.

programme.title: Afterlife
programme.desc: Convicted of a murder he didn't commit, Linden Stiles can either accept execution or become the subject of a military experiment. Choosing to live, he finds himself slowly dehumanized by the alien DNA that has been injected into him.

programme.title: The Deprogrammers
programme.desc: With Earth under alien rule, humanity has been programmed into slavery. A band of rebels kidnap Evan (Erich Anderson), one of the alien leader's slaves. After a twist of fate, Evan agrees to assassinate his former master...with devastating results.

programme.title: Paradise
programme.desc: When three young women age and die within hours, a small town is turned upside down. How does Helen (Maxine Miller), a doctor's aging mother, play into these deaths? The answer to the puzzling mystery of fragile youth is soon to be revealed.

programme.title: The Light Brigade
programme.desc: On a desperate mission to survive, a young military cadet (Will Wheaton) learns the difference between heroic ideals and the bitter realities of war as he and his dying comrades prepare a strike against the aliens who may have condemn them to death.

programme.title: Out Of Body
programme.desc: What really happens during an out-of-body experience? Scientist Rebecca (Peri Gilpin) is so desperate to find out that she decides run an experiment on herself. But not everyone is happy of the lengths science will go to for empirical proof.

programme.title: The Sentence
programme.desc: Inventor Dr. Jack Henson (David Hyde Pierce) comes up with a "virtual prison" where criminals serve a life sentence in just a few, cost-efficient hours. When an innocent man's life is at stake, the doctor must submit himself to his own invention.

programme.title: Bits Of Love
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic underground bunker, a virtual reality world begins to turn on its inventor (Jon Tenney) after he becomes romantically involved with -- and then spurns -- the holographic interface (Natasha Henstridge) that controls the system.

programme.title: Second Thoughts
programme.desc: A mentally challenged man (Howie Mandel) is made more intelligent by a machine that transfers people's memories and experiences into his head, but kills its victims. And he soon discovers that the mind can be a minefield in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Re-Generation
programme.desc: After a couple's son dies, an experimental procedure harvests the boy's nerve cells, allowing the mother to give birth to a genetically identical child. But soon it becomes clear that this fetus is not just identical...it is actually Justin himself.

programme.title: Last Supper
programme.desc: A man's family is turned upside down when he discovers that his son's college sweetheart is the same woman he rescued from a secret military experiment twenty years before...only she has not aged a day since. Peter Onorati and Fred Savage star.

programme.title: Stream Of Consciousness
programme.desc: When "the Stream" -- an artificial system providing information to all society members through computer chips implanted in their brains -- begins to malfunction, an unlikely, "primitive" man (George Newbern) may be the mankind's only hope.

programme.title: Dark Rain
programme.desc: After a chemical war renders the world's population unable to conceive healthy children, a mother and father must escape from a sinister government agency intent on using their miraculously healthy newborn to repopulate the species.

programme.title: The Camp
programme.desc: In a society imprisoned for generations by extraterrestrial who invaded Earth, an electronics expert (Harley Jane Kozak) discovers that not only are her human jailers really machines, but they also have been holding prisoners for nearly a century.

programme.title: Heart's Desire
programme.desc: A preacher descends upon the 18th century town of Heart's Desire and offers to share his extraordinary powers with four outlaws. But who is this stranger and why has he given these outlaws such deadly powers? Caspar Van Dien and Esai Morales star.

programme.title: Tempests
programme.desc: Attempting to deliver serum to a plague-stricken planet, a pilot (Eric McCormack) and his crew crash land on an unknown moon. Bitten by an alien spider while fixing the ship, the pilot's mind wanders between alternate realities...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: The Awakening
programme.desc: A woman unable to feel emotions gets a new lease on life when a brain implant allows her to experience feelings for the first time. But, when the implant malfunctions, driving her towards insanity, she is shocked at the real cause of her problems.

programme.title: New Lease
programme.desc: A remorseless, uncaring scientist (Stephen Lang) and his partner (Michael Ontkean) discover a way to bring life back to the recently deceased. But after the scientist is killed and brought back to life himself, will he choose to live differently?

programme.title: Buchanan Rides Alone
programme.desc: Journeying from Mexico back home to West Texas, mercenary Tom Buchanan takes a break for the night in the border town of Agry. He soon discovers that almost every resident -- from the crooked sheriff to the shifty-eyed innkeeper -- is a member of the prominent Agry family. When Buchanan defends Juan de la Vega, a young man about to be lynched for shooting the town drunk, he himself is accused of murder and must struggle to escape town alive.

programme.title: Fort Worth
programme.desc: Reformed gunman Ned Britt (Randolph Scott) travels to Fort Worth, Texas, to take over the abandoned newspaper. Crooked trail boss Gabe Clevenger (Ray Teal), a former antagonist of Ned's, challenges him on the trail. Ned refuses to fight, which disappoints fellow passenger Flora Talbot (Phyllis Thaxter), who had taken a liking to him but now sees him as weak. In Fort Worth, Ned discovers Clevenger is battling the burgeoning railroad and decides to fight back using the power of the press.

programme.title: The Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Jim Kipp (Randolph Scott) is a bounty hunter hired to find three robbers who committed a daring heist three years ago. When he arrives in a small town near the robbery, he senses that the thieves may be living there. However, many of the townspeople -- including Dr. Spencer (Harry Antrim), his daughter, Julie (Dolores Dorn), and barmaid Alice (Marie Windsor) -- are put on edge by Kipp's presence and want him gone. Kipp perseveres, hatching a plan that he thinks will draw out the bandits.

programme.title: Apache Rifles
programme.desc: A U.S. Cavalry officer (Audie Murphy) falls in love with a part-Indian missionary (Linda Lawson) in Arizona.

programme.title: The Tall Stranger
programme.desc: Union vet Ned (Joel McCrea), gunned down by some tough cattle rustlers, comes to in a wagon train under the care of kindly widow Ellen (Virginia Mayo). But, as he heals, he senses all is not well, and realizes that the suspicious men leading the train are taking the settlers to land owned by his estranged half-brother, an embittered man who will shoot any strangers. Ned then tries to warn the pioneers, while preparing to face the sibling who harbors a deep-seated grudge against him.

programme.title: Stranger on Horseback
programme.desc: A circuit judge (Joel McCrea) rides in to break a ruthless cattle baron's stranglehold on a frontier town.

programme.title: Billy the Kid
programme.desc: The story of the notorious outlaw William "Billy the Kid" Bonney. Billy joins a group of outlaws in a South West town when he meets old friend Jim Sherwood, now the town's marshal. He tries to change his ways but when a friend is murdered he falls back into the life of a bandit.

programme.title: Village of Fear
programme.desc: A peddler outwits a gang of killers.

programme.title: Black Creek Encounter
programme.desc: A gunman lays down his arms.

programme.title: There Were Four
programme.desc: A bitter young man takes up cattle rustling to avenge his father's death.

programme.title: Fugitive
programme.desc: Fate isolates a man.

programme.title: A Time to Live
programme.desc: Saloon girls help would-be murderer.

programme.title: Black Is for Grief
programme.desc: A Civil War veteran searches for the man who killed his wife.

programme.title: Badge of Honor
programme.desc: A disillusioned Confederate veteran encounters a power-mad colonel.

programme.title: Decision at Wilson's Creek
programme.desc: A Civil War officer faces disdain.

programme.title: Westbound
programme.desc: A former Union officer, John Hayes (Randolph Scott) now manages a stagecoach company. However, Clay Putnam (Andrew Duggan), a businessman still loyal to the South, is intent on robbing the coaches operated by Hayes, which transport gold to the North from California. Hoping to heist the treasure as a way to revive the Confederacy, Putnam also has a grudge against Hayes, since his wife, Norma (Virginia Mayo), was once involved with the handsome Union soldier.

programme.title: Major Dundee
programme.desc: During the end of the Civil War, Major Dundee guards Confederate prisoners, Union deserters and ordinary hard-bitten criminals in a remote fort. When Apaches attack the fort and make off with three children, Dundee must set up a posse including Confederates, who face a choice between joining up or being shot. The feud between Dundee and Tyreen is also heated up by a sultry Mexican widow.

programme.title: The Mountain Men
programme.desc: Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.

programme.title: The Violent Men
programme.desc: Former Union soldier John Parrish (Glenn Ford) wants to sell his ranch and start a new life by settling down out east. However, the ruthless tactics of Lew Wilkison (Edward G. Robinson), the scheming businessman interested in his property, make Parrish reconsider the move, especially after one of his ranch hands is murdered. Adding to the increasingly tense conflict is Wilkison's wife, Martha (Barbara Stanwyck), who is cheating on her husband with his brother, Cole (Brian Keith).

programme.title: The Tin Star
programme.desc: Morgan Hickman is a tough gunslinger with a knack for keeping his cool in tense situations. When he wanders into a town where the local lawman has been killed, he finds callow but eager Ben Owens temporarily acting as sheriff. Soon Ben, who wants to keep his new position, is looking to Morgan for guidance. Though the bounty hunter has his own issues with law enforcement, he admires Ben's enthusiasm and decides to train him to be an effective sheriff.

programme.title: Joe Kidd
programme.desc: In New Mexico, one-time bounty hunter Joe Kidd owns a ranch where a nearby group of Mexican revolutionaries, led by Luis Chama, fights for their rightful land after the U.S. government denies their claims. In response, a greedy landowner gathers a posse to capture Chama and solicits Kidd's assistance. Kidd, who has no interest in the matter, changes his mind when he discovers Chama has stolen a horse and roughed up a worker from his ranch.

programme.title: Two Mules for Sister Sara
programme.desc: When gunslinger Hogan (Clint Eastwood) discovers a group of men attempting to rape a young nun, Sara (Shirley MacLaine), he shoots them dead and rescues the woman. The two escape to a nearby camp of Mexican revolutionaries, who have hired Hogan to help fight the invading French army. En route, Sara turns out to be surprisingly crude for a nun, drinking, smoking and using curse words. When she also proves to be handy with a gun, Hogan begins wondering if she is telling him the whole truth.

programme.title: High Plains Drifter
programme.desc: In this Western, a drifter with no name wanders into a small town, where his gun-slinging abilities are in high demand. When the drifter rides into Lago, he is met with incredulity and disapproval by the townspeople. But once he shows his skills with a pistol, the locals realize he may be able to help them fend off a band of criminals who have been terrorizing the town. He agrees to help the townspeople, but does so with his own secret agenda.

programme.title: The Thicket
programme.desc: When a bounty hunter and a band of unlikely heroes pursue a brutal killer, they find themselves in a deadly no-man's-land known as the Thicket.

programme.title: Outlaw Johnny Black
programme.desc: Cowboy Johnny Black vows to gun down Brett Clayton, the man responsible for the death of his father. He soon becomes a wanted outlaw while posing as a preacher in a small mining town that's been taken over by a notorious land baron.

programme.title: Confession for Money
programme.desc: Cisco proves that the man being held in jail on a murder charge is not the actual murderer.

programme.title: The Old Bum
programme.desc: A respectable businessman traps an elderly man into a rustling ring scheme that Pancho and Cisco later discover.

programme.title: Coroner Creek
programme.desc: A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) loses his beloved in a robbery and hunts the man (George Macready) to blame, who is living off the loot.

programme.title: Riding Shotgun
programme.desc: Larry Delong loses his sister and her son when they're gunned down by the notorious Dan Marady and his band of outlaws during a holdup. Delong takes a job as a stagecoach guard, hoping to run into the bandits and take revenge. Run into them, he does, but numbers are on Marady's side, and they shoot up and rob Delong's coach. Delong barely escapes with his life. When he tries to alert the authorities, they implicate him in the crime, and he becomes a fugitive.

programme.title: Joaquin Murietta
programme.desc: The 1850s California gold fields are home to notorious bandit Joaquin Murietta; Matt and Frankie arrive to track him down, but he kidnaps Frankie; Matt and Captain Love trail Murietta to the bitter end.

programme.title: Tiburcio Vasquez
programme.desc: Tiburcio Vasquez vows vengeance against Anglos after his sister Dolores is killed; Matt and Frankie try to stop his years of terror in Southern California after a railroad agent is killed with the help of a local priest.

programme.title: Chief Crazy Horse
programme.desc: Matt enlists the aid of Dakota chiefs to bring in Crazy Horse.

programme.title: Black Bart
programme.desc: The man behind a string of stagecoach robberies has remained out of reach of company detectives Matt and Frankie, but reinforcements from the city help to crack the case.

programme.title: Guilt of a Town
programme.desc: The townspeople are angry about escalating crime and criminals being set free by the court.

programme.title: Cave-In
programme.desc: A ditch digger gets buried in a cave while digging for silver under Tombstone's main street.

programme.title: The Horsetraders
programme.desc: When a horse dealer transporting a prize stallion stops in North Fork, two saddle tramps try to use trickery to obtain it.

programme.title: The Spoiler
programme.desc: An elderly couple moves to North Fork under an assumed name to hide the fact that they are the parents of a vicious killer; the plan backfires when the son shows up at their home.

programme.title: Heller
programme.desc: After foiling a girl's attempt to rob the general store, Lucas finds that she and her brother are plotting the murder of their abusive stepfather.

programme.title: Grasshopper
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark find themselves held at gunpoint by a prisoner being transported on a train, which becomes stranded from a plague of grasshoppers.

programme.title: Jeopardy at Jackson Hole
programme.desc: Bat goes to Jackson Hole, Wyo., to investigate the murder of an old friend at the request of his daughter; the family's freight business faces bankruptcy due to the unsolved murders of its drivers.

programme.title: Double Showdown
programme.desc: Bat Masterson's friend asks for help when rival gambling house owner Big Keel Roberts threatens his casino, with the conflict coming down to a poker game between Bat and Roberts for ownership of both establishments.

programme.title: Loot from Richmond
programme.desc: A friend of the Derringer family gets assassinated while delivering a message from a former general.

programme.title: The Saga of Lonesome Jackson
programme.desc: Yancy investigates a flood of counterfeit money hitting the French Quarter.

programme.title: Man on the Run
programme.desc: Accused killer stops at a water hole.

programme.title: The Deserters
programme.desc: A sergeant is ordered to track down a deserter in the Arizona desert.

programme.title: Charlie Spends the Night with Lacey
programme.desc: Charlie spends the night with Lacey to keep her from killing her ex-boyfriend; Jordan makes a big mistake while taking care of Sean while he is sick.

programme.title: Charlie Screws a Prisoner's Girlriend
programme.desc: After sleeping with a prisoner's girlfriend, Charlie finds out the prisoner is being releases the next day.

programme.title: Charlie Cops a Feel
programme.desc: A female cop makes Charlie's life a living hell after he breaks up with her; Jordan struggles to establish a casual sex relationship with Sean.

programme.title: Charlie, Lacey & The Dangerous Plumber
programme.desc: Charlie tries to keep Lacey from hooking up with an ex-con; Patrick looks for a way to avoid being the bad guy on his reality show.

programme.title: Charlie & The Mother of All Sessions
programme.desc: Charlie creates chaos when he surprises his therapy group by bringing their dysfunctional parents to a session.

programme.title: Charlie & Sean's Twisted Sister
programme.desc: Charlie tries to resist temptations from Sean's hot younger sister; Patrick and Lacey discover that they are dating the same man.

programme.title: Charlie Has a Threesome
programme.desc: Problems arise when Charlie's girlfriend brings home a hot friend; Lacey uses Jordan's help to try and sell her eggs.

programme.title: Charlie & The Lap Dance of Doom
programme.desc: Charlie gets Sean fired from the strip club when he sleeps with one of the strippers.

programme.title: Charlie Tests His Will Power
programme.desc: Charlie makes a promise to an attractive reporter; it involves an interview with an extremely furious convict.

programme.title: Charlie & The Psychic Therapist
programme.desc: Charlie and Jordan have to share a hotel room to expose a shady couple's therapist; Nolan discovers that the African child he sponsored is all grown up and more successful than him.

programme.title: Charlie Gets Between Sean & Jordan
programme.desc: Charlie sets up Sean with a hottie even though he knows Sean is seeing Jordan; Lacey pretends to be in a coma in her latest scam to make money.

programme.title: Charlie Does Time with The Hot Warden
programme.desc: Charlie gets in hot water with his prison group when he sleeps with the attractive new warden; Nolan's new limo driver job puts him in an awkward situation with Lacey.

programme.title: Charlie & The Warden's Dirty Secret
programme.desc: Charlie inadvertently helps a member of his prison group in an escape attempt.

programme.title: Charlie & The Temper of Doom
programme.desc: Charlie struggles to control his anger after meeting a hot girl who doesn't date angry guys; Jordan and Sean play some pranks on Charlie.

programme.title: Charlie Gets Trashed
programme.desc: Charlie looks for revenge after going to war with his garbage man; Nolan and Lacey compete for the same job.

programme.title: Charlie & The Case of the Curious Hottie
programme.desc: Charlie becomes paranoid after discovering he's dating a private investigator; Nolan and Lacey move into Nolan's work limo.

programme.title: Charlie Pledges a Sorority Sister
programme.desc: Charlie falls into trap when Jordan sets him up with a heartbreaker; Lacey begins dating a record producer.

programme.title: Charlie Plays Hide & Go Cheat
programme.desc: Charlie finds himself in a contest with a female private investigator to prove that he could cheat on her without getting caught.

programme.title: Charlie & The Revenge of the Hot Nerd
programme.desc: Charlie's life is taken hostage by a controlling techy girl; Lacey launches a plan with Patrick to trick her rival into having sex with Ed.

programme.title: Charlie & The Curse of the Flying Fist
programme.desc: Charlie creates a monster when he helps Nolan unleash his anger.

programme.title: Charlie & The Houseful of Hookers
programme.desc: Charlie lets his house become a halfway house for five hookers.

programme.title: Charlie Gets Patrick High
programme.desc: Charlie tries to help Patrick through a crisis of confidence by getting him stoned.

programme.title: Charlie and Lacey Go For Broke
programme.desc: Charlie accidentally causes Lacey to become engaged to a creepy billionaire (Gilbert Gottfried).

programme.title: Charlie & The Terrible, Horrible, No Good Very Bad Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Charlie almost destroys Ed's marriage and Jordan hits on Nolan.

programme.title: Charlie Rolls The Dice in Vegas
programme.desc: Charlie goes to Vegas and life gets complicated after a night of heavy drinking.

programme.title: Charlie & The Return of the Danger Girl
programme.desc: Charlie risks his life to sleep with a thrill-seeker.

programme.title: Charlie Gets in Bed with Jordan and Her Ex
programme.desc: Charlie gets between Jordan and her ex-husband.

programme.title: Charlie's Living the Dream
programme.desc: Charlie becomes trapped in a wild dream where he can't distinguish between what's real and what's not.

programme.title: Charlie Meets his Match
programme.desc: A matchmaker sets up Charlie and Sean with the wrong dates.

programme.title: Charlie and The Epic Relationship Fail
programme.desc: Charlie interferes with Lacey and Nolan's love life and gets Nolan kidnapped by prisoners.

programme.title: Charlie Gets Tied Up with A Catholic Girl
programme.desc: Charlie's father sets him up with a hot, but quiet Catholic girl who turns out to be too wild, even for Charlie.

programme.title: Charlie and the Sexy Swing Vote
programme.desc: Charlie's father sets him up with a hot, but quiet Catholic girl who turns out to be too wild, even for Charlie.

programme.title: Charlie & The 100th Episode
programme.desc: Charlie has to make a decision between keeping his group and being a sports psychologist for a baseball team.

programme.title: Charlie Goes Back to Therapy
programme.desc: The first episode in which Charlie - a baseball player with anger issues turned anger management therapist - decides to return to therapy after a bad run-in with his ex wife's new boyfriend. The only problem is he just happens to be sleeping with the one therapist he trusts: his best friend, Kate.

programme.title: Charlie & The Slumpbuster
programme.desc: The new "evolved" Charlie has to deal with a ghost from his old carousing, baseball-playing days when a unattractive woman he slept with just to break a batting slump shows up as a new patient in group therapy.

programme.title: Charlie and Kent Battle over a Patient
programme.desc: A long-standing rivalry over who's a better therapist leads to war when Kate steals Patrick, one of Charlie's group patients.

programme.title: Charlie Tries Sleep Deprivation
programme.desc: Charlie challenges his group to do thirty-six hours of sleep deprivation therapy so that their "inhibitions come down and the truth comes out" - except the result turns out to be the exact opposite.

programme.title: Charlie's Patient Gets Out of Jail
programme.desc: Charlie and his ex, Jennifer, are having an issue with how Charlie still tries to manage her life when Cleo - one of Charlie's patients from his prison anger therapy group - shows up on his doorstep, fresh out on parole. Jennifer decides to get back at Charlie by dating the ex-con.

programme.title: Charlie Dates Kate's Patient
programme.desc: Inflamed by Kate's comment that he's only "nouveau smart", Charlie starts covertly dating a brilliant coffee-shop barista. The only problem is that the woman is turned on by sex where there's a chance of getting caught -- and she's Kate's patient.

programme.title: Charlie Tries to Prove Therapy is Legit
programme.desc: Charlie falls for Jen's hot new business partner, Lori - played by Charlie's real-life ex, Denise Richards - only to find she thinks therapy is a scam. In the therapy group, Patrick asks Charlie to counsel the angry ghost of his mother, who he believes is haunting his apartment.

programme.title: Charlie Outs A Patient
programme.desc: Charlie has to evaluate the depth of his involvement in his patient's lives when he accidentally helps his patient who vicariously enjoys other people's anger hook up with a crazy woman.

programme.desc: A mad scientist (George Zucco) turns his assistant (David Bruce) into a zombie as part of a plan to steal his assistant's lover (Evelyn Ankers).

programme.title: Man-Made Monster
programme.desc: A mad scientist (Lionel Atwill) makes an electric man (Lon Chaney Jr.) who glows and must wear a rubber suit.

programme.title: The Monster and the Girl
programme.desc: A mad scientist creates a monster when he transplants the brain of an executed murderer into the body of an ape.

programme.title: Monster on the Campus
programme.desc: A professor turns into a Neanderthal killer after injecting himself with the blood of an ancient fish.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: A team of British archaeologists led by Sir Joseph Whemple discover the mummified remains of the ancient Egyptian prince Imhotep, along with the legendary scroll of Thoth. When one of the archaeologists recites the scroll aloud, Imhotep returns to life, but escapes. Several years later, Imhotep has taken on the guise of a wealthy man, as he searches Egypt for his lost love, who he believes has been reincarnated as the lovely Helen Grosvenor.

programme.title: The Mummy's Curse
programme.desc: A mummy (Lon Chaney Jr.) and his princess (Virginia Christine) roam the Louisiana bayou.

programme.title: The Mummy's Ghost
programme.desc: A 3000-year-old limping mummy (Lon Chaney) seeks his reincarnated princess (Ramsay Ames) in a Midwestern college town.

programme.title: The Mummy's Hand
programme.desc: In Cairo, archaeologist Steve Banning (Dick Foran) unearths a vase that he believes could lead him to the ancient tomb of Princess Ananka. Unknown to Steve, his colleague, Professor Andoheb (George Zucco), is also the High Priest of Karnak who holds the secrets of Karas, a mummy who guards Ananka's tomb. Upon receiving funds from magician Solvani (Cecil Kellaway) and his daughter, Marta (Peggy Moran), Steve and the Solvanis embark on an expedition to the grave site, where Karas awaits.

programme.title: The Mummy's Tomb
programme.desc: Old archaeologist (Dick Foran) recalls mummy (Lon Chaney) at large in New England.

programme.title: Night Creatures
programme.desc: Pirate Captain Clegg (Peter Cushing), an English vicar by day, leads ghostly mounted smugglers by night.

programme.title: Night Monster
programme.desc: A man (Lionel Atwill) uses mind over matter to replace his legs, then hunts the doctors who took them.

programme.title: The Night Walker
programme.desc: A lawyer (Robert Taylor) advises a blind man's rich widow (Barbara Stanwyck) tormented by nightmares.

programme.title: The People Under the Stairs
programme.desc: When young Fool (Brandon Adams) breaks into the home of his family's greedy and uncaring landlords, he discovers a disturbing scenario where incestuous adult siblings have mutilated a number of boys and kept them imprisoned under stairs in their large, creepy house. As Fool attempts to flee before the psychopaths can catch him, he meets their daughter, Alice (A.J. Langer), who has been spared any extreme discipline by her deranged parents. Can Fool and Alice escape before it's too late?

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera
programme.desc: Talented Christine (Susanna Foster) is unaware that her singing lessons are being funded by a secret admirer, Enrique (Claude Rains), a mysterious violinist with a disfigured face. Christine's colleagues become suspicious when mysterious accidents start occurring at the Paris Opera House, as the deaths coincide with her meteoric rise to stardom. Christine's suitors, Raoul (Edgar Barrier) and Anatole (Nelson Eddy), brave the dark recesses of the opera house to find the true culprit.

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera
programme.desc: Composer Lord Ambrose D'Arcy (Michael Gough) and his backer, Harry Hunter (Edward De Souza), struggle to find a replacement for the female lead in their new opera after she quits in the wake of a gruesome murder. When a new prospect, the nubile Christine Charles (Heather Sears), disappears, Harry cautiously investigates. Meanwhile, a mysterious masked man (Herbert Lom) who is eerily familiar with the opera holds Christine captive and offers to groom her to play the part.

programme.title: Revenge of the Creature
programme.desc: Florida aquarium workers (John Agar, Lori Nelson, John Bromfield) communicate by cattle prod with a captured gill-man.

programme.title: She-Wolf of London
programme.desc: Grisly murders convince a turn-of-the-century Londoner that she is the latest in a long line of werewolves.

programme.title: Son of Dracula
programme.desc: Count Alucard (Lon Chaney) makes Southern belle (Louise Allbritton) his bride.

programme.title: Son of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Baron Wolf von Frankenstein is determined to prove the legitimacy of his father's scientific work, thus rescuing the family name from disgrace. With the help of Ygor, a grave robber, Wolf successfully reanimates the monster his father originally brought back from the dead. But when several villagers are killed mysteriously, Wolf must find the culprit in order to vindicate his creation, or face the possibility that he may be responsible.

programme.title: Sssssss
programme.desc: Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.title: Tarantula
programme.desc: Desert scientists (John Agar, Mara Corday, Leo G. Carroll) try to stop a fortified spider the size of a building.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: The Werewolf of London
programme.desc: While in Tibet researching a mysterious flower that purportedly takes its strength from the moon, botanist Wilfred Glendon is bitten by a strange creature. Back in London, Glendon becomes absorbed in his research of the plant, and is annoyed by the appearance of fellow scientist Dr. Yogami, who reveals that the plant is the only known temporary antidote for werewolves. Glendon remains skeptical until the next full moon, when he undergoes a startling transformation.

programme.title: The Wolf Man
programme.desc: When his brother dies, Larry Talbot (Lon Chaney) returns to Wales and reconciles with his father (Claude Rains). While there, he visits an antique shop and, hoping to impress Gwen (Evelyn Ankers), the attractive shopkeeper, buys a silver walking cane. That same night he kills a wolf with it, only to later learn that he actually killed a man (Bela Lugosi). A gypsy (Maria Ouspenskaya) explains that it was her son, a werewolf, that he killed, and that Larry is now one himself.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Animal
programme.desc: When plans for a weekend vacation hit a dead end, friends find themselves stranded in unfamiliar territory, pursued by a bloodthirsty predator. Holed up in an isolated cabin, the friends must fight to survive as the body count rises.

programme.title: The Atticus Institute
programme.desc: In the early 1970s, Dr. Henry West creates an institute to find people with supernatural abilities. When Judith Winstead comes to the facility, she exhibits amazing abilities that the military wants to turn into a weapon.

programme.title: Beneath
programme.desc: Coal miners become trapped 600 feet below the surface. As the air grows toxic and time runs out, the crew descends into madness and turns on one another.

programme.title: The Birds II: Land's End
programme.desc: Killer birds infest a seaside town where parents (Brad Johnson, Chelsea Field) take their children for vacation.

programme.title: The Black Castle
programme.desc: An Englishman (Richard Greene) enters an Austrian nobleman's (Stephen McNally) castle, complete with torture chamber and alligator moat.

programme.title: Blood Creek
programme.desc: Two brothers become entangled in a sinister Nazi's occult experiment at an American farmhouse.

programme.title: Captive Wild Woman
programme.desc: A mad doctor (John Carradine) turns an animal trainer's (Milburn Stone) ape into Paula the ape-woman (Acquanetta).

programme.title: Cherry Falls
programme.desc: A small-town sheriff, Brent Marken (Michael Biehn), discovers the presence of a serial killer in his sleepy hamlet. Since the perpetrator has been targeting only virgins, both male and female, the deaths cause panic in much of the local high school population. Sheriff Marken's daughter, Jody (Brittany Murphy), is among the potential victims, since she has yet to sleep with her boyfriend, Kenny Ascott (Gabriel Mann). Can the lawman stop the killer before he goes after Jody?

programme.title: Cry Wolf
programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: Cucuy: The Boogeyman
programme.desc: A teenage girl under house arrest discovers that the nightmarish urban legend of the Mexican boogeyman, El Cucuy, is true.

programme.title: Crushing It: Episode 4
programme.desc: Grab a backstage pass and get a glimpse of what it takes to produce a Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live event. Our team presents you with the stars of Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live, while hanging out with Demo Derby driver, Derick Anson, and visiting FMX driver, Cody Elkins, at his home in Oklahoma.

programme.title: Will the Ford 300 Inline Six Start After Sitting for 20 Years?

Project Spartan is getting closer to being a fully functioning machine.

programme.title: Beefing Up The '70 RestoMod Mustang's Brakes

programme.title: Adding More Power to the Rally Car's 4 Cylinder

programme.desc: The guys work hard to finish their 1974 build under the hood, under the frame, and under the top because this prized new Bronco will be on its way to the SEMA Show in Las Vegas.

programme.desc: We wrap up our 427ci LSx engine build for the Music City Trucks' C10 so it can hit the engine dyno! We're topping this engine with a high flowing induction package, stand-alone EFI, and classic small block look. We'll tune it up on the dyno to make pump gas power that will dominate the street!

programme.title: Adding Posi-traction to our '02 Old School Sierra

programme.title: Dodge Challenger Tears It Up At NCM Motorsports Park
programme.desc: The Challenger tears it up at NCM Motorsports Park! Plus we'll help a viewer perk up her pickup in this week's Driveway Rescue.

programme.desc: We buy a '02 Sierra on the cheap and turn it into a reliable, powerful daily driver. First a leveling kit, wheels, and tires for a brand new stance.

programme.title: How to Install a Convertible Top
programme.desc: Step by step, we install a new top on our 1966 Pontiac convertible. Plus, a High Performance visit to Las Vegas for LS Fest West.

programme.title: Taking our '69 Camaro into the Modern Era
programme.desc: We take our '69 Camaro and upgrade the suspension, brakes and tires to give it better handling and performance on the street.

programme.title: Pre-Runner Ranger Part 4 Steering Upgrades
programme.desc: Eliza and Jeremy are adding a custom steering setup to their 2002 Ford Pre-Runner Ranger!

programme.title: Turning An Old Crown Vic Cruiser Into A Track Panther - Part 1

programme.title: Brake the Pavement
programme.desc: The EBC Brakes and Pedal Commander Dodge Charger gets its final touches on brakes and cosmetics before hitting the track.

programme.title: Ultimate 318 LA: Part 2
programme.desc: Our small block 318 Mopar returns to be prettied up and completed on this episode. We cover it in a custom color and go through a detailed assembly process to get it ready for our Dyno. But things go sideways during the testing with our 318, first making excellent power then revealing major problems, and we hope we caught it in time.

programme.title: 1980s Mustang Cobra Transformation Part 2
programme.desc: This hissing Cobra gets dialed in with final touches, taking it from concept to coiled and ready to strike! Strap in for Project Sydewinder's first track day!

programme.title: OBS Pro Touring Chevy Heads to the C10 Nationals and Hits the Track
programme.desc: We add the final touches to our OBS Pro Touring Chevy C1500 and take it to the C10 Nationals where we put it to the test at the Nashville Superspeedway.

programme.title: AWD vs. 4WD Chevy 1500
programme.desc: There's a new purpose and a new plan for our Chevy K1500. It's the tips and techniques for a traction machine. GM's Greatest All-Wheel-Drive Idea Applied To Our C/K 1500

programme.title: Tearing Down a Pair of 351 Small Blocks: Windsor vs Cleveland
programme.desc: HorsePower goes on a salvage yard treasure hunt and finds a pair of 351 smallblocks -- Cleveland and Windsor. After twin teardowns, exploring the characteristics of each, the guys start the first of two performance build-ups.

programme.title: Power Nationals Muscle
programme.desc: We check out the 8 acres of muscle cars, hot rods, and classic cars, along with an autocross attraction at the first annual Power Nationals event at the Nashville Superspeedway.

programme.title: JL Rubicon: Tires and Under Armor
programme.desc: Our Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon gets brand new tires and some much needed under armor. Plus, our 2001 Tacoma gets a spray-on bed liner.

programme.title: Rescuing A 1971 Chevy Caprice From Driveway Death
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle crew rescues a familiar green 1971 Chevy Caprice, dropping a few tips and tricks along the way while diagnosing issues that can easily go unseen.

programme.title: Tearing Into Our AMC Javelin
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc have new project in the shop and have some unique plans that pay homage to the street machine era. But to do that they need to see what they have to work with.

programme.title: Cooling Down & Increasing Power On The '71 Chevy Caprice
programme.desc: Cool Running - We install the cooling system on our '71 Caprice and then put the pedal to the metal to give you the lowdown on electronic throttle vs mechanical.

programme.title: How Camshaft Timing Affects Engine Performance
programme.desc: The first-generation Chevy Small Block deserves its reputation as a powerful and reliable engine. It's the foundation for an old-school stroker build with an emphasis on durability.

programme.title: Sea Foam Truck Tech Sweepstakes
programme.desc: A beefy transmission and gear swap wraps up the Silverado giveaway truck that you can win!

programme.title: Lift & Shift
programme.desc: We yank out our old suspension, upgrade the underside of our Diesel Dually, Nightshift, and give it a disc brake conversion and lift kit to help uphold its Dodge signature style.

programme.title: Lighting the Way Forward
programme.desc: Project Spartan, our 1969 Jeep Kaiser M715, is getting a major overhaul from the ground up. We start by upgrading the lighting system with modern headlights and some vintage C10 turn signals, then move on to the critical work of patching and reinforcing the frame; fixing all the damage left behind by years of rust and corrosion. But the real milestone comes when we reunite the engine with the transmission, build custom mounts, and drop the heart of this beast back onto the frame.

programme.title: 700 Horsepower '86 Jeep Wagoneer Monster Hits the Track
programme.desc: This is a non-stop, complete thrash as we turn a 1986 Jeep Wagoneer into a 700+ horsepower, two-wheel drive monster and put it to the test at the National Corvette Museum Motorsports Park.

programme.title: Body Kit Bolt Ons
programme.desc: Balling on a budget means spending your money wisely. Brian and Jason ordered a complete body kit for their 2011 Lexus IS 250 from China and today, they're cracking open the crate! Will it work or do they have to cut it to fit?

programme.title: Pumping Extra Ponies Under The Hood Of The Retro AMC Javelin
programme.desc: We put some muscle behind our 1973 AMC Javelin, and we see how far it will go on the Dyno.

programme.title: Turning a '76 Cadillac Hearse Into A Torque Monster
programme.desc: We take a '76 Cadillac Hearse and start turning it into a torque monster that will scream down the track starting with the drivetrain.

programme.title: Chevy Blazer Custom Paint
programme.desc: After months of prep, the '89 Blazer hits the paint booth for a custom mix of color. And to accompany the panels will be a color-matched bedliner.

programme.title: Restoring a Scuffed Up Windshield - Road Runner Part 6
programme.desc: We get into some arts and crafts to create a one-of-a-kind emblem that redefines ransom wear and we'll use some wool to clear up Road Burner's eyes. When it's all said and done, the guys will be literally exhausted.

programme.title: 509ci W-Series Big Block Chevy Part 2
programme.desc: We continue the buildup of our 509ci W-Series engine as we get it ready to hit the engine dyno. We wrap up this vintage looking hot rod power plant with high flowing induction and throttle body EFI before we see how much power it makes in the dyno.

programme.title: Extreme Diesel Rigs at Ultimate Callout Challenge

programme.title: Hellcat '69 Charger Restomod Sold For $200,000 - How We Did It

programme.title: Hot Rod LQ9 Cam Swap

programme.desc: We bring in a new Ford F350 Crew Cab Dually and make improvements that will make the truck more functional as a towing rig and all-around work truck for everyone here at PowerNation.

programme.title: Faux Guy Square Body Gets Custom 3" Stainless Exhaust
programme.desc: We start reassembling our 1985 Chevy K-10 square body. We'll add steering, brakes, exhaust, and glass. Plus restoration components that will make our square body look young again!

programme.title: Big Bore 363 Small Block Ford Part 1
programme.desc: Pat and Frankie dive into a brand new, bad to the bone, Small Block Ford that will make outstanding pump-gas power and be able to run on the track. We go through all the prep and machine work to get this powerplant ready to assemble later in Part 2.

programme.title: Power Nationals Trucks
programme.desc: We show you all the trucks, from late models to classics, including BIGFOOT, and a drifting exhibition, that are on display to the public at the first annual Power Nationals event in Nashville.

programme.title: Building the Next Stage of Test Sled
programme.desc: Mike and Pat move to the next stages of the Test Sled build including top end performance goodies, racing seats, an accessory drive, and custom tail lights.

programme.title: Dirty JL
programme.desc: We're on the trail! We are taking our Jeep JL to Burning Rock Off Road park, and the Hatfield McCoy Trail system in West Virginia to see just how dirty our Jeep can get!

programme.title: Go Fast, Spend Less
programme.desc: It has a 6.2 L V8, factory supercharged, with a manual transmission, but can we make it faster without breaking the bank? Joel and Brian test out some cost-effective enhancements on their 2015 Camaro ZL1.

programme.title: Custom Race Inspired Fuel System for a Buick Regal
programme.desc: With a nod to the Grand National we're giving our Buick Regal more Go Go. Fabricating a race inspired fuel system gets us one step closer to our '85 Buick Regal launch.

programme.title: Project Creep It Real Part 1
programme.desc: We tear into our 2012 Jeep JK to begin its transformation into Project Creep It Real!

programme.title: Tips for Custom Brake Lines and Hoses
programme.desc: All of the mechanical and electrical systems are getting buttoned up on our '85 Buick Street Regal. That includes tips and techniques for custom hoses and brake lines.

programme.title: Off-Road Wheeling in West Virginia
programme.desc: The XOR team and a group of off-road enthusiasts hit the trails on the XOR Adventure Ride 4. This year the team heads to the heart of coal country in West Virginia! Everything from the XOR JL Rubicon to the General Tire Tacoma to ATVs hit the trails.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 5 - New Chains
programme.desc: Prisoners love their chains, and Project Henchman is no different. On this episode of Detroit Muscle, the 1969 GTO gets a shiny new exterior look.

programme.title: Prison Tats
programme.desc: Project Henchman is hoping to get a new look on this episode of Detroit Muscle. Tommy and Peyton begin rust repair and a new paint job that'll make this '69 Pontiac GTO shine.

programme.title: Carcass Off-Road Excursion
programme.desc: The Carcass crew invites a few friends out for a day on the trails. We put our Jeep JK to the test and flex it in the hills of East Tennessee.

programme.title: Fabricating a Buick Regal Custom Bumper
programme.desc: We add some GNX body panels to our '85 Buick Regal. We clean up and update a set of old Camaro/Nova wheels with fresh paint and trim pieces.

programme.title: Road Course Camaro Part 6 Roof Top Extension
programme.desc: Our 1972 Camaro is ready for reassembly. The roll cage is welded up, so now it's time to reattach the roof. We'll show you some helpful techniques on how to reinstall your cut-off top. Plus, we head out to help a young viewer get his '91 Chevy Camaro back on the road in an all-new Driveway Rescue.

programme.title: Reviving a High Mileage '69 Camaro
programme.desc: Destination "fun-town," Marc and Tommy are taking a '69 Chevy Camaro RS/SS to the next level! With performance, handling, and appearance upgrades, it's time to revive this ultra-cool muscle car giveaway ride.

programme.title: FErocious Ford Part 1
programme.desc: We bring back our beloved 1965 Ford flatbed shop truck and drop in a naturally aspirated 586 HP FE old-school V8 built by Engine Power.

programme.title: Crushing It: Episode 2
programme.desc: With Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live returning to the big screen, see our Designer Round Table and learn about the design process in making a toy monster truck. Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live gives you an under the hood look at the iconic cars that call the Hot Wheels garage home.

programme.title: Camaro Test Drive and English Drag Racing
programme.desc: The guys take a test spin in the Valvoline Giveaway Camaro, and swing by the last remaining drag strip in England for a day of hot passes.

programme.title: CTS-V Wagon SEMA Build
programme.desc: Rare Cadillac. Big plans. We're partnering with EBC Brakes to transform a 2014 CTS-V Wagon with into the ultimate trailer towing SEMA showstopper.

programme.title: Can a Stock Cast SBC Crank live at 7000 RPM and 570+ HP?
programme.desc: E85 fuel promises high-octane performance for almost any engine. We put it to the test in our revamped 360ci "Compression Obsession" Small Block Chevy.

programme.title: Tired Supercharged Coyote Mustang Interior Gets an Overhaul
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle crew creates a custom exhaust with some TIG Tech, and they lay out a new living room for our EBC Supercharged Coyote Mustang.

programme.title: Tacoma Axle Swap
programme.desc: Jeremy and Eliza transform the Tacoma and show how to get more axle for your money.

programme.title: Adding 315HP to a 2016 Mustang GT with a Stage 2 Supercharger
programme.desc: From stock to rock, Tommy and Marc introduce the EBC Brakes Mustang GT Giveaway Car and give it more power!

programme.title: Finishing Our Crown Vic Sleeper with Handling and Braking
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc's old Crown Vic Interceptor is whistling a new tune with a turbo, upgraded suspension, gears and bigger tires. The only thing left is a hot pursuit to the donut shop that pushes the legal limits!

programme.title: 427 Cubic Inches of Naturally Aspirated HP for Javelin Trans Am Tribute Build
programme.desc: A 427 ci LSX engine goes naturally aspirated for an underappreciated muscle car.

programme.title: Blown 383 Stroker Has Trouble on the Dyno, What Happened?
programme.desc: The crew from Carcass needs plenty of power to move their 1-ton military truck. Our answer: supercharge a 383 ci V8!

programme.title: Prerunner Ranger gets a Custom Console
programme.desc: The transformation of this off-road beast continues as Eliza and Jeremy complete the interior, install a custom dash, and build a spare tire carrier.

programme.title: Project Creep it Real Part 2
programme.desc: We'll lift our 2012 Jeep JK more than 4 inches and get Dana 60 axles under it!

programme.title: Squeezing the Heartbeat Of Our '69 Camaro Between the Fenders
programme.desc: The guys down in Engine Power have finished beefing up our '69 Camaro' s engine with some high-performance parts, now we have to install it and upgrade the drive train so it can hold it's own with today's modern muscle.

programme.title: '65 C10 Rewind 2
programme.desc: With a fully rebuilt 292 straight-six under the hood, we finish up our patina classic in time to put on some road miles, and check out James Otto's '66 C10 built in an entirely different way.

programme.title: Bolt-On 100+ Horsepower in a Day
programme.desc: Power upgrades are great especially if you can bolt-on big performance in a day. Mike and Pat grab some wrenches to install a ProCharger supercharger on a 2019 Challenger ProCharger.

programme.title: Camaro Racecar Sheds Weight With Carbon Fiber
programme.desc: To make our '72 Chevy Camaro lighter we'll need to shed some weight. We'll show the step-by-step process on how to make your own custom carbon fiber body panels.

programme.title: FErocious Ford Part 2
programme.desc: Our '65 flatbed gets a modern transmission swap to compliment the Ford FE engine for better drivability and performance.

programme.title: Backyard Engine Build
programme.desc: Out of the shop and into the yard! We take a weekend to rebuild a 350ci small block Chevy V8 engine like you would at your home. We'll trade in our professional gear for tools you might have at your house to show you how to get the most out of your build.

programme.title: Buttoning Up and Tuning the 427 Stroker in Our Thunderbird Sleeper
programme.desc: Time again to wake up Project "Deep Sleep" - HorsePower's '97 T-bird hiding a 427 cubic inch small block beast. Today, the guys put final touches on their stealthy, Mustang and Camaro killer.

programme.title: How Much Nitrous for 720HP in a Small Block?
programme.desc: Searching for more power, let's add Nitrous and see what happens when our Chevy small block gets on the bottle!

programme.title: UTV Refurb: General Maintenance
programme.desc: Generally, when you think of trucks, the letters UTV may not come to mind, but today, we're here to change your point of view. The guys tear down a 2019 Polaris General and build it back up to be a lean, mean off-roading machine with all-new suspension, brakes, and some performance upgrades to make this the ultimate utility-train vehicle.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 8: Pearlfection
programme.desc: The guys from MCT take their classic Chevy C-10 and transform it into a work of art. They'll tackle body work to lay down a flawless pearl two-tone finish. Whether you're an experienced builder or just love the beauty of custom trucks, they'll show tips, techniques, and tricks to help bring your own project to life. Plus, Mike and Anthony give us a little tour of their own C-10 projects.

programme.title: Crate Horsepower
programme.desc: We dyno test a custom-built 5.3 LS crate engine, talk in-depth about the importance of quality fasteners, and take a closer look at a wild diesel-powered Cadillac drag car, featuring an interview with its pilot, Jared Ring.
