programme.title: Lucky
programme.desc: A family adopt Lucky, a King Charles spaniel mix, and Luckys training plunges into new depths when Brandon discovers the family have a pool in their backyard.

programme.title: Luna
programme.desc: Brandon rescues a fun-loving German Shepherd that was found as a stray, but the dogs boundless energy threatens to be a deal breaker for a woman who was injured while walking a Shepherd in the past.

programme.title: Oliver
programme.desc: A homeless, severely underweight terrier mix is given a home with a Los Angeles family.

programme.title: Best of: Handling Over the Reins
programme.desc: Brandon prepares six shelter dogs for life after the ranch. But before he "hands over the reins" to their new families, he'll need to ensure that each new owner is ready for the responsibility and challenge of their new pup.

programme.title: Charlotte
programme.desc: When a heeler/Chihuahua mix loses her front leg due to neglect, Brandon steps in to give her a second chance. But preparing this special needs dog for a new life means teaching her to embrace her new body and finding her an equally "special" new home.

programme.title: Muffin
programme.desc: A neglected terrier mix gets a second chance with a dog-loving family that devotes much of their time to the Special Olympics. But before Muffin can hit the road with her new family, she'll need to correct her begging habit and prove to Brandon that shes ready for a life of travel.

programme.title: Rosie
programme.desc: Brandon helps turn a ten-month-old poodle mix into a therapy dog for a cancer survivor whos hoping to pay it forward. But, can managing one of lifes most difficult challenges prepare Lori for the job of handling Rosie?

programme.title: Olive
programme.desc: Brandon trains a four-year-old poodle mix to work alongside a child advocate in the Missouri court system. But until Olive can prove she has the right temperament for the job, the jury remains out on her adoption.

programme.title: Jax
programme.desc: Brandon rescues Jax, a two-year old black shepherd-collie mix with hip dysplasia. After surgery to correct the condition, Brandon rehabilitates Jax so he can join the rescued animals at a farm owned by Brandons friend.

programme.title: Biscuit
programme.desc: A debilitating skin condition leaves a French bulldog mix with little hope for adoption, until an eleventh hour save gives him another shot at life. But will the family pool sink Biscuits chance at a forever home?

programme.title: Best of: One Step at a Time
programme.desc: Every dog has its day... but training them takes a lot longer. Whether its busting bad habits or cultivating news skills, true results require patience, consistency and above all else, taking it "one step at a time".

programme.title: Kona
programme.desc: Two former high school sweethearts reunite after college and decide to kick off their new life by adopting a shelter dog. But before one-and-a-half-year-old Kona can fit into their beach-centric lifestyle, she'll need to conquer her own fear of new environments.

programme.title: Kai
programme.desc: Kai is a dog who was found on the streets in Los Angeles and who was born blind on his left side. Brandon matches Kai to a woman who wants to take him to her grandmothers assisted living facility as a loving and calm therapy dog.

programme.title: Scout
programme.desc: Brandon rescues a ten-week-old puppy whose close bond with another ranch resident could be the key to successful training. If all goes well, Scout could be the perfect match for a cancer survivor searching for her next canine

programme.title: Cora
programme.desc: Cora, an eight-year-old Doberman mix, gets a new shot at life when potential owner, Nikki, decides to adopt a senior dog. But will Cora be able to shed a lifetime of bad habits to make way for a new talent?

programme.title: Simba
programme.desc: Before a young, energetic Golden Retriever can be a companion for a family, Brandon will have to teach him control and how to safely navigate around wheelchairs.

programme.title: Patches
programme.desc: A timid Chihuahua/Min Pin mix presents Brandon with an unexpected obstacle as he works to train her to become an emotional support dog.

programme.title: Kobe
programme.desc: Game on! Brandon rescues an "untrainable" terrier mix that was abandoned by his original owner. But if Kobe wants a second chance at a stable home, he'll need to embrace the fundamentals of obedience and keep his head in the game.

programme.title: Stewie
programme.desc: Brandon adopts a hand shy dachshund mix with a history of prior abuse. But before Stewie can officially settle into his loving new home, he'll need to prove that he can get along with his new brother, an eleven-year- old lab mix named Drogo.

programme.title: Lily
programme.desc: An impassioned mother seeks out Brandons assistance in hopes of finding a service dog for her disabled daughter. But before Lily the two-year old Golden Retriever can join this new partnership, she'll need to prove that shes ready to shoulder the responsibility.

programme.title: JoJo and Rhi Rhi
programme.desc: Seeing Double! Unwilling to separate two lifelong pals, Brandon rescues JoJo and Rhi Rhi in hopes of placing them in the same forever home. But preparing them for Josh and Jonathons jet-setting lifestyle means a lesson in flying the friendly skies and helming a stand-up paddleboard.

programme.title: Bella
programme.desc: Brandon trains Bella, 1-1/2-year-old German short-hair pointer mix, abandoned by her family, to be adopted by a Palm Springs, California couple, Bob and Viv, who lost both their dogs to different illnesses on the same day.

programme.title: Bandit
programme.desc: Brandon hopes to place an intelligent Border Collie mix named Bandit into the home of the Bisaccia family. But the adoption falls into jeopardy when mom, Erika, reveals her own personal battle with dog allergies.

programme.title: Dottie
programme.desc: A last minute rescue gives one senior dog the chance to live out her golden years in an exciting new role. But before Dottie can officially join Kris and his companys mascot Lucky, she'll need to embrace office etiquette and a love for travel.

programme.title: Scarlett
programme.desc: Brandon rescues a two-year- old golden retriever that lives life in the fast lane. But when Scarletts new family expresses an interest in taking her on road trips, she and Brandon must hit the road for a lesson in car etiquette.

programme.title: Ali
programme.desc: Ali, a 10-month-old boxer, is trained for adoption by a father and his 14-year-old son, first-time dog owners who love the water.

programme.title: Shadow
programme.desc: A game of trust. Living alone for the first time in fifty years, retiree Gary seeks out a new companion in Shadow, a one-year old Chihuahua mix. But before they can make new memories together, Shadow must learn to put aside the trust issues of his past.

programme.title: Molly
programme.desc: Mary Moore, a single mom, needs a therapy dog to help her 16-year-old autistic son Jack with his anxiety. Brandon trains a six-month-old Chihuahua mix for the job. Kris helps the family with their yard.

programme.title: Cersei
programme.desc: A young Husky mix could be the perfect match for a couple that plans to have kids. But, before Brandon hands over the reigns, he'll need to make sure that this very active dog has the right temperament for a family.

programme.title: Yogi
programme.desc: Brandon helps Yogi, a chocolate Lab mix with anxiety.

programme.title: Groot
programme.desc: Follow the leader! When a submissive Dachshund mix proves difficult to train, Brandon seeks out additional assistance-and finds it in the paws of another trainer.

programme.title: Betsy
programme.desc: To prepare a young Foxhound for a woman hoping for a companion, Brandon will have to help the dog overcome her separation anxiety and keep her nose out of trouble.

programme.title: Otto
programme.desc: When a ranch employee takes a leave of absence to recover from an ongoing medical condition, Brandon trains an Australian cattle dog named Otto to be her companion... and her lifesaver.

programme.title: Best of: Ultimate Tests
programme.desc: From climbing a mountain to resisting temptation to swimming for safety, every dog that Brandon rescues has a unique set of challenges. And success will mean that they are ready for their new families.

programme.title: Lolly
programme.desc: A Maltese mix appears to be an ideal lapdog for a senior, but the dogs boundless energy makes preparation for retirement living a lot of work for Brandon.

programme.title: Atlas
programme.desc: Let freedom ring! Brandon thinks a black German shepherd has what it takes to become a service dog. But is one-year- old Atlas ready to shoulder the needs of a disabled veteran?

programme.title: Lucy
programme.desc: If Brandon can earn the trust of a fearful Chihuahua mix named Lucy, the dog could become the perfect companion for a partially paralyzed adrenaline junkie whos trying to get back on her feet.

programme.title: Popcorn
programme.desc: Brandon rescues Popcorn, a loveable English Bulldog saddled with a history of neglect. Hes found a nurturing new owner in Simone, but can this out of shape bulldog keep up with her active lifestyle?

programme.title: Dean
programme.desc: To prepare a sweet poodle mix for a woman who has had six knee surgeries, Brandon must make sure that the dog has a perfect heel and can jump in and out of cars by himself.

programme.title: Kenny
programme.desc: A sweet Shih Tzu could be the perfect therapy dog for an assisted living facility. But before Kenny will be ready to serve, Brandon must make sure that he has the training and desire for the job.

programme.title: Aussie
programme.desc: Before he can find a new home for a Golden Retriever-Collie mix that was surrendered by his previous family, Brandon must help the dog overcome separation anxiety.

programme.title: Teri
programme.desc: A retired couple reaches out to Brandon in hopes of finding a dog that will help them stay active in their daily fight against Parkinsons disease. But keeping this terriers high-flying energy under control means channeling Teris natural instincts into agility.

programme.title: Odie
programme.desc: A standard poodle named Odie could be the emotional support animal one young woman needs to conquer her severe anxiety. But before Odie can inspire Casey to go back to school, he'll first need to focus on his own graduation.

programme.title: Buddy
programme.desc: A newlywed couple decides to jump-start their new life together by rescuing a puppy. But before Brandon says "I do" to this adoption, he'll need to get Buddys unacceptable puppy habits under control.

programme.title: Frankie
programme.desc: Brandon works with Frankie, a beagle mix whos shy because of an abusive past.

programme.title: Titan
programme.desc: Brandon is on a mission to train a service dog for a Navy veteran who suffers from severe anxiety, panic attacks and seizures. But it will take months of work before he'll know if a rescued German shepherd is prepared to answer the call of duty.

programme.title: Hachi
programme.desc: A homeless dog discovers a second chance with a once-homeless family that also spent time in and out of shelters. But before Hachi can become an official member of their public speaking crew, he'll need to transform his jumping habit into a new skill.

programme.title: Tweety
programme.desc: A pint-sized Maltese mix could be the perfect remedy for one familys heartache. But before Tweety can take a new family under her wing, she'll need to focus on her own healing.

programme.title: Darby
programme.desc: A middle school teacher reaches out to Brandon in hopes of adopting her very first dog. But if nine-month-old Darby wants to be the teachers pet, she'll need to ace the common commands and prove shes ready for a classroom environment.

programme.title: Toto
programme.desc: Theres no place like home! A West Highland terrier mix catches the eye of a loving family looking to adopt their first dog. But will Totos severe reaction to leashes jeopardize his storybook ending?

programme.title: Luke
programme.desc: Brandon rescues a shy German shepherd-Labrador mix and trains the dog to be a companion for a teacher and her students.

programme.title: Tank!
programme.desc: Brandon trains a Tank, a black Lab, to alert a diabetic Navy vet when his blood sugar levels are low.

programme.title: Sebastian
programme.desc: In order to prepare a young Husky for life with his new family, Brandon must make sure that this former escape artist can part ways with his bad habits to prevent additional repeat visits to the local shelter.

programme.title: Penny
programme.desc: A two-year-old boxer with lots of energy could be the perfect playmate for three active boys. But Penny must first learn to focus before she'll be ready for her new family and her new yard.

programme.title: Randy
programme.desc: Brandon finds a mixed poodle for a boy.

programme.title: Charlie
programme.desc: A family look for a playmate for their lab, and Brandon suggests Charlie, an energetic black lab mix.

But if Sawyer, an eight-month old Labrador Retriever, wants to keep up with the familys active lifestyle, he'll need to learn bike training.

programme.title: Poppi
programme.desc: After months of scouring shelters, Brandon thinks hes finally ready to cook up the perfect adoption for his Aunt Patti. But will Aunt Pattis epicurean lifestyle prove too much for this Cocker Spaniels insatiable appetite?

programme.title: Foxy

programme.desc: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

programme.desc: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

programme.title: The Three Amigos
programme.desc: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.

programme.title: What Happens in Vegas
programme.desc: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west.

programme.title: San Fran Summer of Love
programme.desc: Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon.

programme.title: Brokeback Mountain
programme.desc: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man.

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Off We Go Again
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world.

programme.title: Go Greek! Clash of the Titans
programme.desc: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation.

programme.title: Desperately Seeking Santa
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred are getting together for another extraordinary culinary Christmas adventure. Gordon arranged a trip to the official home of Santa. They are going to Lapland to enjoy spectacular landscapes and meet Father Christmas in person.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

programme.title: The French Connection
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland.

programme.title: The Highland Fling
programme.desc: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games.

programme.title: Swift, Silent, Deadly

programme.desc: From his arrest to his resurrection, a lot of questions still surround the last hours of Jesus' life. Recent discoveries and eXperts' analysis shed some light on this enigma. Did Jesus really dies on the cross? Follow this investigation on one of History's biggest mysteries.

programme.title: Mary Magdalene
programme.desc: From very early on, Mary was given the title 'Apostle of the Apostles'. We follow her career as a close follower of Jesus and, contrary to popular belief, show how she is a role model for the Christian life and a powerful feminist voice.

programme.title: Biblical Women: Was Mary Magdalene a Saint or Sinner?
programme.desc: An investigation into the identity of Mary Magdalene, one the Bible's best known women, produces startling insights. Who was she? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or Christ's beloved disciple?

programme.title: Tomb of Jesus: The Evidence
programme.desc: The Real Discoveries team visit two tombs each believed to be the tombs where Jesus was laid to rest and later rose. However, Jesus could not have been laid and risen from both tombs. Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!

programme.title: Third Day
programme.desc: On the third day after Jesus' crucifixion, eyewitnesses reported that they found an empty tomb and had an encounter with a living, breathing Jesus of Nazareth. What proof do we have that the resurrection really happened? This intriguing documentary digs deep into the biblical and historical accounts and explores these questions: Did the disciples steal the body?

programme.title: The Week That Changed The World
programme.desc: The resurrection happened. It's not just the belief of Christians, it's borne out by history, archaeology, and science. This documentary takes viewers step by step through the events of Holy Week-shedding light on the key players, unraveling the political intrigue, and answering long standing questions about what happened, and why. Professor of ancient history and world-renowned expert Dr. Paul L.

programme.title: Jesus of Nazareth
programme.desc: The life, ministry and message of Jesus Christ. Here is the story of His humble birth in a Bethlehem manger, His baptism in the River Jordan and of His calling of the disciples. Witness Jesus' temptation in the wilderness, the Sermon on the Mount, the healing of the blind and many miracles.

programme.title: Peter
programme.desc: St Peter's Basilica in Rome is the centre of the Roman Catholic faith. But the man who it is named after, knew nothing but fishing for the first part of his life. Following the death and resurrection of Jesus, Peter became a missionary of the Christian Church. From the shores of the Sea of Galilee to the might of Rome, Peter became one of the young churches first missionaries.

programme.title: Jesus
programme.desc: This production aims to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection and meaning of Jesus.

programme.title: The Last Supper
programme.desc: The Last Supper is the final meal that, in the Gospel accounts, Jesus shared with his Apostles in Jerusalem before his crucifixion.

programme.title: Peter
programme.desc: The Galilean fishmonger, Peter, emerged as pre-eminent amongst the apostles. We look at his controversial life and career ending with his martyrdom in Rome and his place in laying the foundation of the Catholic Church.

programme.title: James and Jude
programme.desc: James and Jude were the brothers of Jesus, who like Jesus, grew up in their father's carpenters shop in Nazareth. It was only after Jesus' death and resurrection that they became his followers, with James heading up the Jerusalem Church. Each of them wrote letters to the believers with James encouraging them to do good deeds as well as believe.

programme.title: Jesus The Desire Of Ages
programme.desc: Jesus: The Desire of Ages tells the familiar story in a fresh way, through the eyes of those who knew and loved the Son of Man. An inspiring and triumphant music score combined with imaginative visual artistry will grip your heart as you experience the reality of Jesus' ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Philosopher
programme.desc: Paul's background gave him a good understanding of Greek culture and philosophies. But to him the Gospel wasn't philosophy, it was truth and unlike the monasteries of Meteora, where monks hid their faith away, Paul engaged with the philosophers of his day in the market place. In Athens he was invited to address the Council of the Areopagus about the resurrection and 'Unknown God'.

programme.title: The Apocalypse
programme.desc: From the Emmy Award-winning Bible Collection comes a production starring Richard Harris as the Apostle John. Detailing John's visions against the backdrop of the severe persecution of Christians in the first century, this biblically based film will inspire viewers.

programme.title: We Were There
programme.desc: We Were There captures the voices of America's greatest generation, as they share their stories of duty, service, and responsibility during World War II. While the tumultuous global events of the early 1940's provide the backdrop for this film, it is the men and women recalling their personal stories who take center stage.

programme.title: The Two Thieves
programme.desc: The second short film from Vertical Church Films, The Two Thieves captures the uncommon grace and redemption of the crucifixion from a perspective that's never before been captured on film.

programme.title: A Very Corgi Christmas
programme.desc: Laura, a single mom meets a fellow single dad Ben, who enlists her help in taking care of a cute corgi puppy he plans to give to his daughter at Christmas. Through all the chaos, Lauren gets the chance to finally experience the holiday spirit.

programme.title: A Christmas Village
programme.desc: To save her reputation, Piper Jensen, a public relations genius and owner of her own PR company, agrees to work for the owner of a failing Santa's Village and discovers love and how magical Christmas is after all.

programme.title: Christmas Wedding Runaway
programme.desc: A runaway bride does some soul-searching when she's trapped in a snowed-in cabin with her grandmother and an old flame at Christmas.

programme.title: Wesley: A Heart Transformed Can Change the World
programme.desc: John Wesley is well known as the spiritual father of Methodism. His heartfelt struggles, his passion for authentic faith expressing itself through meaningful kingdom work, and his message of saving grace resonate with audiences of all ages and denominations.

programme.title: Carry Me Home
programme.desc: Carry Me Home is a short film following the true story of Maria Ennals (Lindsey Grimble) and her family in the Antebellum South in the cold winter of 1860. Maria is a young mother trapped in slavery who seizes the opportunity to escape with her family when she encounters HARRIET TUBMAN (Karen Abercrombie, War Room).

programme.title: Newton's Grace
programme.desc: Newton's Grace is the true story of a real 'Prodigal Son,' the story of miraculous forgiveness and change that lies behind the powerful words of one of the world's most beloved hymns.

programme.title: Road To Emmaus
programme.desc: Bruce Marchiano stars in this dramatic production which helps viewers discover what may have happened during the miraculous journey on the Road to Emmaus.

programme.title: Heavens to Betsy 2
programme.desc: Author Betsy Simon (Karen Lesiewicz) finally finds career success when her new novel, Heavens to Betsy, is published. Following advice from her agent (Ruth Kaufman), she tells the public that the book is a work of fiction. After talking with Pastor John (Jim O'Heir from TV's 'Parks and Recreation') she claims that the events portrayed in the book actually happened to her!

programme.title: Solomon
programme.desc: Solomon is crowned King of Israel and rules the land with love, peace and respect. While visiting the city, Solomon meets the beautiful Queen of Sheba and falls in love. When she returns to her homeland, Solomon falls into a deep depression, departing from his once idyllic world of peace and luxury while his kingdom threatens to collapse.

programme.title: Grace and Gravity
programme.desc: John Palmer, an American Christian visiting the UK comes across a suicidal British atheist who is about to throw himself off a bridge. Will John convince the man to turn to Christ and live or will John be overcome by his own weaknesses and doubts? Staring Bruce Marchiano (The Encounter) and Richard Brimblecombe (For Love's Sake).

programme.desc: This moving, personal documentary tells the stories of those who adopt children from China as well as the stories of those who loved them first; The biological parents who feel they can't keep their children and the orphanage nannies or foster-families who must say goodbye to the children they've raised for months.

programme.title: Summer Snow
programme.desc: Hallie (Rachel Egggleston) is a small girl with a very big heart. Unfortunately, her creative ways of helping people often leave her father Dan (David Chisum) with a mess to clean up.

programme.title: Biblical Rapture
programme.desc: Since the dawn of the new millennium predictions of the apocalypse have reached a fever pitch. Some scholars believe the Bible tells us there will be a mysterious event called 'The Rapture'. Many believe in the 'second coming' of Christ. Will there be a 'third' coming as well? Could there be a formula hidden in the Book of Revelation? The answers are at once hopeful and frightening.

programme.title: End Time Prophecy of the Popes
programme.desc: Saint Malachy, an obscure Irish archbishop from the 12th century, is said to have written a text called 'The Prophecy of the Popes'. In this he foretold the end of the papacy, the destruction of Rome, and the Last Judgment. Is this only one more apocalyptic vision? Another 'end of the world' tale like the one people have imagined in the Mayan calendar? Perhaps not.

programme.title: Israel's Miracle War: Was the Six Day War the Start of Armageddon?
programme.desc: Israel managed to achieve one of the most stunning military coups of all time in the 1967 Six Day War. Did this conflict also mark the beginning of the End Times?

programme.title: Six Day War: Was the Six Day War a Miracle?
programme.desc: Against all odds Israel scored a decisive military victory during the 1967 Six-Day War. How was this possible? What miraculous events contributed to an Israeli victory?

programme.title: In The Shadow Of Babylon: Prophecy Revealed
programme.desc: Throughout time the human race has been besieged by an unseen religious force. This program reveals the source of all religious confusion, not only in the obvious cults, sects, denominations, but also in the more subtle tones of Christianity. She how pagan Babylon has infected the world's religions, even to the door of your own church.

programme.desc: Learn what the Bible has foretold about today's world events and the Armageddon. This informative documentary explores Bible prophecy surrounding the kingdom of Antichrist by tracking the history of the New World Order from the pages of Scripture to the global revolution sweeping the world.

programme.desc: Some scientists say every major event, major figure in history and even ordinary people appear to be encoded in a mysterious cipher called the Bible Code. Is it possible?

programme.desc: Jeremiah tells the story of the prophet who abandons his family and the woman he loves in order to relay God's message in Jerusalem. Although he is persecuted and branded as a traitor for warning others of the destruction of the Holy City, he continues fearlessly with his mission. When his prophecy is fulfilled, he experiences first-hand Jerusalem's destruction by the Babylonians.

programme.desc: Prophecies of the Passion is an extraordinary look at the Messianic prophecies fulfilled during the final week of Christ's life on earth. The Gospels clearly describe Jesus' betrayal, arrest, death, and resurrection. Remarkably, these events were foretold by Hebrew prophets-in specific detail... centuries before they actually occurred.

programme.title: The Crusades
programme.desc: Host, Seth Udinski, explores the epic clashes between Islam and Christianity that occurred throughout the Medieval Period.

programme.title: Israel, Islam, and Armageddon
programme.desc: With more than 3000 years of history, Jerusalem is mentioned 800 times in the Bible, and prophesied to play a key role in world destiny. Many of these prophecies have already come to pass, with some yet to be fulfilled. This video shows how the current peace process is fraught with peril, why it is impossible for Jerusalem to know true peace in our age, and the Palestinian myth.

programme.desc: John's letters to the Seven Churches, written while he was in exile on Patmos, were messages from Jesus to seven churches in Asia Minor. The Seven Churches included: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamon, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, Laodicea . The history/story of each letter is described in this program.

Although he is persecuted and branded as a traitor for warning others of the destruction of the Holy City, he continues fearlessly with his mission. When his prophecy is fulfilled, he experiences first-hand Jerusalem's destruction by the Babylonians.

programme.title: Giant's Migration
programme.desc: On the coast of south Africa, a group of mammoth mammals is arriving from the deep ocean. Every year humpback and southern right whales make incredible migrations from the Antarctic seas to mate and give birth along southern Africa's rich protected coast. Just arriving in time won't be enough to guarantee a mate. Humpbacks conduct awe-inspiring aerial displays and chaotic competitions for attention before showing off their grace in underwater ballets.

programme.title: Magical Fjords
programme.desc: Fjords are one of the most dramatic landscapes on Earth, but their majesty is just the tip of the iceberg. Fjords stand witness to some of the greatest wonders of the animal kingdom. Fjords are found in a frozen land where only the toughest survive. Whether just below the surface, at the murky depths of the sea floor or on dry land, the fjords offer an incredible bounty to wildlife.

programme.title: On a wildlife mission
programme.desc: As soon as she arrives, conservationist Hannah Emde immerses herself in Namibia's wildlife. The first destination of her trip is the world-famous Naankuse Foundation near Windhoek. In addition to a veterinary clinic, the sanctuary includes 85,000 hectares of wilderness, where endangered and rescued animals live.

programme.title: Fighting for a Mate
programme.desc: Animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each animal fights with a unique set of tools, from display structures and elaborate body language to claws, jaws and antlers. And few fights are as fuelled as those during breeding season; the ultimate trophy for the brave fighter is, of course, a chance to pass on the fighting genes to the next generation.

programme.title: Brown Bears and Salmon
programme.desc: When Spring comes one animal arrives in its thousands. It's the salmon. Travelling an incredible 3500 miles through rivers and streams they are Alaska's hardiest resident. Using their muscular bodies they can swim up stream jumping over any obstacle that comes in their way. But there is one grizzly hazard they face right at the end of their journey. It's the brown bears. These expert fishermen use skill and accuracy to grab onto the salmon with their powerful teeth.

programme.title: Deserts
programme.desc: All habitats present difficulties, but the challenges of the desert are more obvious than most - scorching heat and a lack food and water make them one of the most hostile environments on the planet. But with great challenges come incredible solutions. Despite the deadly conditions, a hardy band of unique animal and plant species have adapted to meet the inhospitable desert conditions head on.

programme.title: The last rhinos
programme.desc: The poaching of rhinos for their horn has brought these animals to the brink of extinction. Namibia's black rhinos are hard to find. The Save The Rhino Trust has been fighting for the protection of the pachyderms every day for 30 years under the most adverse conditions. Hannah Emde accompanies the anti-poaching unit through the semi-desert for a day. She learns how difficult it is to track the animals and can hardly believe her luck when she finds a mother with her calf.

programme.title: January
programme.desc: In Europe in January, we sit around in the dark, missing the bright lights and festivities of Christmas, perhaps it would cheer us up to imagine January around the world. To the north, polar bear cubs are born and nestle against their hibernating mothers, but on the other side of the planet, kangaroos are experiencing the highest temperatures and having to trek in search of water, while in East Africa, wildebeest arrive on their breeding grounds and enjoy a baby-boom on a giant scale.

programme.title: Zanzibar: Land of Giants
programme.desc: Lying 40km off the east coast of Tanzania in Africa, the Zanzibar Archipelago has been labelled the most exotic island chain in the world. Pristine sands and azure blue sea make it a much loved holiday destination, but bizarre creatures, many of enormous size, also roam the islands. The world's largest crab scales trees in search of coconuts, and clouds of giant bats fill the skies at dusk.

programme.title: Meet the Mustelids
programme.desc: To many ears the name mustelid might sound mysterious and confusing. They may sound strange, but this family of hunters are probably much more familiar than you think. They're tiny terrors; ankle-height tigers of the undergrowth. From the icy northern climbs where the bold wolverine quietly rules the forests, scattering wolves with a fearsome glance, to the sun-drenched wetlands of the Amazon where man-sized giant otters work together to protect their families and defend their homes.

programme.title: Fight for Life
programme.desc: Nature is red in tooth and claw - animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between energy spent, the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each fighter has a unique set of tools and techniques available to dispatch their opponents. For predators to find food, lower links in the food chain have a fight on their hands escaping the jaws of death. Their only options are to die, run or turn and fight.

programme.title: Creepy Crawlies - Breeding
programme.desc: Birds do it, bees do it, and so of course do the smallest members of the animal kingdom. Finding a mate is not merely a human pursuit, and few creatures put more vigour, variety and unexpected twists into their love-lives than creepy crawlies! They fill the air with their gentle music and they write their love in the sky. Some battle it out while others just embrace in tender caress. Stand by as they prove that sexual prowess has nothing to do with size - as the creepy crawlies start breeding.

programme.title: The Dry Forest
programme.desc: The dry forest, which once covered the entire Pacific coast of Central America, now exists only as isolated "vestiges". In Costa Rica, however, it has been revived and even expanded thanks to the efforts of biologists and the local population. Here, the population of jaguars, a top predator, is increasing. This unique forest - dense, abundant and colorful during the rainy season, camouflaged and asleep during the dry season - is home to a splendid diversity of plants, trees and wildlife.

programme.title: Death
programme.desc: Salmon, Bears, Beluga Whales, Naked Mole Rat, Bacteria, Aspen Trees In this episode, we explore how different animal species react to impending death. We explore the factors that lead animals to their final resting places: disease, injury, predation, drought, famine. Some species, such as the naked mole rat, while not immortal, seem to be able to effectively protect themselves from certain diseases such as cancer.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Islands come in all shapes and sizes all over the world. Any land mass surrounded by water is an island. They are found in seas, oceans lakes and rivers. Atolls, Islets, keys or cays are formed either as result of land brea-king away, water encroaching on the land, or by volcanic eruptions on the sea bed . Islands are often isolated, which leads to the development of a unique flora, fauna and wildlife. The environmental eco-structure of islands differs widely, as does the wildlife.

programme.title: Amazon Rainforest
programme.desc: The Amazon. A magnificent broad-leafed rainforest. The heart of Brazil. The Amazon basin covers an impressive 7 million square kilometres. Rainforests are often known as the lungs of our planet. The Amazon Rainforest is the largest. Its value in terms of the Oxygen that it provides, and the Carbon Dioxide that it consumes is immeasurable. It is home to splendid, exquisite plant and animal species. The most diverse and numerous array of species found anywhere in the world.

programme.title: African Savannah
programme.desc: Grasslands cover nearly fifty percent of the African continent. African grasslands support vast and diverse wildlife. Due to the open and uncovered nature of grassland, predators are much easier to spot, giving smaller animals a chance to run away, hide and survive. Thanks to the lack of hiding places for predators, the African savannah regions support a much greater diversity of wildlife than temperate grasslands.

programme.title: The Great Barrier Reef
programme.desc: One of Australia's most remarkable natural gifts. The Great Barrier Reef in all it's breath-taking beauty. It is the world's largest coral reef, acknowledged as one of the seven wonders of the natural world, and viewed from a greater distance it's easy to understand why. It is larger than the Great Wall of China and the only living thing on earth visible from space. The Great Barrier Reef supports a vast array of life forms.

programme.title: Kipling's Paradise
programme.desc: The Western Ghats are amongst some of the most biodiverse regions in the world, and these mountains are the ancestral birthplace for many of India's endemic species. This episode delves into India's jungle heart, and the mysterious forests nestled in the shadow of the Western Ghats' great peaks. Amongst these trees lies the fabled world from the pages of history, and the character counterparts to the West's most cherished tales of India - Rudyard Kipling's 'The Jungle Book'.

programme.title: Place of Hope
programme.desc: Five critically endangered African species find protection in one modest haven - De Hoop Nature reserve is not only a World heritage Site its's also incredibly important for the survival of these iconic animal. 36,000 hectares are home to the rare and plucky Cape Mountain Zebra; the beautiful Bontebok; one of the last remaining breeding colonies of Cape Vultures; the African Black Oystercatcher and the mighty Southern Right Whale.

programme.title: Europe's Green Heart
programme.desc: Europe was once covered by forest, from the Arctic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea. Wiped out in a mini ice age around 15000 years ago, they, and the wildlife that inhabit them are making a spectacular recovery. Today, Europe's forests cover around 1 000 million hectares (about 30 times the size of Poland).

programme.title: Water Kingdoms
programme.desc: Argentina's northern territory contains one of the largest reserves in the country. Iberá is a vast expanse of swamps, marshes and lagoons, with a biodiversity count to rival the Pantanal. These lands are bursting with life, home to over 4000 animal and plant species. The rainy season in Iberá finds the wetlands in bloom... but unseen perils lurk beneath the surface, and even here, life can be a struggle for survival.

programme.title: Hidden Russia
programme.desc: There's no doubt Russia has it all: from the subtropics to the arctic and the Atlantic to the Pacific; giant lakes, active volcanoes and endless forests.

programme.title: February
programme.desc: In the northern hemisphere February is one of the toughest months of the year, the seemingly unending cold and scarce food of winter. Some animals fail, but their bodies become a bounty that will see carnivores and scavengers through. In parts of Africa animals face the opposite problem, high temperatures and overdue rains and must trek to find food and water. While the Amazon has the opposite problem, too much water, with the rainforest wildlife having to adapt to a submerged forest.

programme.title: Manawatāwhi/ Three Kings islands
programme.desc: Where the South Pacific Ocean meets the Tasman Sea, thirteen islands stretch across the blue desert as if a giant has tossed rocks from the sky above, Manawatāwhi/ The Three Kings Islands. Ancient, wild, and remote, this ocean junction bewitches many who visit. Upwellings of cold nutrient rich water support a spectacle of marine life, while a small pod of Bottlenose Dolphins has given up their nomadic ways to make this place their home.

programme.title: Meet the Pigs
programme.desc: What first comes to mind when you think of pigs? Mud wallows and pink, curly tails? Perhaps lucky symbols and money banks, or maybe just bacon sandwiches? Whatever it is, you're probably underestimating the world's amazing collection of pigs. Today they might be one of our favourite farm animals, but if we visit their cousins in the wild we start to reveal the unique and wonderful world of the pig.

programme.title: The Killer Coast
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Mountains of Extreme
programme.desc: This episode follows the animals of Argentina, living life at the mercy of the Andean mountains. These peaks dictate a hard existence for every living creature from their summits to the very edge of the Patagonian steppe, forcing even the cutest resident to turn carnivore... Predators stalk the foothills and creepy crawlies lie low in the sandy steppe. Every animal here has a bloodthirsty drive to survive.

programme.title: Return to the Wild
programme.desc: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness. A new volunteer arrives in time to see the release, but will it end in disaster?

programme.title: Wolves - Power of the Pack
programme.desc: From arctic tundra to the great planes, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword. Though magnificent predators on their own, the feature that perhaps makes wolves so iconic is the pack. The close bonds, complex communication and sheer muscle of a team of wolves is almost unstoppable. And the pack's not just the day job, it's the cornerstone of family life for a wolf.

programme.title: Weird and Wonderful
programme.desc: This episode will introduce you to some of the Aquariums most weird and wonderful inhabitants. From upside-down Jellyfish to male Seahorses giving birth, these wacky residents make up the enchanting world that keeps guests coming to through the Aquarium doors! But other pressing issues keep the staff busy, from keeping the peace between man and seal, to preparing a new gigantic predator tank, there's not a minute to rest in the life of an Aquarist!

programme.title: Chiribiquete
programme.desc: Chiribiquete is an unknown world, hidden deep within Colombia's Amazon. Pre-historic towers, waterfalls and deep canyons lie surrounded by rivers, lakes and rainforests bursting with life. Scientists have only guessed at what else lies beneath this impenetrable pristine jungle - until now. Biologist Blanca Huertas from England's Natural History Museum, and Colombian-born nature photographer Francisco Forero, head deep into the heart of nowhere.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Few things make us shiver like the thought of falling prey to one of the world's great predators. With teeth, claws, stings and venom, they inflict death on their prey, and instil fear in us. But who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dan-gerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom, imagining close shaves with all the planet's most dangerous creatures.

programme.title: The Caribbean: The Wild Side of Paradise
programme.desc: Between the continents of North and South America is a tropical paradise: the Caribbean. This archipelago of over 7,000 islands and reefs lies within the crystal clear waters of the Caribbean Sea. From just a few metres wide, to hundreds of kilometres across, every island is different, and each has its own unique wildlife.

programme.title: British Garden: Life And Death On Your Lawn
programme.desc: The British back garden is a familiar setting, but underneath the peonies and petunias is a much wilder hidden world, a miniature Serengeti, with beauty and brutality in equal measure. In this 90-minute documentary Chris Packham and a team of wildlife experts spend an entire year exploring every inch of a series of interlinked back gardens in Welwyn Garden City. They want to answer a fundamental question: how much wildlife lives beyond our back doors?

programme.title: Trophy hunting - just killing or conservation?
programme.desc: Hannah Emde tries to illuminate the subject of trophy hunting from all sides. She talks to the Khwe chief, villagers and game guards in the Zambezi region. She meets a trophy hunter and follows the topic back to Germany, where she exchanges ideas with Izak Smit, the Chairperson of Desert Lions Human Relations Aid, Delhra in short.

programme.title: Galapagos: Darwin's Eden
programme.desc: Situated 1,000km west of Ecuador in South America, the Galapagos archipelago contains 13 main islands and a hundred or so smaller rocks and reefs. The region's wilderness is so pristine and rich in life it altered our entire view of the natural world. It was the Galapagos islands' finches and mockingbirds that proved key to Darwin's theory of evolution.

programme.title: The Fragile Islands/Andaman
programme.desc: What seems calm and tranquil may not necessarily be so. Under the tranquility there maybe a vibrant dynamic world and above water there maybe dangers which are lurking at very corner. Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park is one such. In the Andaman Islands a group of 15 islands make up this fragile eco system. Coral, is one of the most productive and endangered wild fauna in the shallow coastal waters.

programme.title: Rhino Rescue Cote d'Ivoire
programme.desc: In the heart of the Ivory Coast a small rural village has a very special resident. The last white rhino in the country sleeps on the village outskirts and feeds on the villagers' crops. He's survived a gunshot to the shoulder and a decade of civil war, and he's something of a celebrity here. But all is not well. The rhino has killed the chief of the village, and it's time for him to go.

programme.title: Arctic
programme.desc: The Arctic is alive with a fascinating assortment of wildlife and species that are unique to this Polar environment. Most of are rarely or never seen outside the Arctic Circle. They live and thrive in a hostile environment of ice, polar desert, wind-swept open tundra, ancient glacial formations, sub zero sea temperatures and an incredible variety of geographical topo-graphy from open plain and valleys to mountainous peaks and deep water fiords.

programme.title: American Praire
programme.desc: Prairies are a temperate grassland. Vast great plains, extremely hot in summer and cold in winter. Moderate rainfall, and a composition of grasses, herbs and shrubs, rather than trees characterise these plains. Most of North America was a vast prairie before European settlement and agriculture radically altered the environment.

programme.title: Jungle of Asia
programme.desc: Some of the most beautiful rainforest, jungle landscape and wildlife are in Asia. The rainforests of Asia stretch from India and Burma in the west to Malaysia and the islands of Java and Borneo in the east. The Great teak forests and Jungles in Asia have long been under threat from intensive logging and industrial farming of cash crops. Slash and burn agriculture has also taken a heavy toll on the eco-structure and environment. Bangladesh has the largest mangrove forests in the world.

programme.title: Open Ocean
programme.desc: It might look uniform from the air, as we fly over it, but the oceans are deep and varied. The underwater landscape is made up of continental shelves, volcanoes, mountains, valleys, trenches and large, flat plains similar to the landscape on land only on a much larger scale. Ocean habitats come in all forms. Under water creatures make homes wherever survival is assured.

programme.title: The Marine Ecosystem
programme.desc: Costa Rica is home to some of the richest marine ecosystems in the world; biologists and conservationists have undertaken a race against time to better understand and protect marine ecosystems.

programme.title: Return of the Shan/Hemis
programme.desc: Snow Leopard is the one of the most elusive big cats in the world. This episode details how the wildlife guards and the wildlife department has set up conservation and scientific plans to protect and indeed to enumerate and increase it's population. For the first time we see the radio collaring operations of the big cats and also the very rare Lynx. The episode also shows how the guards live and work in these tough terrains sometimes even by putting their lives in danger.

programme.title: Wild Wolverine
programme.desc: To many the wolverine is the stuff of movie superheroes. To others they are a creature of myth and legend. They look like a weird hybrid between wolf, bear and skunk and are some of the toughest, strongest and most aggressive animals around. In the sub-arctic forests of Siberia survival is an expert skill. The creatures of the far north strike a delicate balance and must show ingenuity and cunning if they are to survive.

programme.title: Fight for Territory
programme.desc: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for!

programme.title: July
programme.desc: As schools break up for summer and kids can play in meadows amid poppies and singing sky larks, wildlife around the world has very different stories to tell. Lemmings are going crazy. On the Arctic tundra, the ground's frozen for most of the year, now they need to make the most of the time of plenty. But the giving summer heat is too much in southern Spain, where pools are drying out leaving fish high and dry, a feast for herons.

programme.title: Icy Coast
programme.desc: Cold coasts create challenging landscapes for all wildlife. It's hard to believe that these freezing oceans can be bringers of life. In fact, cold water holds onto oxygen much better than warm, encouraging aquatic activity. Great eagles hunt abundant marine life in the bleak northern hemisphere whilst cold water corals thrive off the nutrient rich currents passing through their reefs, and massive elephant seals fight for territory off the coast of Australia.

programme.title: Beaver Lumberjacks
programme.desc: Anchorage has a rather unique resident who is renowned as nature's lumberjack and North Americas largest rodent, the beaver. With their powerful teeth the trees they fell can be huge and their dams can be so enormous they can be seen from space. But since humans arrived here, many beavers have been forced to live in an urban jungle! And as the Wild City of Anchorage expands, that means more people, more cars, and the biggest risk to the beavers, dogs!

programme.title: Artic Refuge
programme.desc: Alaska one of the last true wildernesses on earth. With 600 square miles of pristine habitat this state is home to an abundance of wildlife. Herds of caribou roam the plains, wolves stalk in the forest and the brown bears are the kings of the rivers. But you don't always have to head to the wild to come face to face with an animal. In the city of Anchorage the wildlife is a lot closer than you think, because a city with so much green space means everywhere is fair game for its wild neighbours.

programme.title: Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale
programme.desc: Under a blanket of stars on an African night, in the serene grasslands of Botswana's Okavango Delta, something rarely witnessed by humankind is about to happen: the much-anticipated birth of a baby elephant. An emotional life-or-death drama that champions the struggle of Africa's native elephant population, Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale tells the urgent story of an international crisis.

programme.title: Coasts - Life's a Beach
programme.desc: To us the beach is one giant playground, but for wildlife it's a place to live, to find food and to raise their young. Amongst the fish and chips, sandcastles and donkey rides it's easy to forget that beaches are vital habitats, home to a myriad of animals. Whether grey seals are duelling for a mate and raising their young, or black bears and tigers are scouring the coastline for a tasty snack, animals have been using the beach for millennia.

programme.title: Mammal Takeover
programme.desc: With the dinosaurs' passing, a land of opportunity was laid bare for the little mammals that had scampered about their feet.

programme.title: Mountains - Gateways to Heaven
programme.desc: Mountains define our most spectacular landscapes. As they climb the changing altitude results in a mosaic of dramatic habitats, teaming with incredible wildlife. They're found on every continent on Earth, literally from pole to pole, covering 22% of the planet's surface. An incredibly important part of our ecosystem, a quarter of terrestrial animal and plant species, live in mountains and they house an incredible 85% of all amphibians, mammals and birds.

programme.title: Incredible Journeys
programme.desc: Whether by wing, fin or hoof, epic migrations are among nature's most awe-inspiring events. Animals undertake these arduous journeys, for many reasons: to find a mate, to give birth, or to move to new feeding grounds. And danger lurks at every turn. In this episode we discover the lengths they go to in order to survive.

programme.title: Turtle Tales
programme.desc: Ever wondered how to look after dozens of tiny turtles? This episode of An Aquatic Life will show you just that! Meet the turtle team and their amazing ambassadors, Bob, Sandy and the monstrous loggerhead, Yoshi! The collections team is running at half capacity while most of the team members collect Ragged-Toothed Sharks in East London for the upcoming predator exhibit... But with a colossal storm en route to the city of Cape Town, will it all be ready for their arrival?

programme.title: Meet the Meerkats
programme.desc: Meerkats live in close families and rely on their companions to watch their backs. In their vast and unforgiving home of the Namib desert, only together can they defeat the odds stacked against them. One young female is forced from her group, overcoming a brutal attack from the alpha pair and fearing for her life. Cast out and left to fend for herself, she has no choice but to roam the desert and find a way to live.

programme.title: Rise of the Giants
programme.desc: In the great story of life, reptiles were one of the first major players. For 180 million years they ruled the land, seas and skies - this was the rise of the giants.

programme.title: March
programme.desc: As northern forests become carpeted by bluebells and wood anemones, and damp corners become singles bars for frogs and a toads, hailing the first hint of spring sun, South Africa needs a break from the heat, fire season is in full swing, threatening the fynbos and the extraordinary animals living in them. Ground squirrels get inventive to find shade. Gray whales migrate up the Californian coast, passing colonies of sea otters. March is a month of change

programme.title: The Inner Workings
programme.desc: Join us as we delve into the inner workings of the Two Oceans Aquarium and meet the team who keep the machine running! Learn how they cater for hundreds of different dietary requirements, how they keep up with the demand of life-giving water and meet the new arrivals to the aquarium; from the six-legged spider crabs of Japan, to the tiny turtles in need of rehabilitation. We'll move behind the glass to reveal the secrets of Africa's premier Aquarium!

programme.title: Of elephant & trackers
programme.desc: Hannah Emde meets one of Africa's most experienced elephant trackers: Hendrick Munembome, the Director of Elephant Human Relations Aid (EHRA). The struggle for water often makes elephants and humans rivals in Namibia. Therefore, EHRA builds water wells for the elephants with volunteers from all over the world, far away from the villages. Hannah helps dig a ditch for a pipeline, then heads up the dry Ugab riverbed in search of the endangered Mama Afrika' herd.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: The culture of Japan is incredible. But there are also more than 130 mammals and 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands.

programme.title: American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt
programme.desc: Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular "American Ninja" franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

programme.title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents' brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

programme.title: RoboCop (2014)
programme.desc: When Alex Murphy is critically injured, OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.

programme.title: Hercules (2014)
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

programme.title: Walking Tall (2004)
programme.desc: When it comes to laying down the law, one man can make a difference! Action superstar Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson takes no prisoners as he fights for justice and crushes corruption in this story of one man who takes a stand and takes back his town!

programme.title: Walking Tall: The Payback
programme.desc: In this action-packed sequel, Kevin Sorbo discovers the quiet town he grew up in is now overrun by a violent gang. And it's up to him to take it back!

programme.title: Firewalker
programme.desc: Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

programme.title: Breaker! Breaker!
programme.desc: Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.

programme.title: The Octagon
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: Enter The Ninja
programme.desc: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

programme.title: Revenge Of The Ninja
programme.desc: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Anti-Trust
programme.desc: In this sizzling, fast-paced thriller, computer whiz Milo Hoffman (Ryan Phillippe) lands his dream job at a major computer company, only to learn that the C.E.O. (Tim Robbins) may employ some very unorthodox -- and very deadly --business practices.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Two convicts run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife.

programme.title: Ronin
programme.desc: Action-packed spy thriller about mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.

programme.title: Thief
programme.desc: Michael Mann ("Manhunter") directs this stylish, action-packed drama that stars James Caan ("Misery") as a master safe cracker who is planning his last heist for the sake of a woman, Tuesday Weld ("Who'll Stop The Rain?"), and a new life.

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.

programme.title: Kalifornia
programme.desc: A couple (David Duchovny, Michelle Forbes) sets out on a cross-country trip to research a book about serial killers and, along the way, pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend (Brad Pitt, Juliette Lewis) who take them on a ride they'll never forget.

programme.title: 10 To Midnight
programme.desc: Charles Bronson is Leo Kessler, a cynical cop on the trail of Warren Stacy (Gene Davis), a homicidal maniac. When the legal system sets Stacy free, Kessler has one option: to hunt down Stacy on his own before the crazed killer can strike again!

programme.title: Assassination
programme.desc: Hard-hitting action, cross-country adventure and a government conspiracy that goes all the way to the top highlight this pulse-pounding political thriller in which Charles Bronson must protect the First Lady (Jill Ireland) from ruthless assassins.

programme.title: Rage Of Honor
programme.desc: When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.

programme.title: Pray For Death
programme.desc: A vicious gang forces Akira to shed his quiet persona and reveal his other identity...that of a skilled Ninja!

programme.title: Warriors Of Virtue

programme.title: Hello and Farewell - Part 2

programme.title: The Squeaky Wheel

programme.desc: Mark has fallen in love with an attractive woman, but Jonathan receives news about her from higher up.

programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark are on hand when a dying woman attempts a reconciliation with her estranged father.

programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark meet a child star whose fame is spoiling her rotten, destroying her family and taking away her childhood.

programme.desc: Jonathan encourages residents in a neighborhood to unite against a cold-hearted developer.

programme.desc: Revisit some of Mike's toughest jobs and see how he made scary situations right.

programme.title: Flood Suckers
programme.desc: A woman's basement is flooded with sewage water after a downpour.

programme.title: Great Wall of Crap
programme.desc: Mike Holmes takes over after Elaine and Bert's contractor gives up on repairing their retaining wall and goes home.

programme.title: Tiles & Tribulations
programme.desc: After the kitchen floor begins to bow, a couple has the contractor install a ceramic tile floor.

programme.title: Troubled Waters
programme.desc: Learning how a home inspection dampened Kim and Daniel's plan to buy a cozy house where their two girls could grow up; Mike takes a thorough look and finds the source of all this humidity, then creates a dry, safe haven for the family.

programme.title: No More Down and Out
programme.desc: A rotten roof discovered accidentally by a satellite dish installer; Mike ponders ways to stretch Keith and Caitlin's repair budget as the team work to fill the gaps left in their previous inspection report.

programme.title: Heated Issues
programme.desc: Todd and Duane, excited about buying their first house together, tackle their home inspector's suggestions with enthusiasm until then they discover something that could ruin everything.

programme.title: A Hole Lot of History
programme.desc: Mike and crew make an emergency house call to Fred and Sara's diminutive, historical two-storey; gaping holes in their seemingly solid home inspection have led to a high-stakes repair mission for Damon and the construction team.

programme.title: A Hole Lot of History
programme.desc: Returning to Fred and Sara's petite historical home, where inspection misses have launched a rescue mission; Damon and the crew are tested by leaks, mold, foundation holes, dangerous fireplaces, shocking electrical and a plumbing disaster.

programme.title: Mike's Ultimate Garage
programme.desc: Contractor, Mike Holmes has a vision for the ultimate garage and hands over the white helmet to his son Mike Jr. to run the job site.

programme.title: Mike's Ultimate Garage
programme.desc: The garage is well under way.

programme.title: A Bold Move
programme.desc: When Mike helps his son, MJ, renovate his tiny bungalow, MJ's modest renovation plans are turned upside down by his father's ambitious plans to gut the house and add a second story.

programme.title: Decisions, Decisions
programme.desc: Construction goes smoothly while Mike and MJ work side by side; when Mike is forced to leave the job site, MJ makes some important structural decisions without his father.

programme.title: Moving Up in the World
programme.desc: Cracks in the foundation put a dent in MJ's hot tub dreams; while the second floor walls go up, the house is exposed, and MJ decides not to shield the house before a heavy rain, dampening both Mike's mood and the wood beneath his feet.

programme.title: Distractions and Disagreements
programme.desc: Tensions run high as Mike and MJ engage in disagreements; MJ's nerves are frayed as he prepares to ask Lisa an important question while on a getaway; Mike takes over the job site, with some frustrating consequences for MJ.

programme.title: Trouble at the Finish
programme.desc: MJ runs into financial setbacks, tiling troubles and door debates with his father; as tensions mount, MJ must come to a decision that has repercussions for the completion of his home.

programme.title: Holmes Sweet Home
programme.desc: Emotions are high as MJ delivers his custom table to an unsuspecting friend; everyone pitches in for the final push to complete the house before the big reveal.

programme.desc: The Viet Cong's secret methods to foil America's attempts to seal off South Vietnam.

programme.title: Japan: The Invasion That Never Was
programme.desc: Authors Norman Polmar and Tom Allen comment on new revelations about the planned U.S. invasion of Japan.

programme.title: Sitzkrieg: The Phony War
programme.desc: Hitler's lightning strike in Poland soon gave way to a strange eight month waiting game.

programme.desc: How did the Nazi's hide their atrocities and what did the Allies know as the "final solution" was implemented across Europe?
