programme.desc: The second stage of the SCL heads to the FIBO convention, Cologne. The leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health hosts.

programme.title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 3, Lithuania - Log lift World championship
programme.desc: For the third stage of SCL world series 2016, the athletes compete in Kaunas for the SCL Log Lift World Championships.

programme.title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 4, Holland
programme.desc: Stage four is an epic competition and a few surprises. With 14 strongmen from all over the world, one newcomer left quite an impression.

programme.title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 5, Latvia
programme.desc: This year Lauri Nami joins the starting list, back after last year's injury in Romania

programme.title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 6, Serbia
programme.desc: The SCL train stopped in Zlatibor for the stage 6 of the MLO SCL. 11 compete for the title in the home country of legendary Ervin Katona.

programme.title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 7, Bulgaria
programme.desc: Bulgaria hosts the next stage of the SCL. Current leader in the World Series is Matjaz Belsak, youngest compet

programme.title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 8, England
programme.desc: The competitors battle it out in the special event, the Atlas Steel Stone. This stone is made completely from iron and cannot be touched with any support.

programme.title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 9, Finland
programme.desc: This stage sees the strongmen visit Vaasa, Finland. Residents here are familiar with the competition because some of the SCL icons are from their country.

programme.title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 10, Finland - World championship under 105 kilograms
programme.desc: 38 athletes compete in the under 90kg and under 105kg SCL World Championships. From each weight class, the top 12 qualify for the finals.

programme.title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 11, Romania Part 1
programme.desc: A two day, seven event battle with lots of spectators.

programme.title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 12, Romania Part 2
programme.desc: Alex Moonen is leading. Part two of the competition in Romania showcases a new challenge - Hercules Hold.

programme.title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 13, Curacao
programme.desc: In this stage in Curacao no one wants to lose the chance to fight for one kilo gold in World grand finals in Dubai.

programme.title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 14, Portugal
programme.desc: The last chance to qualify for the World Grand Finale. Zageris and Belsak fight for the better position for th

programme.title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 15, Dubai World grand finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: We reach Dubai where we will crown the new champion for SCL 2016. This is part one of the world finals.

programme.title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 16, Dubai World grand finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 1, Norway
programme.desc: We are in Norway for the start of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League and have a beautiful snowy backdrop

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 2, Germany
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 3, Lithuania
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 4, Holland
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous "Black Cross". The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 5, Serbia
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 6, Canada (Part 1)
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true 'heavyweight'. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World's Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 7, Canada (Part 2)
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer's Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow 'Leader Shirt'?

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 8, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 9, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven't given up yet.

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 10, Finland Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 11, Romania
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 12, Curacao
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let's see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 13, Jordan
programme.desc: Ten of the world's strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan's first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World's Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 14, Greece
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season's finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan's Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 15, Mexico World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale and anything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the b

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 16, Mexico World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances - and even world records!

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 1, Norway - World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We'll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 2, Germany - FIBO Power
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It's a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 3, Abu Dhabi
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) & Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O'Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 4, Holland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Her

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 5, Holland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Part 2 in Holland brings world records, injuries, and tight battle on disciplines like Viking Press, Yoke Race

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 6, Finland
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World - Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic - Aivars Smaukstelis

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 7, Serbia
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on "Air spa" for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 8, Finland - U105 (Part 1)
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 9, Finland - U105 (Part 2)
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 10, Romania (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman C

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 11, Romania (Part 2)
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events - Dead lift, Loading and Front hold - and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 12, Curacao (Part 1)
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman event

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 13, Curacao (Part 2)
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O'Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 14, Road to Mexico
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 15, Mexico - World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing t

programme.title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 16, Mexico - World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 1, World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: SCL S6 Ep2 FIBO Power
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It's a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 3, Turkey
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Mercenary
programme.desc: Ragnar and Lagertha's fleets depart Kattegat once more for Wessex and this time they bring a group to colonize there. King Ecbert hosts the Norsemen and proposes a deal. Despite the misgivings of some of the other leaders, Ragnar leads his forces into battle once more, but this time as allies of Wessex.

programme.title: The Wanderer
programme.desc: Lagertha and Athelstan help to establish the Viking settlement in Wessex. Harbard, a mysterious wanderer, arrives in Kattegat, realizing the forewarned dreams of Aslaug, Siggy and Helga.

programme.title: Warrior's Fate
programme.desc: King Ecbert visits the developing Viking settlement as the first harvest is sown and rebuffs criticism from his leading nobles. The Wessex/Viking forces charge into battle with Mercia. In Kattegat, Harbard arrives in to the Great Hall and his mysterious aura fascinates Aslaug and Helga but Siggy remains suspicious. There are strange and tragic happenings in Kattegat and Siggy suspects Harbard is the cause.

programme.title: Scarred
programme.desc: The victorious Wessex/Viking forces return to Wessex but there is rancour in the Viking camp - Floki is angry over the alliance with Ecbert and is resentful the influence that he feels Athelstan has over Ragnar. Princess Kwenthrith makes some calculating political moves following the battle at the Hill of the Ash in Mercia. Visitors from the past arrive in Hederby, at Kalf's invitation.

programme.title: The Usurper
programme.desc: The fleet returns to Kattegat to find tragic circumstances await. Lagertha learns that her Earldom has been usurped and convinces Ragnar to travel to Hederby with her in an effort to reclaim her title. Ragnar causes great surprise when he announces the next raid. The Seer has interesting prophecies for Rollo.

programme.title: Born Again
programme.desc: Preparations for the Paris raid pick up pace, and Rollo ponders the Seer's prophecy about his destiny. Ragnar is informed of Aethelwulf's massacre at the settlement in Wessex, and Kalf arrives in Kattegat with some new allies and some familiar faces. Porunn and Judith both deliver children; but with new life there is also death.

programme.title: Paris
programme.desc: The appearance of the Viking fleet causes panic among the population of Paris. The defense of Paris is in the hands of its Commander, Count Odo, who is confident that the city is prepared for the attack. The Emperor Charles, urged by his daughter Gisla, announces in Court he will remain in the city. The Vikings establish camp downriver from the city and plan their attack.

programme.title: To The Gates!
programme.desc: The Viking army embarks and Paris goes into lockdown as the army prepares the defense, overseen by Count Odo. The Vikings are determined to make it through the gates of Paris and conquer the city; they will stop at nothing to succeed.

programme.title: Breaking Point
programme.desc: The Vikings go all out for a second assault on Paris. Recognizing the desperate state of affairs for his city, Emperor Charles must make a difficult decision. In Wessex, Judith is compelled to make a difficult decision of her own.

programme.title: The Dead
programme.desc: Rollo's destiny is recognized and Bjorn steps up as a leader. With one last chance to take Paris, Ragnar and his Vikings troops take a daring chance.

programme.title: Season 10 Episode 4
programme.desc: Jon investigates hitting a motorway crash barrier. Kevin Petersen drives the Lamborghini Gallardo Spyder.

programme.title: Season 10 Episode 5
programme.desc: Tiff drives Suzuki's Swift Sport; Tom drives the Aussie supercar Vauxhall Monaro; Vicki drives a racing truck.

programme.title: Season 10 Episode 6
programme.desc: Vicki drives the one-off supercharged Nissan Murano GTC; Jonny challenges the world's biggest lawnmower.

programme.title: Season 10 Episode 7
programme.desc: Jason drives the Subaru Litchfield Type 25. Tiff drives the Ferrari 599 on the world's most treacherous roads.

programme.title: Season 10 Episode 8
programme.desc: Tom drives Volvo's new coupe the C30; Tiff tests if a green supercar really can be fun in Lotus' Exige 265E.

programme.title: Season 10 Episode 9
programme.desc: Vicki has a race against some of the biggest names in bike racing; Tom tests the new Land Rover Freelander.

programme.title: Season 10 Episode 10
programme.desc: Tom's been testing the Mazda's new MX5 Roadster Coupe and Vicki has been thrashing Porsche's 911 GT3.

programme.title: Season 10 Episode 11

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: Drag Me to Hell
programme.desc: Christine Brown has a loving boyfriend and a good job at a Los Angeles bank. Her heavenly life becomes hellish when, in an effort to impress her boss, she denies an old woman's request for an extension on her home loan. In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. Christine seeks a psychic's help to break the curse, but the price to save her soul may be more than she can pay.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: Hard Target 2
programme.desc: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: The Legend of Louis Mueller's Dino Beef Ribs
programme.desc: Pat visits his close friend Wayne Mueller, third-generation pitmaster of Louis Mueller's BBQ, to learn the ins and outs of his famous dino beef ribs.

programme.title: Catching Gulf Coast Redfish and Blue Crabs
programme.desc: Pat visits Houston to go Gulf Bay fishing with chef Chris Shepherd, hoping to catch some redfish and gather a side of blue crabs.

programme.title: Hickory Smoked Virginia Ham & Mint Juleps
programme.desc: Pat Martin gets a history lesson on the origin of American barbecue from "The Professor" Tuffy Stone.

programme.title: Bluefin Tuna Collars with Chili Pickle Relish
programme.desc: Pat Martin visits chef Adam Perry Lang in Los Angeles, where the pair cooks a prized catch castoff cut - Bluefin Tuna collars.

programme.title: Hunting for Quail in Charleston

programme.desc: Tacos are the way to Chef Dale's heart, and he's grilling up a sweet and smoky lemongrass and guajillo pork with pineapple, served with coconut and cotija cheese corn and an avocado jicama salad.

programme.title: Restaurant-Style Whole Roast Fish
programme.desc: Chef Dale grills to impress with restaurant quality meal of whole roasted fish, coconut milk grits, and snow pea, watermelon and tamarind salad.

programme.title: Vegetables, but Delicious
programme.desc: Chef Dale crafts a family style platter of trumpet mushrooms, eggplant marinated in spicy ssam jang, and charred yellow squash served with a green goddess dressing.

programme.title: Sunday Vietnamese Brisket with Noodles
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde shows us how he does Sunday up right as he grills up some Vietnamese Brisket with Rice Noodles, Crispy Swordfish Summer Rolls, and tops it all off with some tasty Soju Floats. Hey, it's Sunday somewhere, right?

programme.title: Beer Brats & BBQ Ribs
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde grills up summer favorites perfect for any backyard BBQ. Cheddar beer brats in a pretzel bun, BBQ lamb ribs with Chinese mustard sauce, watermelon lime soju punch, & warm donuts with grilled strawberries & whipped cream for dessert.

programme.title: The Perfection of Pork
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings the heat when it comes to making perfect pork dishes including a root beer glazed pork banh mi, chorizo fried rice, Filipino sausage stuffed long hot peppers, and round it all out with a spicy grilled pineapple sundae.

programme.title: Tempting Tasty Tacos
programme.desc: It's always taco night at Chef Dale's house! He turns up the heat with grilled salmon tacos with salsa verde & cauliflower escabeche, duck al pastor tacos with habanero pineapple salsa, & a smoky mushroom queso taco with truffle mole negro.

programme.title: Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls.

programme.title: Grilled Loco Moco and Huli Huli Chicken
programme.desc: The options are plentiful when Chef Dale smothers grilled Loco Moco with a mushroom gravy, salty and sweet Huli Huli Chicken with charred pineapple, and healthy scoops of Tuna Water Chestnut poke or mac salad.

programme.title: World of Burgers!
programme.desc: It's burger day! Chef Dale tackles three classics with a full flavor spin. Game changing Pho Burgers with bone marrow, toasted milk bread Ahi Tuna patty melts, and Chori Pan Burgers with a fried egg and shrimp chips.

programme.title: Street Eats off the Grill
programme.desc: Japan, Thailand, Turkey, and Mexico street foods inspire Dale to grill with dynamically preparing Chili-Cuman Lamb Mushroom sticks, Grilled pork and shrimp shumai, and scallion pancakes with brown butter labneh.

programme.title: Sizzlin' Summer Fruits
programme.desc: Summer seasonal fruit pampers your taste buds. Chef Dale grills blistered grapes with ham wrapped trout, peaches with smoked pork chops, watermelon with halloumi, and char-grilled cherries with chocolate mousse.

programme.title: Heavenly Hibachi Bites
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde tries his hand at hibachi by making supreme fried rice with shrimp, chicken, and bacon, pretzel pork dumplings, mushroom noodles, a filet of beef with the famous onion volcano, and washes it down with a melon & mint sake slushy.

programme.title: Family-Friendly BBQ
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde creates a tasty menu that kids & parents alike will love! Apple pancakes with coconut brown butter syrup, grilled cheese & tomato soup, cheesy chicken parm, and a sticky s'mores dessert round out the full day of deliciousness.

programme.title: Pizzapalooza
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde grills a Chicago-style pie, pepperoni pizza pocket, chicken wings, and a zesty grilled Caesar.

programme.title: The Art of Open Fire Cooking
programme.desc: Chef Dale goes back to the roots of cooking, building a grill over an open fire to serve up a variety of dishes, including whole smoked chicken and fish, roasted cauliflower, a sweet and tangy grilled pineapple s'more dessert.

programme.title: Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.

programme.title: Carne Adovada
programme.desc: Carne Adovada.

programme.title: A Whole Roasted Hog
programme.desc: For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.

programme.title: Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

programme.title: Braised Pigeon with Homemade Herb Gnocchi
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening.

programme.title: Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions
programme.desc: Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.

programme.title: Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.

programme.title: Venison Satay & Classic Venison Wellington
programme.desc: Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

programme.title: Cajun-Style Grilled Wild Turkey & Creamy Tetrazzini
programme.desc: Andrew gives holiday turkey the Wild Game Kitchen treatment with grilled turkey tetrazzini and a butter basted Cajun-spiced whole bird roasted over crawfish, andouille and cornbread stuffing.

programme.title: Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.

programme.title: Hawaiian Plate Lunch
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.

programme.title: The Essence of Grill Culture
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

programme.title: Back to Our Caveman Roots
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

programme.title: Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

programme.title: Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

programme.title: Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread
programme.desc: Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

programme.title: Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.

programme.title: Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.

programme.title: Crispy Duck Noodle Soup
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.

programme.title: Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables
programme.desc: Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.

programme.title: Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

programme.title: The King of Open-Fire Paella
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

programme.title: Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

programme.title: Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.

programme.title: Wild Seafood Risotto
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

programme.title: Holy Mackerel!
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

programme.title: Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

programme.title: Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.

programme.title: Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

programme.title: Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

programme.title: Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

programme.title: Easy Pantry Staple Fish Cakes
programme.desc: Jamie shares a simple salmon dish perfect for a midweek meal, and some no-fuss fish cakes made from tins. He cooks a lamb Madras traybake, as well as a no-cook pasta sauce, and crowns it all off with a hot and crispy ice cream parcel!

programme.title: Smash Burger and Creamy Chicken with Mushrooms
programme.desc: Jamie cooks a midweek meal of speedy sweet pea chicken, a juicy Smash burger and a chicken and mushroom rice traybake. He batch-cooks his seven-veg sauce, followed by a spicy fish soup. And finishes off with a perfect pudding of tinned fruit granita.

programme.title: Jarred Pepper Pasta and Sheet Pan Brisket
programme.desc: Jamie cooks a speedy jarred-pepper pasta, crispy chicken in baked-bread sauce, and a beef brisket tray bake - all prepped in minutes. He makes shelf-raid spiced haricot beans, and rounds it all off with a fast and simple strawberry & balsamic tart.

programme.title: Creamy Chicken Pot Pie and Chocolate Tiramisu
programme.desc: Jamie cooks a midweek traybake of roast veg and Camembert. He turns poached chicken into a creamy chicken & chive pie, serves up his easy green chilli salsa under sizzling butterflied prawns, and finishes it all off with decadent chocolate tiramisù.

programme.title: Traditional Greek Cuisine
programme.desc: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

programme.title: Inspirational Spanish Tapas
programme.desc: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

programme.title: Making Couscous in Tunisia
programme.desc: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

programme.title: Traditional Greek Cuisine
programme.desc: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

programme.title: Stunning Seafood of Marseille
programme.desc: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

programme.desc: Frankie skips the stress and roasts a juicy spatchcocked turkey, then goes big on sides-cardamom rolls, Sweet & Savory Dauphinoise Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts with Bacon Jam, and a bright Citrus Salad with smoked salt.

programme.title: La unión hace la fuerza
programme.desc: Una mujer que se hace pasar por trabajadora social se lleva a una niña a una casa hogar después de que sus padres fueran encarcelados por robar. La señora planea vender a la niña a una pareja que no puede tener hijos.

programme.title: Cuando el tecolote canta
programme.desc: Refugio insiste en hacerle creer a Ángel que la vida de uno de sus seres queridos corre peligro, después de escuchar al tecolote cantar. Más tarde, El señor sufre un accidente automovilístico y trata de llegar a su casa.

programme.title: Dime de que presumes y te diré de que careces
programme.desc: Diana es una chica que se lastima a sí misma para llamar la atención y sentir un alivio ante los problemas que existen en su casa. Diana se enamora de Adrián, un nuevo compañero de la escuela, pero provoca los celos de Rebeca, su mejor amiga.

programme.title: En casa del ladrón
programme.desc: Una joven está obsesionada con la muerte de su padre, cree que él quiere comunicarse con ella para darle un mensaje. La joven cree que el mejor amigo de su papá y su mamá son amantes, y que ellos tuvieron que ver con la muerte de su padre.

programme.title: Cara de beato
programme.desc: Un joven debe dinero de drogas y decide irse a vivir con sus tíos a otra ciudad para escapar, pero lo siguen para cobrarle todo el dinero que debe. El joven se roba la tarjeta de su tía y saca el dinero, pero el cobrador se lo quita todo.

programme.title: A cada uno le toca escoger
programme.desc: Un joven se va de su casa porque su padrastro lo maltrataba, su abuela se pasa buscándolo, pero él no quiere regresar con su familia y conoce a una mujer que lo utiliza para robar al lado de otros niños de la calle.

programme.title: Quien mucho amenaza
programme.desc: Una joven tiene que enfrentar el intento de suicidio de su madre provocado por su alcoholismo y por el desamor de su exmarido. La joven trata de complacer a su madre en todo para que no sufra más.

programme.title: El Hombre es Fuego, La Mujer Estopa
programme.desc: Un sacerdote se quita su hábito porque tiene mucho calor, un joven le ofrece bolearle los zapatos, pero es una trampa para asaltarlo, lo golpea y se desmaya. El sacerdote se despierta y no recuerda nada.

programme.title: Nada en exceso
programme.desc: Un hombre que se rehúsa a dejar de comer en exceso sufre un desmayo por comer mucha grasa. A pesar de que su esposa le pide que coma sanamente, su madre lo defiende. El hombre decide ir al nutriólogo para llevar una vida más saludable.

programme.title: Nadie sabe lo que tiene
programme.desc: Un joven se aprovecha de su novia porque ella está muy enamorada de él. Ella le hace todos sus trabajos de la escuela, mientras él la engaña con otras chicas de la universidad.

programme.title: Al que Dios no le da hijos
programme.desc: Un hombre se dedica a seducir mujeres al por mayor sin ninguna clase de remordimiento; sin embargo, pierde la vida en un accidente. Al morir, su hermano Víctor quien jamás pensó en tener hijos decide hacerse cargo de sus sobrinas.

programme.title: Nadie Escarmienta en Cabeza Ajena
programme.desc: Una joven trabaja en una clínica donde hacen cirugías plásticas y se enamora del médico, pero cree que él no se fijará en ella por no ser delgada y comienza a dejar de comer. Luego reacciona al ver que su amiga fallece por padecer anorexia.

programme.title: No dejes para mañana
programme.desc: Un niño se orina en sus pantalones y sus padres tienen que cambiarlo de escuela. El niño descubre que el compañero de clase que lo hostiga con saña brutal también padece de enuresis.

programme.title: Del agua mansa
programme.desc: Una joven se obsesiona con su profesor y trata de tener una relación con él, pero él la rechaza. La chica hace unas pruebas falsas para que todos crean que él trató de seducirla.

programme.desc: Un joven comienza a salir con un chico, pero su hermano y su exnovio se preocupan porque piensan que es un asesino serial que ha estado matando mujeres en su colonia.

programme.title: El que por gusto es buey
programme.desc: Mario busca integrarse al grupo de un chico que se dedica a robar cosas personales a sus compañeros de la escuela y a los profesores. Un día una joven acusa a otra chica de haber robado su celular. Mario defiende a la chica, pero esta se molesta.

programme.title: Al mal tiempo buena cara
programme.desc: Desde que era niño, Ricardo ha sufrido abuso sexual por parte de su padrino, quien también es su entrenador de fútbol. Al sentirse mal, le hacen unos análisis y le diagnostican cáncer testicular, por lo que busca justicia.

programme.title: Dile que es hermosa
programme.desc: Sebastián es un joven pintor que quiere conseguir a la mejor modelo para el concurso anual de retrato desnudo de la academia donde estudia. Sin embargo, se enamora de María Domínguez lo cual provoca una disputa con Gala.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Mariana decide tener relaciones sexuales sin protección con un compañero de la escuela. El padre de la joven tiene un accidente, Mariana quiere donar sangre, pero una enfermera le informa que es portadora del virus VIH.

programme.title: Ora veras huarache
programme.desc: Francisco es un chico muy peleonero e irresponsable que no estudia ni trabaja y está sobreprotegido y solapado por su madre. Un día, agrede a un conductor y sus escoltas lo siguen para darle un escarmiento. Sin querer, una tarde conoce a Francisca.

programme.title: Pa' decir mentiras y comer pescado hay que tener cuidado
programme.desc: Una niña muy grosera y malcriada se escapa de su casa para buscar a su papá después de enterarse de que su mamá le ha mentido. La niña conoce a un niño de la calle, comienza a valorar su vida en casa y le promete a su mamá que no le volverá a mentir.

programme.title: Siempre hay un roto para un descosido

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Mariana decide tener relaciones sexuales sin protección con un compañero de la escuela. El padre de la joven tiene un accidente, Mariana quiere donar sangre, pero una enfermera le informa que es portadora del virus VIH.

programme.title: Ora veras huarache
programme.desc: Francisco es un chico muy peleonero e irresponsable que no estudia ni trabaja y está sobreprotegido y solapado por su madre. Un día, agrede a un conductor y sus escoltas lo siguen para darle un escarmiento. Sin querer, una tarde conoce a Francisca.

programme.title: Pa' decir mentiras y comer pescado hay que tener cuidado
programme.desc: Una niña muy grosera y malcriada se escapa de su casa para buscar a su papá después de enterarse de que su mamá le ha mentido. La niña conoce a un niño de la calle, comienza a valorar su vida en casa y le promete a su mamá que no le volverá a mentir.

programme.title: Siempre hay un roto para un descosido
programme.desc: Un hombre quiere hacer negocios con un traficante de órganos para salvarle la vida a su mujer, el criminal la mata por venganza y el marido después de pensarlo mucho, el marido accede a donar los órganos de su mujer, salvando varias vidas.

programme.title: Ahora es cuando chile verde
programme.desc: Un joven comienza a salir con un chico, pero su hermano y su exnovio se preocupan porque piensan que es un asesino serial que ha estado matando mujeres en su colonia.

programme.title: El que por gusto es buey
programme.desc: Mario busca integrarse al grupo de un chico que se dedica a robar cosas personales a sus compañeros de la escuela y a los profesores. Un día una joven acusa a otra chica de haber robado su celular. Mario defiende a la chica, pero esta se molesta.

programme.title: Al mal tiempo buena cara
programme.desc: Desde que era niño, Ricardo ha sufrido abuso sexual por parte de su padrino, quien también es su entrenador de fútbol. Al sentirse mal, le hacen unos análisis y le diagnostican cáncer testicular, por lo que busca justicia.

programme.title: Por Nochebuena y Navidad
programme.desc: Un hombre decide dejar de ser boxeador por su familia, pero la enfermedad de su esposa le hace volver a pelear para pagar las medicinas necesarias.

programme.title: Amor de lejos
programme.desc: Una mujer se enamora de un hombre que vive en otro país. El hombre viaja a México para verla y ella le cuenta que tiene cáncer. El hombre decide mudarse a México para estar con ella a pesar de que los hijos no lo quieren.

programme.title: Hijo eres,padres serás
programme.desc: Alejandro es un adolescente que decide irse de casa por tener discusiones con su papá, tras la muerte de su madre. Una fuerte experiencia con un criminal, provoca que el joven reaccione y valore la vida de su padre logrando perdonarse.

programme.title: Hard Lessons
programme.desc: Richard returns to the hospital where he had an encounter with an entity; a husband and wife claim they were attacked in a hotel; Karlo takes on his most difficult case yet.

programme.title: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Karlo investigates a home where a woman claims to be attacked by a demonic creature; Alan and Anna investigate their old house; Jack investigates a claim of possession in Connecticut.

programme.title: The Black Monk
programme.desc: Richard and his team are reminded of a poltergeist haunting investigation in England; the Tolfs investigate a farmhouse in Indiana; a family asks Jack to get rid of an abusive spirit.

programme.title: Killer Spirit
programme.desc: Investigators face an entity known as Big Black in Indiana; Richard encounters a ghost in a home where a double murder-suicide took place; Karlo investigates an old school building.

programme.title: Haunted Asylum
programme.desc: Jay and Marie witness strange occurrences in their home after a cemetery investigation; the Tolfs investigate an old hospital in Michigan; Shannon and her team investigate a mansion in New York.

programme.title: Taken Over
programme.desc: The Tolfs investigate the site of one of the earliest recorded possessions; Karlo attempts to remove a spirit in a lakeside property; Eric investigates a former hospital.

programme.title: Ghost Cops
programme.desc: Jay and Marie investigate Arizona tunnels; the Tolfs investigate a former jail in Michigan; Shannon encounters spirits in a house.

programme.title: Where Evil Hides
programme.desc: A family seeks help after their daughter is physically attacked by a demonic entity; a team is surprised by the intensity of paranormal activity at a historic inn; an investigator encounters the spirit of a long-dead musician in her former home.

programme.title: Under Attack
programme.desc: Investigators are attacked by the ghost of a sadistic nurse at an abandoned hospital; a seemingly perfect home harbors an unwelcome guest; a father-daughter team is subjected to a torrent of abuse from the spirits of former inmates.

programme.title: Nasty Surprises
programme.desc: Things turn ugly inside a beauty salon for a veteran investigator and his team; a ghost hunter discovers that a remote island is alive with history; investigators unleash evil while investigating a historic home.

programme.title: Get It Out
programme.desc: When demon hunter Tim Wood is called to a former hospital in Texas where a poltergeist is believed to travel between the abandoned site and a nearby town, he and his team undertake a dangerous experiment to trap the entity on the grounds permanently.

programme.title: Dead on the Floor
programme.desc: Demon hunter Tim Wood is called to San Antonio to expel an evil presence from a historic mansion, but the case takes a dark turn when a strange doll found on the property reveals a spine-chilling premonition.

programme.title: Deliverance
programme.desc: The team members investigate demon hunter Tim Wood's erratic behavior; they wage an all-out battle for Tim's soul, which leads to a confrontation with the demon known as Zozo.

programme.title: Breaking and Entering
programme.desc: A frightened homeowner's security system captures unexplained voices so terrifying that she must leave her house.

programme.title: Cabin in the Woods
programme.desc: Amy and Adam head to Pennsylvania to help a family make sense of unexplainable happenings on their desolate property and find the spirit stalking them.

programme.title: Trapped in the Attic
programme.desc: An investigation into a shadowy figure takes an emotional turn for Amy when a psychic makes a shocking discovery; a growling voice makes the team fear the ghost is more negative than they believed.

programme.title: Lost Amy
programme.desc: A shadow man terrorizes a small boy, and his mom is so frightened by the activity she won't use their living space.

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: A menacing ghost frightens an 11-year-old girl, and she refuses to sleep alone in her room; Amy and Adam uncover answers about a disturbed grave of a giant Native American man.

programme.title: Shoebox Murder
programme.desc: A hostile spirit attacks a homeowner and smashes objects, leading the investigation to a breakthrough in an infamous unsolved murder.

programme.title: Buried Alive
programme.desc: An unknown entity torments a teenager afraid to live in his own home; Amy and Adam investigate a creepy crawlspace in an upstairs bedroom that could be tied to the tragic death of a grandfather who was buried alive.

programme.title: The Basement
programme.desc: A family won't step foot in the basement because of a brutal murder that took place there, but the kids are still seeing shadow figures and a scary man in the closet; Amy and Adam find evidence on camera.

programme.title: Uninvited Guests
programme.desc: A terrified couple calls for help after witnessing a chair levitate in their home; Amy endures a chilling paranormal experience in an upstairs bedroom; a psychic's visit later reveals a horrifying truth that leaves Adam and Amy shocked.

programme.title: Home Sweet Holmes
programme.desc: A full-bodied apparition terrorizes two young girls at night and Adam and Amy catch it on camera; a heinous murder committed more than 100 years ago might help close the investigation.

programme.title: The Legacy of Lizzie Borden
programme.desc: Adam and Amy investigate one of the most infamous places in America, the Lizzie Borden House; one of the tour guides experiences terrifying paranormal activity and fears for her life, and Adam and Amy discover there's a life hanging in the balance.

programme.title: The Strangler
programme.desc: A family is paralyzed by fear after a spirit strangles one of the children.

programme.title: The Executioner
programme.desc: Adam and Amy investigate the home of a former executioner who killed hundreds of criminals, and now something's trying to kill the current homeowner.

programme.title: The Neighbor
programme.desc: Amy and Adam investigate two properties simultaneously, and both homes are afflicted by the same entity; a cache of haunted objects is key to solving this case, but they belonged to different people.

programme.title: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A home in constant turmoil leaves a child sleepless in a room haunted by a shadowy mass that scares the child at night and taunts his mother, growling at her from the closet.

programme.title: Fire Starter
programme.desc: A home gets set ablaze, and the owners insist upon a paranormal cause; the daughter believes something targets her family, prompting Amy and Adam to think she might be psychic and launch a unique investigation.

programme.title: Native Roots
programme.desc: Amy and Adam investigate the culprit behind an aggressive spirit.

programme.title: Don't Go in the Attic
programme.desc: A family lives in fear because of airborne box cutters, hair pulling and other unexplainable paranormal activity; Adam and Amy discover that one of the spirits in the home has a vital message to deliver.

programme.title: No Salvation
programme.desc: Amy and Adam are called to Liberty, Mo., to investigate the Odd Fellows Home, a massive compound that once cared for orphans and the elderly; more than 10,000 people died on the property, and their pain has fostered a malevolent entity.

programme.title: Satanic Panic
programme.desc: Amy Bruni and Adam Berry investigate a Connecticut home where lives may be at stake; their client believes an evil entity is responsible for killing her children and is living in her home.

programme.title: A Haunting in Gettysburg
programme.desc: Amy and Adam investigate a haunted mirror in Gettysburg, Pa.; abnormal activity turns to unrest when an entity suddenly became physical; Amy and Adam wonder if the mirror is a portal.

programme.title: The Shadow of Death
programme.desc: Amy and Adam visit the Waverly Hills Sanatorium in Louisville, Ky.; considered one of the most haunted locations in the United States, the building houses countless spirits, including a dangerous entity on the fourth floor.

programme.title: Blood in the Water
programme.desc: In Tennessee, Amy and Adam investigate Hales Bar Dam, a location cursed by a chieftain warlord; centuries later the curse still wreaks havoc on the land, and the current owner fears an evil entity is out for revenge.

programme.title: Dying Regrets
programme.desc: Amy and Adam investigate a Virginia plantation where an evil overseer has returned to strike fear into the living by seeking out the dead he once brutalized.

programme.title: Ghost Train
programme.desc: Amy and Adam investigate violent spiritual activity that's threatening a young family residing in one of the oldest homes on Cape Cod in Massachusetts; they break new ground as they unveil a never-before-seen paranormal experiment.

programme.title: The Villisca Axe Murders
programme.desc: Amy and Adam investigate an Iowa farmhouse where a family was brutally murdered by an unknown assailant in 1912; they fear the killer's spirit haunts the home.

programme.title: The Search for Lizzie Borden
programme.desc: Amy and Adam are the first paranormal investigators to enter Maplecroft, the mansion where Lizzie Borden died; they hope it is a groundbreaking opportunity to speak with the spirit of the alleged ax murderer.

programme.title: Brushy Mountain State Penitentiary
programme.desc: Dakota meets the team in Tennessee to investigate the dark corridors of Brushy Mountain State Penitentiary; Chelsea has a confrontation with an entity inside James Earl Ray's cell; Tanner is threatened; Dakota's fear experiment takes a turn.

programme.title: Old South Pittsburg Hospital
programme.desc: Dakota, Chelsea and Tanner explore the Old South Pittsburg Hospital in Tennessee; Dakota must prepare his sister, Chelsea, for a confrontation with a specter on the third floor that is said to attack only women.

programme.title: Sweet Springs Sanitarium
programme.desc: The team encounters its darkest, most-terrifying paranormal activity at a West Virginia sanitarium; the team is tormented by unexplained screams, disembodied chanting, and a voice that almost pushes it to the edge of madness.

programme.title: St. Albans Sanatorium
programme.desc: The team revisits the St. Albans Sanatorium, a place so awful that Chelsea vowed she would never go back; considered to be the most haunted place on the East Coast, it is said to be filled with hundreds of entities, including a demonic force.

programme.title: Eloise Psychiatric Hospital
programme.desc: Dakota, Chelsea and Tanner investigate one of the most haunted locations in Michigan, Eloise Psychiatric Hospital; the team begins to lose its grip on reality while being subjected to screams, slamming doors and rampant poltergeist activity.

programme.title: Madison Seminary
programme.desc: Dark forces conspire against the team as it investigates the Madison Seminary, one of the most-haunted locations in Ohio; terrifying voices, shadow figures and physical contact with a demonic entity leave them stunned and shaken to the core.

programme.title: Statler Hotel
programme.desc: Dakota's team members are pushed to their limits after they check into a hotel in Buffalo, N.Y.; disembodied voices and shadows are everywhere; communications fail in the haunted elevators, and each of the team members find themselves alone.

programme.title: WV State Penitentiary
programme.desc: The team heads to Moundsville, W.Va., to investigate what was once one of the top 10 most-violent prisons in the United States; Dakota fears he may have to leave some part of his soul behind after he is targeted in a physical attack.

programme.title: Fairfield County Infirmary
programme.desc: The team's road trip takes them to Lancaster, Ohio, to investigate a house of horrors; after Dakota instructs each member to explore the property all alone; Alex encounters something so evil it won't be believed if not caught on video.

programme.title: Pennhurst State School
programme.desc: The team faces their biggest paranormal challenge yet when they roll up to an abandoned asylum in Spring City, Pa.; hissing, violent entities within the asylum leave them wondering if they'll ever return home from their terrifying road trip.

programme.title: Nopeming Sanatorium
programme.desc: Dakota, Chelsea and Tanner head home to face the horror of their childhood nightmares, Minnesota's most-notorious sanatorium.

programme.title: Yorktown Memorial Hospital
programme.desc: The team investigates a Texas hospital that has a gruesome history, including a brutal double homicide; the abandoned building's chapel may house a demonic entity.

programme.title: Old Montana Prison
programme.desc: The team investigates a former Montana prison haunted by dark entities known for choking, shanking and possessing visitors; one team member must overcome his fear of violent spirits to survive the night behind the walls of the vile place.

programme.title: Hill View Manor
programme.desc: The team heads to Pennsylvania to investigate a former home for the destitute and elderly, determined to conquer the terror inside; but things go horribly wrong during a dire paranormal-induced emergency.

programme.title: Cambria County Jail
programme.desc: Convinced total isolation and disorientation are the only way to push fear to its limits, Dakota leads the team to Ebensburg, Pa., to investigate a dungeon deep in the bowels of the old Cambria County Jail.

programme.title: Sheboygan County Asylum
programme.desc: Dakota brings the road trip to its most chilling overnight yet, inside a shuttered Wisconsin asylum; this will be the first team ever to sleep inside its abandoned halls, where little is known about why several nurses took their own lives.

programme.title: Saratoga County Homestead
programme.desc: Dakota leads Chelsea, Tanner and Alex to a decaying sanitarium where some patient corpses were unclaimed due to a flu pandemic; screams and darting shadows play mind games with the team as they struggle to pin the activity on the living or the dead.

programme.title: Old Bourbon Distillery
programme.desc: The team confronts the horrors inside an abandoned Kentucky distillery.

programme.title: Randolph County Infirmary
programme.desc: The team returns to Indiana to explore an abandoned facility that has haunted Tanner's nightmares for the past five years; he has only now mustered up the courage to confront who -- or what -- terrorized him during their first investigation.

programme.title: Joliet Prison
programme.desc: It's sweet revenge for Chelsea when she takes the team to Chicago's terrifying Joliet Prison; terrible things happen once they separate inside its walls.

programme.title: Rolling Hills Asylum
programme.desc: Tanner confronts his greatest fear when the team explores an upstate New York asylum that is said to be haunted by the spirit of a 7-foot-tall man.

programme.title: Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum
programme.desc: The team heads to West Virginia to explore an asylum in America; Dakota has doubts about their ability to combat the bloodthirsty souls lurking in the shadows of the cursed property, but Tanner believes they are up for the challenge!

programme.title: Old Idaho Penitentiary
programme.desc: After many nights of torment by the paranormal, Alex finally gets his chance to pick a haunted location for the team to investigate; he has planned the most terrifying experiment for Dakota yet at an infamous Idaho prison.

programme.title: Old Hospital On College Hill
programme.desc: The team may shatter as it arrives at a deserted West Virginia hospital known for its brutal deaths and grisly amputations.

programme.title: Old War Memorial
programme.desc: The team visits an abandoned hospital in Scottsville, Ky., where the alleged spirit of an insane doctor continues to make the rounds.

programme.title: Kuhn State Hospital
programme.desc: The team looks for paranormal activity in the abandoned Kuhn Memorial State Hospital in Vicksburg, Miss.

programme.title: Hayswood Infirmary
programme.desc: The team investigates the abandoned Hayswood Hospital in Maysville, Ky., which once served as a home for shell-shocked veterans.

programme.title: St. Vincent's Mental Home
programme.desc: The team explores the long-abandoned St. Vincent's Home in Oklahoma City, a facility with a history of horror.

programme.title: Old Ironton Psychiatric
programme.desc: The team heads to Ironton, Mo. to investigate an asylum with a dark history of violent patient treatment.

programme.title: Operación 67
programme.desc: Una banda oriental intenta falsificar las placas con que se imprimen los billetes de un país latino para desestabilizarlo.

programme.title: Los supersabios
programme.desc: Los supersabios construyen un cohete espacial. Panza Y Pola provocan la curiosidad de los villanos Solomillo y el médico. Los muchachos despegan su nave y se encuentran con Panza y Pola para comenzar a explorar.

programme.title: El tesoro de Moctezuma
programme.desc: Santo y dos agentes enfrentan a unos villanos cuando se tratan de robar el tesoro de Moctezuma.

programme.title: Asesinos comerciantes de niños
programme.desc: Los padres de un niño secuestrado se enfrentan a una banda criminal que trafica con órganos humanos de menores.

programme.title: Duelo en El Dorado
programme.desc: Poveda, el cacique, se presenta como padre legítimo de un niño y lo rapta. El ex pistolero comienza una intensa lucha con el secuestrador para rescatar al niño.

programme.title: Silencio asesino
programme.desc: Una joven rica es secuestrada por unos delincuentes, pero uno de sus captores se convierte en su protector.

programme.title: Un tipo difícil de matar
programme.desc: El rancho de Tony es blanco de un asalto en Estados Unidos, Ringo el líder de la banda quien también rapta una mujer, sufrirá más de lo que imagina, la persecución será a muerte.

programme.title: Las siete Cucas
programme.desc: Todos los hombres desaparecen tras las puertas de la casa de "Las siete Cucas".

programme.title: The Devil's Rejects
programme.desc: After a raid on the rural home of the psychopathic Firefly family, two members of the clan, Otis (Bill Moseley) and Baby (Sheri Moon Zombie), manage to flee the scene. While the trio continues to torment and kill various victims, the vengeful Sheriff Wydell (William Forsythe) slowly closes in on them.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas (Brenton Thwaites) lives in a seemingly idyllic world of conformity and contentment. When he begins to spend time with The Giver (Jeff Bridges), an old man who is the sole keeper of the community's memories, Jonas discovers the dangerous truths of his community's secret past. Armed with the power of knowledge, Jonas realizes that he must escape from their world to protect himself and those he loves -- a challenge no one has ever completed successfully.

programme.title: Kin
programme.desc: While scavenging for copper wire, Detroit teenager Eli Solinski stumbles upon a high-tech gun that holds special powers. When his brother, Jimmy, lands in trouble with a local crime boss, the two siblings take the mysterious weapon and go on the run. Eli and Jimmy now find themselves in a life-and-death battle against an army of thugs and two heavily armored, futuristic soldiers who want their gun back.

programme.title: Knowing
programme.desc: Fifty years after it was buried in a time capsule, a schoolgirl's cryptic document falls into the hands of Caleb Koestler, the son of professor John Koestler (Nicolas Cage). John figures out that the encoded message accurately lists every major disaster from the past five decades, and predicts three future calamities -- one a global cataclysm. When his warnings fall on deaf ears, John enlists the help of the prophetic author's daughter and granddaughter to try to avert the ultimate disaster.
