programme.title: A Crime for Mothers
programme.desc: An alcoholic woman (Claire Trevor) tries to reclaim her estranged daughter, who has been raised by another family. With Biff Elliott.

programme.title: The Last Escape
programme.desc: An escape artist desperate for the one big stunt that will make him famous meets with disaster when his wife schemes to turn his death-defying trick into a deadly performance.

programme.title: Greatest Monster of Them All
programme.desc: A humiliated horror-movie star yearning for a big comeback seeks revenge after discovering that the producer of a low-budget horror has dubbed his voice and turned the film into a complete farce.

programme.title: The Throwback
programme.desc: A wily old codger (Murray Matheson) gets the better of a younger, stronger man (Scott Marlowe) in their pursuit of a young lady (Joyce Meadows).

programme.title: The Kiss-off
programme.desc: After spending six years in prison for a robbery he didn't commit, Ernie Walters decides to get even with the detective and district attorney who convicted him.

programme.title: The Horseplayer
programme.desc: A priest (Claude Rains) asks for help from a gambler who believes prayers are helping his horses win.

programme.title: Incident in a Small Jail
programme.desc: When a traveling salesman (John Fiedler) stops in a small town, he runs into unexpected trouble. With Crahan Denton.

programme.title: A Woman's Help
programme.desc: A miserable husband devises a deadly plot with a nurse to kill his ailing, domineering wife after being told their affair cannot carry on as long as he stays married.

programme.title: Museum Piece
programme.desc: A man with knowledge in multiple fields runs a museum containing a human skeleton; he finds something in common with a curious visitor and reveals the skeleton's identity.

programme.title: Coming, Mama
programme.desc: A woman begins to realize her domineering mother has no intention of cutting the apron strings that bind them together.

programme.title: Deathmate
programme.desc: A woman (Gia Scala) convinces her handsome young lover (Lee Phillips) to end her husband's (Les Tremayne) life. With Russell Collins.

programme.title: Gratitude
programme.desc: A faithful valet (Paul Hartman) performs a final service for his mob-connected employer (Peter Falk).

programme.title: The Pearl Necklace
programme.desc: A young couple's (Hazel Court, Jack Cassidy) plans to marry are upset when an old man (Ernest Truex) proposes to the woman.

programme.title: Run for Doom
programme.desc: An unfaithful wife gets more than she bargained for when she decides to leave both her husband and her lover.

programme.title: Death of a Cop
programme.desc: A father and son (Victor Jory, Peter Brown) are reunited when the boy decides to follow in his dad's footsteps.

programme.title: A Home Away From Home
programme.desc: A patient (Ray Milland) kills and assumes the identity of the head of a mental hospital; then the man's niece arrives.

programme.title: A Nice Touch
programme.desc: An ambitious Hollywood actor (George Segal) convinces his lover (Anne Baxter) to kill her husband, then makes a phone call.

programme.title: Terror at Northfield
programme.desc: After his son's murder, a zealot (R.G. Armstrong) becomes obsessed with capturing the killer. With Dick York.

programme.title: You'll Be the Death of Me
programme.desc: A woman (Pilar Seurat) becomes the target of her murderous spouse after finding a victim's button.

programme.title: Blood Bargain
programme.desc: A hired killer (Richard Kiley) fakes a murder for the victim (Richard Long) and his disabled wife (Anne Francis).

programme.title: Nothing Ever Happens in Linvale
programme.desc: A curious woman tells the police her neighbor (Gary Merrill) has buried his wife's body in his backyard. With Fess Parker.

programme.title: You Can't Trust a Man
programme.desc: A woman is surprised when her husband returns from prison after serving time for a crime she committed.

programme.title: The Gloating Place
programme.desc: A teenager, Susan Harper, basks in the attention she receives after pretending to have been attacked.

programme.title: Self Defense
programme.desc: When a man kills a young hoodlum who has just robbed a liquor store, he is later confronted by the boy's mother.

programme.title: A Secret Life
programme.desc: A man is bored with marriage and leaves his wife; when he hires a private investigator to watch her in order to gather evidence for a divorce, he discovers that she is living a secret life.

programme.title: Servant Problem
programme.desc: The wife (Jo Van Fleet) abandoned by her husband (John Emery) years before suddenly appears on the night of an important dinner party.

programme.title: Coming Home
programme.desc: An ex-convict becomes frantic when he loses all his money in the town shortly after being released from prison.

programme.title: Final Arrangements
programme.desc: A man who's fed up with his invalid wife's incessant nagging plans her funeral and prepays for a stylish coffin.

programme.title: Ambition
programme.desc: A district attorney (Leslie Nielsen) is ambitious to further his career and eventually become a governor. With Bernard Katz and Harold Stone.

programme.title: The Hat Box
programme.desc: A student (Billy Gray) caught cheating on an exam thinks that his professor (Paul Ford) has killed his wife.

programme.title: Cop for a Day
programme.desc: Two crooks rob a bank messenger and escape with $18,000, only to learn there was a witness to their crime.

programme.title: Keep Me Company
programme.desc: A lonely wife's (Anne Francis) attempt to make her husband (Edmund Hashim) jealous unwittingly helps the police.

programme.title: I Spy
programme.desc: A man (Cecil Parker) hires a detective (Eric Barker) to follow his estranged wife (Kay Walsh), who he believes is seeing another man.

programme.title: Sorcerer's Apprentice
programme.desc: After being taken in by a kind carnival magician, a mentally challenged boy is duped by the magician's deceitful wife.

programme.title: Sybilla
programme.desc: An unhappy husband (Alexander Scourby) fantasizes about killing his wife (Barbara Bel Geddes) and records murder plans in his diary.

programme.title: Bang, You're Dead
programme.desc: While searching his visiting uncle's luggage, a 6-year-old discovers a loaded pistol and thinks it is a toy.

programme.title: Maria
programme.desc: After acquiring an unusual monkey for his act during a state of intoxication, a carnival worker comes to regret his purchase.

programme.title: Beta Delta Gamma
programme.desc: A fraternity prank proves deadly when a drunken frat member (Burt Brinckerhoff) thinks he has committed murder.

programme.title: You Can't Be a Little Girl All Your Life
programme.desc: A shy woman (Caroline Kearney) is attacked in her home while her husband (Dick York) is working late one night.

programme.title: The Old Pro
programme.desc: A professional hit man (Richard Conte) tries to retire, but things keep getting in the way. With Sarah Shane.

programme.title: Services Rendered
programme.desc: An amnesia victim (Steve Dunne) has a $1,000 bill and a doctor's name in his wallet.

programme.title: Right Kind of Medicine
programme.desc: After being shot in a holdup, a bank robber unknowingly receives the wrong medicine from an old pharmacist.

programme.title: A Jury of Her Peers
programme.desc: A sheriff believes a woman (June Walker) is guilty of her husband's murder but has no evidence. With Ann Harding and Frances Reid.

programme.title: The Silk Petticoat
programme.desc: A woman has second thoughts about marriage when her future husband lectures her about indiscretions and torture.

programme.title: Bad Actor
programme.desc: A struggling actor invites a fellow actor to his apartment to rehearse a role for which they are competing.

programme.title: Door Without a Key
programme.desc: A policeman working the night shift encounters an old man with amnesia (Claude Rains) and a lost boy (Bill Mumy).

programme.title: The Case of M.J.H.
programme.desc: Taking advantage of his girlfriend's job at a psychiatrist's office, a small-time crook cooks up a lucrative money-making scheme.

programme.title: The Faith of Aaron Menefee
programme.desc: A man's (Andrew Prine) confidence in a faith healer (Sidney Blackmer) leads to an interesting situation for both of them. With Maggie Pierce and Robert Armstrong.

programme.title: The Woman Who Wanted to Live
programme.desc: In his run from the law, an escaped convict kidnaps a young woman, unaware of her relationship to his latest victim.

programme.title: Strange Miracle
programme.desc: Following a train accident, a man plans to cheat an insurance company out of a large amount of money.

programme.title: The Test
programme.desc: Following the close of a murder trial, an attorney continues to seek the truth for his own personal satisfaction.

programme.title: Burglar Proof
programme.desc: On the verge of losing his job, an advertising executive is desperate to come up with a successful ad campaign.

programme.title: The Big Score
programme.desc: A gang of teen thieves hits one house too many when they target a mob gangster's (Philip Reed) home. With Tom Gilleran and Rafael Campos.

programme.title: Profit-Sharing Plan
programme.desc: A retired man plans to run away with his mistress and stolen company funds, but his wife has something else in mind.

programme.title: Apex
programme.desc: A man and his lover (Mark Miller, Patricia Breslin) plot to eliminate his wife (Vivienne Segal) so they can be together.

programme.title: Last Remains
programme.desc: An undertaker (John Fielder) attempts to collect from a penny-pinching killer (Ed Gardner).

programme.title: 10 O'Clock Tiger
programme.desc: A seedy character (Frankie Darro) discovers an amazing formula and decides to use it to make some quick cash. With Robert Keith and Karl Lukas.

programme.title: The Kerry Blue
programme.desc: A man's (Gene Evans) obsession over his pet dog pushes him over the edge when the dog suddenly dies. With Carmen Mathews.

programme.title: Starring the Defense
programme.desc: A lawyer (Richard Basehart), once an actor, helps his son, who stands trial for homicide. With Florence Halop.

programme.title: The Cadaver
programme.desc: A medical student plants a corpse in a drunken roommate's (Michael Parks) bed to convince him he killed.

programme.title: The Dividing Wall
programme.desc: Paroled safecrackers (Chris Robinson, James Gregory, Norman Fell) steal a safe, but it holds radioactive cobalt.

programme.title: Good-Bye George
programme.desc: An actress's (Patricia Barry) supposed dead husband returns and demands a share of her success. With Robert Culp.

programme.title: How to Get Rid of Your Wife
programme.desc: A henpecked man (Bob Newhart) tries to drive his nagging wife (Jane Withers) to murder.

programme.title: Three Wives Too Many
programme.desc: The well-to-do wife (Teresa Wright) of a bigamist will go to any lengths to have her husband all to herself.

programme.title: The Magic Shop
programme.desc: A man (Leslie Nielsen) takes his son to a magic shop on his birthday and watches as the store owner makes the boy vanish.

programme.title: Beyond the Sea of Death
programme.desc: An heiress (Diana Hyland) turns to a greedy mystic after her fiancé (Jeremy Slate) dies in a mining mishap.

programme.title: The Matched Pearl
programme.desc: A jewelry shop owner sells a rare black pearl to a client, who later returns looking for another one to make a matched pair.

programme.title: Most Likely to Succeed
programme.desc: Having had a bad run of luck, a man (Howard Morris) tracks down an old college friend (Jack Carter) in hopes of landing a job.

programme.title: Victim Four
programme.desc: A husband searches desperately for his wife in a neighborhood where numerous murders have been committed.

programme.title: Golden Opportunity
programme.desc: A shoplifter (Coleen Gray) is blackmailed into helping the store manager (Richard Long) in a crime of his own.

programme.title: The 12-Hour Caper
programme.desc: A meek clerk (Dick York) plots with his associates to rob their investment firm. With Wendell Holmes.

programme.title: Children of Alda Nuova
programme.desc: A wanted man (Jack Carson) disappears while visiting a little-known tourist attraction in Italy. With Christopher Dark.

programme.title: First-Class Honeymoon
programme.desc: A recently-divorced man (Robert Webber) makes a deal with a friend (Jeremy Slate) to avoid having to pay alimony.

programme.title: The Big Kick
programme.desc: A man (Wayne Rogers) decides to demonstrate to his new-found girlfriend (Anne Helm) how he gets his kicks. With Brian Hutton.

programme.title: Where Beauty Lies
programme.desc: A housekeeper make arrangements to keep her lover all to herself when he expresses interest in another woman.

programme.title: Revenge
programme.desc: A woman (Linda Purl) is attacked in her home and her husband (David Clennon) takes the law into his own hands.

programme.title: Shopping for Death
programme.desc: Two retired insurance salesmen (Robert H. Harris, John Qualen) expect murder when the temperature reaches 92 degrees.

programme.title: Premonition
programme.desc: A young man (John Forsythe) returns home after an absence of four years to investigate his father's death.

programme.title: Triggers in Leash
programme.desc: A woman (Ellen Corby) tries to prevent a shootout between two gunslingers (Darren McGavin, Gene Barry).

programme.title: Don't Come Back Alive
programme.desc: A determined detective (Robert Emhardt) uncovers a man's scheme to have his "missing" wife declared legally dead.

programme.title: Into Thin Air
programme.desc: A woman (Patricia Hitchcock) visiting Paris returns to her hotel room to find her ailing mother missing.

programme.title: Salvage
programme.desc: A gangster (Gene Barry) plans to punish the woman (Nancy Gates) he feels is responsible for his brother's death.

programme.title: Breakdown
programme.desc: A businessman, injured in a car crash and believed by everyone to be dead, fights to signal he is alive.

programme.title: Our Cook's a Treasure
programme.desc: A man (Everett Sloane) suspects his cook (Beulah Bondi) of being an arsenic-poisoning murderer. With Janet Ward.

programme.title: The Long Shot
programme.desc: A down-on-his-luck man responds to a newspaper ad from a man seeking a companion for a cross-country trip.

programme.title: The Case of Mr. Pelham
programme.desc: A man (Tom Ewell) believes an exact double is gradually taking over his life.

programme.title: Guilty Witness
programme.desc: A woman (Judith Evelyn) is suspected of murdering her husband, who has been having an affair with another woman. With Joe Mantell and Kathleen McGuire.

programme.title: Santa Claus and the 10th Ave. Kid
programme.desc: A larcenous store Santa (Barry Fitzgerald) helps change the ways of a potential delinquent (Bobby Clark).

programme.title: The Cheney Vase
programme.desc: A man (Darren McGavin) tries to trick an elderly woman (Patricia Collinge) out of a family heirloom.

programme.title: A Bullet for Baldwin
programme.desc: A man (John Qualen) is surprised to learn that the boss he thought he had murdered is still alive. With Philip Reed.

programme.title: The Big Switch
programme.desc: A gunman (George Mathews), intent on murdering his girlfriend, purchases an alibi.

programme.title: You Got to Have Luck
programme.desc: An escaped convict (John Cassavetes) takes refuge in a farmhouse occupied by a young housewife (Marisa Pavan).

programme.title: The Older Sister
programme.desc: A year after the murders, a newspaper reporter (Joan Lorring) attempts to interview Lizzie Borden (Carmen Mathews) and her sister about the killings.

programme.title: The Derelicts
programme.desc: A bum (Robert Newton) witnesses a murder and decide to take advantage of the situation. With Philip Reed.

programme.title: And So Died Riabouchinska
programme.desc: A police detective (Charles Bronson) investigating a murder focuses on a strange ventriloquist (Claude Rains).

programme.title: Safe Conduct
programme.desc: A female reporter (Claire Trevor) encounters problem trying to leave Eastern Europe after meeting a soccer star.

programme.title: Place of Shadows
programme.desc: A man (Mark Damon) arrives at a monastery bent on revenge and is convinced by a kind priest (Everett Sloane) to mend his heart.

programme.title: Back for Christmas
programme.desc: An English man (John Williams) murders his wife and moves to California, thinking he has committed the perfect crime.

programme.title: The Perfect Murder
programme.desc: Two greedy brothers plan to murder their elderly aunt (Mildred Natwick) in an attempt to inherit her money.

programme.title: There Was an Old Woman
programme.desc: A desperate couple (Charles Bronson, Norma Crane) plans to rob an eccentric old woman (Estelle Winwood).

programme.title: Whodunit
programme.desc: An angel (Alan Napier) allows a murdered mystery writer (John Williams) to return to Earth to uncover his killer.

programme.title: Help Wanted
programme.desc: An unemployed man (John Qualen) needing money is hired by an unknown employer (Lorne Greene) to commit murder.

programme.title: Portrait of Jocelyn
programme.desc: A man (Philip Abbott) is startled to see a portrait of his first wife four years after she disappeared.

programme.desc: Matt and Bruno find the perfect hunting truck, the only problem is they need to get it running before they can go on their first hunt.

programme.title: Mall Crawler
programme.desc: Some build Jeeps to go off-road, and others build them just for the "off-road" look. Matt and Bruno will show you how to build the ultimate "Mall Crawler" on Truck U.

programme.title: SuperCharged Raptor
programme.desc: How can you jump a Ford Raptor even further? Put a supercharger in it. Matt and Bruno team up with Roush Performance to get the maximum power output of a stock Raptor.

programme.title: Vintage CJ
programme.desc: Bruno and Matt find a vintage CJ Jeep and see if they can transform it back to its former glory.

programme.title: Bruno Goes Racing
programme.desc: Bruno goes racing in Charlotte, North Carolina. First, he finds out how a NASCAR team is run at Michael Waltrip Racing; then he checks out a NHRA test session at zMAX Dragway.

programme.title: Wired and Fired
programme.desc: Every Project starts with a Cab and Chassis. On Truck U will show you what to look for when finding the right cab and get a small block engine wired and fired.

programme.title: Under the Knife
programme.desc: Bryan finally gets to fulfill his dream of chopping the top on his 33.

programme.title: Factory Five Build Part 1 - the Engine
programme.desc: Kevin and Bryan begin work on a new Factory Five Hot Rod with a Dart 369 engine build

programme.title: Factory Five Build Part 2 - the Body
programme.desc: Bryan and Kevin get the body on their Factory Five Hot Rod

programme.title: Factory Five Build Part 3 - the Test
programme.desc: Kevin and Bryan finish their five-day Factory Five project and take their car to the streets.

programme.title: Welding Tips
programme.desc: Learn some Mig and Tig welding tips as the guys finish the roll cage and do some patch panels on the Fuller Hot Rod Project.

programme.title: Custom Camaro
programme.desc: How do you a make a 2010 SS throw back Camaro look even better. Drop it off with Kevin and Bryan and see what happens.

programme.title: SuperNova
programme.desc: Kevin installs a new wiring harness while Bryan welds up a new exhaust for our Nova.

programme.title: See it Made - Magnaflow
programme.desc: Kevin visits Magnaflow to see what it takes to get that perfect sounding exhaust.

programme.title: Daily Driver
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno completely overhaul the bed of a 1966 Chevy truck.

programme.title: Food Truck
programme.desc: The world's largest food truck rally comes to Truck U. Matt and Bruno find a Food Truck that is need of some repair and in the process give the truck a whole new look.

programme.title: Fisherman's Fleet
programme.desc: A local seafood distributor is ready to grow his business and Truck U is ready to help. Matt and Bruno find a truck, find a work bed and fill it up with seafood.

programme.title: UTV Fun
programme.desc: Can Am Commanders are perfect for work and play. On Truck U we do a little of both.

programme.title: Signature Series Jeep
programme.desc: When 4 Wheel Parts ask Truck U to build a signature series Jeep, we said yes. We'll add a long arm suspension kit with 37 inch tires and take the new JK off-road.

programme.title: Ultimate Chase Truck
programme.desc: Desert Race Teams need support when they're in the middle of nowhere. We'll help one of those teams, by turning a stock Raptor SVT into the Ultimate Chase Truck.

programme.title: Diesel Puller
programme.desc: When it takes almost 900 horsepower to pull a pro sled truck down a track, things are going to break. Truck U steps in, to take out broken axles and upgrade them for good.

programme.title: Show and Go
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno bring in a 1982 GMC that has a lot of show and even more go. They'll do some custom modifications to the Cummins engine and dress up the exterior.

programme.title: Hemi Orange is the New Corporate Blue
programme.desc: The ghouls work on a 1968 GTX for Bill Goldberg, and Mark repairs a Challenger deck lid. Will paints a 1967 Hemi GTX and challenges Mark to a paint-off.

programme.title: Grand Theft Hemi
programme.desc: Mark teaches Allysa to analyze and document cars in preparation for disassembly, but she later has a crucial lapse in judgement. The ghouls install the 400 Magnum in the 1972 Dodge Charger.

programme.title: Investigation O.E.
programme.desc: Two rare Mopars, a Daytona survivor and early Hemi Charger, are analyzed for authenticity and restoration.

programme.title: Chally vs. Chally
programme.desc: The ghouls complete the 1970 V-Code Challenger and make a side-by-side comparison with Mark's 2014 Shaker-hood Challenger.

programme.title: HEMI FK5 Alive
programme.desc: A 1970 Hemi Charger is restored.

programme.title: Pitch and Rides
programme.desc: The 1970 Hemi Charger project is completed in the season finale.

programme.title: General Assemble Lee
programme.desc: The Graveyard Ghouls return with the final assembly of the legendary General Lee which so happens to also be the official screen-used, record holding, freeway jump-car from the 2005 Dukes of Hazzard film.

programme.title: Put Up Your Dukes
programme.desc: Mark isolates himself in the machine-shop and begins the assembly of the 440 4BBL for the 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger previously owned by a former cast member.

programme.title: General Deliver Lee
programme.desc: It's a delivery day at Graveyard Carz! We jump back and show you every moment in the restoration of our legendary, screen-used, record holding, General Lee from the 2005 Dukes of Hazzard film. It all builds to a reveal the Duke Boys would be proud of.

programme.title: Inner Workings of a Victim
programme.desc: With all the distractions out of the way, Mark returns to the machine-ship to finish the 440 4BBL for the 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger while master-assembler Dave begins working on the 1970 Lemon-Twist Roadrunner.

programme.title: The Ghost of Causton Abbey
programme.desc: The ancient Causton Abbey is now a brewery, but the old curse is still active: one person is found boiled to death in one of the vats shortly after a party to launch a new ale.

programme.title: Death of the Small Coppers
programme.desc: An old friend must help Barnaby and Winter solve the death of a butterfly collector before more bodies follow in his wake.

programme.title: Drawing Dead
programme.desc: Barnaby and Winter use a scandalous comic book to find the murderer of a former supermodel during Carver Valley's comic festival.

programme.title: The Lions of Causton
programme.desc: Barnaby and Winter sift through old grudges, intimate affairs and artisanal chocolates to find the culprit behind a death at a rugby club.

programme.title: Till Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Barnaby's reluctant presence at Sarah's friend's wedding proves fateful when a murderer targets local brides, sending the investigator on a mission to nab the killer.

programme.title: Send in the Clowns
programme.desc: Barnaby must confront his fears when clown sightings, sinister notes and death accompany Ferraees Circus into town.

programme.title: The Dark Rider
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones investigate when the appearance of a headless horseman at Quitewell Hall foreshadows a number of deaths among an aristocratic family called the DeQuettevilles. Meanwhile, the family stage a Civil War re-enactment with their hostile neighbours and relive historic battles. Can the detectives uncover the truth about the DeQuettevilles and the ghostly rider in order to prevent more murders?

programme.title: Murder of Innocence
programme.desc: When convicted murderer Grady Felton returns to the village where he killed a boy years earlier, his arrival is met with anger from the locals. Soon afterwards, a barrister is killed in Midsomer and suspicion falls on Grady. Grady has a solid alibi, but Barnaby suspects that he is working with an accomplice - until Grady himself is targeted in an arson attack.

programme.title: Death and the Divas
programme.desc: The murder of a journalist has chilling echoes of a 1960s horror film starring Midsomer's own Stella Harris. When Stella's more famous sister returns after a 40-year family rift, the killings escalate, each of them reminiscent of a movie plot - is life - and death - imitating art?

programme.title: Written in the Stars
programme.desc: As darkness covers Midsomer Stanton during a total eclipse of the sun, amateur astronomer Jeremy Harper is killed by a blow to the head with a meteorite. Barnaby and Jones soon discover intrigue, sexual tension and academic rivalry are rife among the star-seeking community.

programme.title: The Sicilian Defence
programme.desc: Harriet Farmer wakes up after being in a coma since the night she tried to elope. Harriet's boyfriend Finn Robson has been missing since the couple tried to run away together a year before. Then the president of the local chess society, Edward Stannington, is found dead in a lake with an ice pick in his back. His damaged car is nearby and Kate finds a clue in his mouth.

programme.title: Schooled in Murder
programme.desc: When a woman is crushed to death by a giant round of cheese at the home of the world-famous "Midsomer Blue", Barnaby and Jones are soon on the case. Debbie Moffett worked at the dairy, founded by her colleague Jim Caxton, who seems more anxious about his precious cheese than Debbie's death. And later, Debbie's lover Oliver Ordish is garrotted with cheese wire and covered with cheese fly larvae.

programme.title: The Killings at Badger's Drift
programme.desc: The peace of idyllic Badger's Drift is shattered by an inexplicable murder. It falls to DCI Barnaby and Sergeant Troy to hunt down the killer. Their investigation uncovers a web of sinister events, some long buried in the past.

programme.title: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In the tranquil village of Midsomer Worthy, the local writers' circle is eagerly anticipating a visit from a best-selling novelist, but the aspiring authors are about to witness a sequence of gruesome events far stranger than any fiction.

programme.title: Death of a Hollow Man
programme.desc: In the quiet rural village of Ferne Basset, an elderly resident is found drowned after a violent attack. Meanwhile, a local amateur dramatic production of `Amadeus' reveals a hitherto unseen world of intrigue and passion.

programme.title: Faithful Unto Death
programme.desc: The village of Morton Fendle seems to be overflowing with community spirit when many of the residents invest in the local craft centre, but DCI Barnaby is called in after the wife of the centre's owner goes missing, and a neighbour is murdered.

programme.title: Death in Disguise
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Barnaby is called in following the death of a cult leader and finds clues that point to a ruthless tycoon searching for his daughter.

programme.title: The Wolf Hunter of Little Worthy
programme.desc: After a local photographer wins an urban myth competition with his creation of The Wolf Hunter, it unexpectedly gains a cult following. However, when a man is killed, Barnaby and Winter must investigate if this myth has become murderous reality.

programme.title: The Stitcher Society
programme.desc: A local outcast, who was controversially acquitted of murder years earlier, is the latest inductee into a post-operative heart rehab club. Following his arrival, members' dreams of a second chance at life begin to be cut short.

programme.title: Happy Families
programme.desc: As the owners of Karras Games gather for a murder mystery weekend, the immersive experience takes a puzzling twist when a killer strikes for real. The police's detective skills are put to the test as they are forced to solve this case on their own.

programme.title: The Scarecrow Murders
programme.desc: The annual Midsomer Scarecrow Festival takes a grisly turn as bodies begin appearing on poles displayed alongside their straw creations; the investigation reveals rivalries that run deep and shows people will do just about anything to win.

programme.title: Death Prepare
programme.desc: The Midsomer Mummers, an amateur operatic society, rehearses for its charity concert when the body of an unknown man is found in the theatre; the investigation quickly becomes a race to discover who is desperate to take centre stage.

programme.title: The Witches of Angel's Rise
programme.desc: Each year, the village of Angel's Rise hosts the Psychic Fayre. Founded by the Saint-Stephens family in memory of their late daughter, the event attracts mediums, psychics and followers of the occult. When a body is found surrounded by ritual symbols on the eve of the festival, Barnaby must step into the spiritual world to find the killer.

programme.title: The Made to Measure Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Milton Cross, a feudal estate with a church, farms, houses and acres of land, depend on lord of the manor Edward Milton for their livelihoods. When Sonia Woodley is stabbed in the churchyard two years after the death of her abusive husband Gerald, Barnaby and Jones investigate - and the village starts to reveal its secrets.

programme.title: The Sword of Guillaume
programme.desc: Barnaby joins a trip from Midsomer Parva to Brighton because he's suspicious about a deal to buy coastal land for holiday chalets by Causton's mayor. Also against the proposal is Lady Matilda William, a descendant of a French knight Sir Richard Guillaume, whose son Richard will be the last of the line because of brain damage sustained in an attack 20 years ago.

programme.title: Blood on the Saddle
programme.desc: Trouble seems to be brewing in the pretty village of Ford Florey when a tract of waste ground dubbed 'the Swamp' becomes the focus of a land dispute between two old agricultural families and a band of travellers. Things get nasty at the town's annual fair when a woman is shot for real during a shoot-out reconstruction at the Wild West show. Barnaby and Jones uncover a series of seething grudges within the village.

programme.title: The Silent Land
programme.desc: After Joyce Barnaby swerves off the road into a ditch, believing she has hit someone, the body of a librarian is found in a nearby cemetery. Amid stories of ghosts and haunted buildings, can DCI Tom Barnaby convince his wife that she is not to blame - and at the same time identify the real killer on the loose in March Magna?

programme.title: Master Class
programme.desc: During a masterclass for talented young musicians held by famous pianist Sir Michael Fielding, prodigy Zoe Stock is shocked to witness a woman drowning in the river, leaving a baby on the bank. When police arrive, however, there is no sign of the woman or her child. DCI Tom Barnaby is struck by the similarity of the reported drowning to a mysterious case from 20 years ago.

programme.title: The Noble Art
programme.desc: Betrayal, infidelity and blackmail fester as plans to re-enact a Victorian prizefight turn nasty - and even DCI Barnaby finds his judgement clouded by an old friend. Midsomer Morchard welcomes back local boxer John Kinsella from his world title fight victory in New York. Meanwhile, Kinsella's ruthless and controlling promoter Frank Bishop goes to see solicitor Giles Braithwaite, only to find the lawyer dead.

programme.title: Not in My Backyard
programme.desc: A planning dispute turns to murder after a leading light in the Midsomer Conservation Society suspects her neighbours are involved in a money-making development scam. Political wrangling, burglaries and sexual liaisons abound in picturesque Great Pelfe - but why is someone driven to start killing? Barnaby and Jones investigate.

programme.title: Fit for Murder
programme.desc: With his birthday approaching, Barnaby reluctantly accompanies Joyce on a spa weekend to Swavely Manor, but as he attempts to relax, a woman is found dead in the flotation chamber. Abandoning the treatment to investigate, Barnaby uncovers a feud between neighbours, money wrangles and the mystery of a half-written novel. After another gruesome discovery, the truth gradually emerges.

programme.title: Blood Wedding
programme.desc: There are two contrasting weddings taking place in Midsomer - Cully's to Simon, and local baronet Ned Fitzroy's to Beth Porteous. As Cully suffers from last minute doubts, Barnaby becomes an unwelcome guest at Ned's marriage when the maid of honour is stabbed to death. What are the secrets in Midsomer high society, and will Barnaby get to his daughter's ceremony on time?

programme.title: PFL Summer Series: Charlotte - Battle vs. Rosta
programme.desc: PFL Summer Series lands in Charlotte as hometown favorite Bryan Battle squares off against Dalton Rosta.

programme.title: PFL Summer Series: Austin - Eblen vs. Kasanganay
programme.desc: PFL Summer Series heads to Austin as Johnny Eblen battles Impa Kasanganay for interim middleweight gold.

programme.title: Gaethje v. Cobb
programme.desc: In a back and forth three-round bout, undefeated lightweight prospect Justin Gaethje (8-0) takes on MMA veteran Brian Cobb (20-7) at WSOF 3. From 2013.

programme.title: Gaethje vs. Firmino
programme.desc: In the WSOFNYC main event, undefeated lightweight kingpin Justin Gaethje defends his crown against Luiz Buscape Firmino; WSOFNYC features an unprecedented New Year's Eve world championship extravaganza at Madison Square Garden, New York.

programme.title: Gaethje v. Foster
programme.desc: In the lightweight championship main event, undefeated champ Justin Gaethje (15-0) attempts to defend his throne against Brian Foster (26-8) at WSOF 29, 2016.

programme.title: Gaethje v. Guillard
programme.desc: In the people's main event, undefeated contender and fan favorite Justin Gaethje takes on Melvin Guillard in a catchweight bout at WSOF 15, 2014. The hostility between the fighters during fight week made this the most anticipated bout of the weekend.

programme.title: Gaethje v. Lauzon
programme.desc: In his third fight in the WSOF, undefeated knockout artist Justin Gaethje (9-0) accepts the challenge from MMA veteran Dan Lauzon (17-4) at WSOF 6, 2013.

programme.title: Gaethje v. Newell
programme.desc: The first ever WSOF lightweight king Justin Gaethje (11-0) attempts his first title defense against undefeated contender Nick Newell (11-0) at WSOF 11, 2014.

programme.title: Gaethje v. Palomino 1
programme.desc: In what many consider the fight of the year for 2015, lightweight champ Justin Gaethje faces Luis Palomino in a battle; Gaethje vs. Palomino in the main event of WSOF 19, 2015.

programme.title: Gaethje v. Palomino 2
programme.desc: Undefeated lightweight champ Justin Gaethje attempts to defend his belt against Luis Palomino for the second time; Gaethje vs. Palomino Two in the main event of WSOF 23, 2015.

programme.title: 2026: Austin
programme.desc: PFL Austin featured Johnny Eblen vs. Impa Kasanganay for the interim middleweight title in the main event, plus Lewis McGrillen vs. Rafael do Nascimento in a bantamweight co-main event.

programme.title: 2026: Washington D.C.
programme.desc: PFL Washington D.C. featured Thad Jean vs. late replacement Ernesto Rodriguez for the vacant welterweight title in the main event, plus Tyson Pedro vs. Rafael Xavier in the light heavyweight co-main event.

programme.title: 2026: San Diego
programme.desc: PFL San Diego featured California standout AJ McKee vs. undefeated Salamat Isbulaev in the featherweight main event, plus former PFL champion Liz Carmouche taking on Viviane Araujo in the co-main event.

programme.title: 2026: MENA 10

programme.desc: France turns a corner toward absolute monarchy after 1627-28's Siege of La Rochelle, with Louis XIII in power.

programme.title: The Siege of Orléans: Joan's Fortress
programme.desc: French forces defend Orléans from the English army in the Hundred Years' War's brutal siege of 1428-29.

programme.title: The Daunting Fortress of Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: Richard the Lionheart constructs a mighty castle on the Seine to dominate over his strategic Normandy lands.

programme.title: The Siege Of Alesia: Caesar's Greatest Victory
programme.desc: The fortress at Alesia falls to Caesar in his greatest victory, redefining siege warfare with Roman know-how.

programme.title: The Spanish Conquest
programme.desc: The Spanish Conquest produced 300 years of colonial rule, dividing Mexico with a class system still in effect.

programme.title: The War of Independence
programme.desc: The War of Independence charts Mexico's fight to break free from Spain after years of instability.

programme.title: Athens
programme.desc: See Athens rise from a village to Greece's pinnacle under Pericles, with landmarks that showcased democracy.

programme.title: Beat Street
programme.desc: Feel the rhythm. Catch the beat! Brash, bold and breakin' all the rules, this powerful musical stars Rae Dawn Chong and Guy Davis.

programme.title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
programme.desc: This fly follow-up to "Breakin'" finds Kelly, Ozone and Turbo trying to rescue a community center facing demolition at the hands of a greedy real-estate developer.

programme.title: Rappin'
programme.desc: To save the homes of his family and friends, John "Rappin" Hood (Mario Van Peebles) rallies with his fast-talking comrades to fight back. Not with their fists... but with their powerful rap!

programme.title: Five on the Black Hand Side
programme.desc: Fed up with patriarch Mr. John Henry Brooks Jr.'s tyrannical rule, Mrs. Brooks and the kids are fighting back!

programme.title: Barbershop (2002)
programme.desc: Ice Cube headlines a stellar cast this hit comedy about a southside Chicago barbershop.

programme.title: Barbershop 2: Back In Business
programme.desc: The buzz is back in this hit sequel! Calvin (Ice Cube) is struggling to keep his father's shop alive, competing with a name-brand chain opening up next door! Queen Latifah, Eve, Michael Ealy, Troy Garity and Cedric The Entertainer co-star.

programme.title: Beauty Shop
programme.desc: When her egotistical boss pushes her a hair too far, top stylist Gina decides to open her own beauty shop with an eccentric group of stylists!

programme.title: Holiday Heart
programme.desc: Holiday (Ving Rhames), a choirmaster by day and a talented female impersonator by night, is lonely and grieving the death of his lover...until he befriends a bright young girl and her drug-addicted mother (Alfre Woodard).

programme.title: Street Smart
programme.desc: A freelance journalist becomes the toast of the town when he breaks a story about the dirty deeds of a ruthless New York pimp. There's only one problem: Jonathan fabricated the entire thing.

programme.title: Gang Related
programme.desc: Two killers are hiding where no one will ever find them...behind their badges! Tupac Shakur and James Belushi are two corrupt police detectives caught in a dangerous web of deceit in this gritty, smart and tough action thriller.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg), the city's toughest cop, is out to take down the drug lord responsible!

programme.title: The Mighty Quinn
programme.desc: Police officer Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) discovers that he's the only one who believes that his childhood friend was framed for murder to protect the local tourism business.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: A straight-laced and successful executive's world is turned upside-down when he discovers the 17-year-old son he never knew he had: Roger (Denzel Washington in his feature film debut)!

programme.title: Cooley High
programme.desc: Two best friends in 1964 Chicago cope with the challenges of everyday life and life in the housing projects.

programme.title: A Family Thing
programme.desc: When Earl (Robert Duvall) learns he has a Black half-brother (James Earl Jones) in Chicago, he heads north.

programme.title: Salt & Pepper
programme.desc: Legendary Rat-Packers Sammy Davis, Jr., and Peter Lawford star as London's hippest nightclub owners who take on England's craziest criminals!

programme.title: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka
programme.desc: A slick comedy that blows the 70s Blaxploitation movies right out of the hood! A decorated war hero, returns to the ghetto and enlist an army of original gangstas to clean it up in this mixture of nostalgia, silliness and unpredictable humor.

programme.title: Fame (2009)
programme.desc: An inspiring story of a group of dancers, singers, musicians and actors at the NYC School of Performing Arts.

programme.title: Bojangles
programme.desc: Bill "Bojangles" Robinson (Gregory Hines) overcomes the prejudice of the time and his own personal demons to become a master craftsman...and a legendary entertainer!

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: The great Isaac Hayes stars as Truck Turner who tracks a sadistic pimp through the mean streets of Los Angeles. Nichelle Nichols also stars.

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: An ex-Vietnam, ex-Green Beret captain (Jim Brown) is out to avenge the murder of his parents by the psychotic Dominic Hoffo (Rip Torn).

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: Sentenced to life in the world's most notorious prison colony, two tougher-than-nails inmates enact the ultimate jail break.

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: When Harlem gangsters mess with the Mafia, an unlikely pair of New York's finest must work together to bring justice to the streets!

programme.title: Cotton Comes To Harlem
programme.desc: Two New York detectives suddenly find themselves on a wild goose chase for stolen cash that takes them from the Apollo Theater through the heart and soul of Harlem!

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is a professional killer. Now, on the eve of his retirement, he must make a deadly decision.

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: When wild child Anna Lucasta (Eartha Kitt) is thrown out of the house by her self-righteous father, she falls into the life of prostitution... and into the arms of street-wise sailor Danny Johnson (Sammy Davis, Jr.).

programme.title: Lilies Of The Field
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier stars as an itinerant handyman who stops to help five impoverished nuns in the Arizona desert.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®.

programme.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
programme.desc: Lt. Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier), asks to be assigned to the case of a reverend accused of murder in San Francisco in hopes of clearing his friend's name.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier is back as Lt. Virgil Tibbs! When six masked figures rob a seemingly normal furniture factory, they leave with a multimillion-dollar cache of heroin!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '50s - Jack Benny (1/17/73)
programme.desc: Jack Benny talks about his NBC special and Rick Little impersonates celebrities. Plus, Johnny takes on gas rationing in his monologue.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '50s - Jack Benny (7/20/73)
programme.desc: Jack Benny doesn't enjoy Paris and Joe Namath doesn't understand politics. Elke Sommer also appears.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '50s - Lucille Ball (3/22/74)
programme.desc: You'll love Lucy when she gets a surprise visitor to The Tonight Show. You might also love Dom Deluise and Charlton Heston in this star-studded episode.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '50s - George Burns (11/30/76)
programme.desc: George Burns takes on Groucho Marx and young people and Rodney Dangerfield continues to get no respect. Plus, Johnny talks with Michael Constantine and Shana Alexander.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '50s - Jackie Gleason (10/18/85)
programme.desc: Jackie Gleason opens up about why he quit The Honeymooners after only three years. Plus, Jim Stafford stops by and Johnny jokes about Tommy Lasorda.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '50s - Milton Berle (1/14/88)
programme.desc: Join Johnny as he celebrates Milton Berle's 75th year in show business! Also, Carol Siskind does stand-up and Don Yesso details being discovered on an airplane.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '50s - Jerry Lewis (3/21/84)
programme.desc: American comedian and beloved star in France, Jerry Lewis jokes about scoring the French Legion of Honor Award and his recent heart surgery.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '50s - Bob Hope (12/21/78)
programme.desc: Merry Christmas, Mr. Hope! Bob says he's spending the holiday with his grandkids in Reno. Producer Gil Cates spills the beans on celebrity game show, What's My Line?

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '50s - Bob Hope (10/31/80)
programme.desc: The inimitable Bob Hope offers his 2 cents on the Reagan - Carter debate, sleeping in the Lincoln bedroom, and grades Presidents Johnson and Kennedy on their sense of humor.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '50s - Bob Hope (12/15/88)
programme.desc: Bob Hope talks about growing up poor, his brief boxing career, Christmas in Palm Springs and what it means when a man wears a red tie.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '50s - Bob Hope (12/15/89)
programme.desc: It's Christmas tonight, with Bob Hope in cheery holiday spirit chatting about shopping trips and hitting the golf course over the holidays.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Dom Deluise (3/6/73)
programme.desc: Dom Deluise on earthquakes, Bruno Vailati on sharks and Sally Kellerman on the Queen of England highlight this episode. Plus, Ronnie Schell does stand-up.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Buddy Hackett (3/30/73)
programme.desc: Learn how to raise rabbits on a Brooklyn fire escape with Buddy Hackett and how to light a fire with Brady Watt. Also appearing are McLean Stevenson and John Kidner.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Dom Deluise (9/6/73)
programme.desc: It's a comedy fan's heaven when Dom Deluise and Don Rickles head to the couch.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Buddy Hackett (5/7/74)
programme.desc: Buddy Hackett reads poetry and Cass Elliot makes one of her final TV appearances. Also appearing are firebreather Jan Munroe and artist Doug Kingman.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Joan Rivers (5/17/74)
programme.desc: Joan Rivers talks California living, Vincent Price thinks horror movies are fun and Johnny takes on the musician strike. Bert Convoy also appears.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Mel Brooks (2/13/75)
programme.desc: Mel Brooks stops by to talk about Young Frankenstein and Blazing Saddles. Plus, Susan Blakely and Bob Rosefsky appear.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Joan Rivers (5/20/75)
programme.desc: Find out how Joan Rivers is preparing for getting old and what story intrigues Truman Capote. Bob Speca also appears.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Joan Rivers (12/31/75)
programme.desc: What are Joan Rivers' New Year's resolutions? Find out in this episode, which also features Orson Bean, Charles Nelson Reilly and Scatman Crothers.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Flip Wilson (7/23/76)
programme.desc: Flip Wilson does stand-up, Pat Boone talks about the Olympics and a doctor waxes poetic on the wisdom of spanking children. Tom Dressen also performs comedy.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Buddy Hackett (2/1/77)
programme.desc: Get skiing tips from Buddy Hackett, fan mail tips from Cindy Williams and TV journalism tips from Sander Vanocur.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Carl Reiner (2/2/78)
programme.desc: Hollywood legend Carl Reiner stops by with his toupee. Plus, Jack Klugman talks examining dead bodies and Jan Todd shows you what it's like to be the strongest woman in the world.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Don Rickles (3/1/78)
programme.desc: No one is safe when Don Rickles visits the set! But Cheryl Ladd and Ray Bradbury will make you feel right at home again.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Joan Rivers (12/13/78)
programme.desc: The legendary Joan Rivers talks giving birth and politics, but not necessarily at the same time. Also appearing are Ann Margret and Lou Holtz.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Joan Rivers (4/3/80)
programme.desc: Joan Rivers won Comedy Star of the Year, Dick Van Patten is depressed and Johnny has to deal with a slow news day. Byron Allen and Stephanie Faracy also appear.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Buddy Hackett (10/16/80)
programme.desc: Buddy Hackett has knowledge on many subjects, including snakes. Dr. Morris Goldberg talks chauffeuring and Johnny addresses George Brett's hemorrhoids.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Joan Rivers (5/14/81)
programme.desc: The birds and the bees are a topic of conversation for Joan Rivers and Johnny notes the high price of meat these days in this episode which also features William Caulfield and Amos Caulfield.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Buddy Hackett (12/8/81)
programme.desc: Even Buddy Hackett bombs sometimes--just not for Johnny Carson. Rocky Graziano stops by and Johnny wonders if $2,000-worth of ornaments on a Christmas tree is too much.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Jack Lemmon (3/18/82)
programme.desc: Jack Lemmon can't sit through his own movies and Maureen Murphy thinks writing jokes is as hard as having a baby. Johnny has something to say about his windshield wipers.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Joan Rivers (10/15/82)
programme.desc: Hear what Joan Rivers has to say about retouched magazine covers, Gone With The Wind and Dolly Parton. Plus, Johnny welcomes Japanese TV personality Tetsuko Kuroyanagi.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Bob Newhart (5/18/83)
programme.desc: What was Bob Newhart's worst stand-up routine? He tells all in this episode which also features Anthony Quinn and Julie Lynn Hayek.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Bob Newhart (10/7/83)
programme.desc: Did you know Bob Newhart started his career as an accountant? We're glad he switched to comedy and visited Johnny for this episode, which also features James Stephens and Ronnie Porter.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Mel Brooks (12/15/83)
programme.desc: Finally, the world has proof that Johnny's desk backdrop isn't real when Mel Brooks reveals all in this episode. Also: Teri Garr insists that money is not important to her.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Bob Newhart (10/9/84)
programme.desc: Bob Newhart got a Peabody, Emmy and pink slip from NBC in the same year. Johnny talks with him about it, plus Erin Gray visits the couch.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Don Rickles (11/21/84)
programme.desc: When Don Rickles has Thanksgiving with Bob Newhart, you want to hear him talk about it. You'll also want to hear Angie Dickinson talk about Police Woman and Johnny talk about Mr. Rogers' sweater.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Buddy Hackett (5/7/86)
programme.desc: This episode is a real balancing act when expert balancer Ed Kennedy graces the stage along with comic legend Buddy Hackett and Breakfast Club star Ally Sheedy.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Bob Newhart (9/17/86)
programme.desc: TV comedy icon Bob Newhart stops by, along with Saundra Santiago and Teresa Ganzel.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Jack Lemmon (11/1/89)
programme.desc: The laughs can't stop/won't stop when comedy heavyweights Jack Lemmon and Steven Wright stop by the set.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Don Rickles (2/7/90)
programme.desc: What do you get when you combine comedian Don Rickles, 95-year-old artist Jon Serl and a Johnny Carson monologue that mentions Pee-wee Herman and Russian Big Macs? Watch this episode to find out!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Carl Reiner (10/18/74)
programme.desc: Nine-time Emmy winner Carl Reiner loves talking about the World Series and his days in the Army! Comedian David Brenner covers LA earthquakes.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Carl Reiner (2/24/81)
programme.desc: Carl Reiner insists that Johnny is a great role model for dating couples. Reflects on shaving his head for a movie, and trades quips on aging with French beauty Catherine Deneuve.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Carl Reiner (1/4/83)
programme.desc: Carl Reiner improvises an Italian aria and riffs on ridiculous celebrity stories from the tabloids. Olympic diver Greg Louganis shows off his moves on a trampoline.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Carl Reiner (8/5/85)
programme.desc: Comedy master Carl Reiner ate his way through France and now complains to Johnny about his weight gain. Shows a clip from his movie, Summer Rentals.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Carl Reiner (11/12/87)
programme.desc: TV's ultimate GOAT Carl Reiner performs a dance number then chats about writing screenplays and (wait for it) the Supreme Court.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Carl Reiner (10/5/89)
programme.desc: TV's polymath Carl Reiner chats about his wife Estelle, a recent nose injury, his frequent forgetfulness, and the smash hit flick When Harry Met Sally written and directed by his son, Rob Reiner.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Carl Reiner (10/10/91)
programme.desc: Comic genius Carl Reiner makes his 46th visit to Johnny's couch. Discusses his attempts at dieting and presents Johnny with a bunch of gifts: slippers, pipe, glasses and....a gun.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '70s - Steve Martin (2/15/73)
programme.desc: Wild and crazy guy Steve Martin does card tricks, George Foreman talks winning the heavyweight championship and Johnny details his valentine from Don Rickles. Sandy Duncan and Binnie Barnes also appear.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '70s - Rodney Dangerfield (7/3/74)
programme.desc: Johnny gives questionable amounts of respect to Rodney Dangerfield, then reasonable amounts of respect to Dom Deluise, Orson Bean and Mariette Hartley.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '70s - George Carlin (2/15/77)
programme.desc: George Carlin sticks only to words you CAN say on TV. Plus, Rita Reutter is an older sex symbol, McLean Stevenson had a date with the Rose Bowl Queen and Martina Navratilova is the best tennis player in the world.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '70s - Carol Burnett (8/10/79)
programme.desc: Carol Burnett reveals her Hollywood idols, Tim Conway details losing his car at a party and Johnny discusses The Joy Of Sex. Plus, Robert Easton and Tracee Talavera appear.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '70s - George Carlin (11/29/84)
programme.desc: George Carlin likes to harmonize on the phone with the dial tone. In case you needed more reasons to watch this episode, Keshia Knight Pulliam also appears.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '70s - Michael Palin (4/18/85)
programme.desc: Michael Palin sleeps all night and works all day, but still finds time to stop by the couch. Mariette Hartley talks practical jokes and Johnny takes on Leave It To Beaver.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '70s - George Carlin (8/21/85)
programme.desc: A stand-up routine by comic giant George Carlin highlights this episode which also features record-setting test pilot Chuck Yeager.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '70s - Carol Burnett (12/7/72)
programme.desc: The queen of comedy, Carol Burnett dishes on Hollywood High, reminisces about her family, and her early days on The Garry Moore Show. Bob Hope chats about politics.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '70s - Tim Conway (1/3/86)
programme.desc: Comedy genius and Carol Burnett co-star Tim Conway discusses his movie, "Long Shot," marriage, and horseracing. Hal Linden joins in.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '70s - Tim Conway (3/17/87)
programme.desc: Tim Conway and Harry Anderson stop by to chat with Johnny.

programme.title: Behold
programme.desc: Grace and the Greenleaf family must lay the past to rest once and for all as God's plans for the future unfold.

programme.title: A Time to Heal
programme.desc: The news of Grace Greenleaf's return to Memphis breeds tension.

programme.title: The Baptism
programme.desc: Grace's moving back to Memphis is motivated by vengeance for her sister's death; she struggles to work in the family's church.

programme.title: We Shall See Him As He Is
programme.desc: Jacob and Kerissa realize what their marriage has become; Grace goes on an uncomfortable date; Senator Banks looks into the church's finances.

programme.title: Behind Closed Doors
programme.desc: When the mayor cashes in a favor, the Bishop is left in a tough spot that could split the church; Grace is blackmailed; Charity can't keep a secret.

programme.title: Uncle Drew
programme.desc: After draining his life savings to enter a team in the Rucker Classic street ball tournament in Harlem, Dax is dealt a series of setbacks, including losing his team to his longtime rival. Desperate to win the tournament and the cash prize, Dax stumbles upon the man, the myth, the legend Uncle Drew and convinces him to return to the court one more time. The two men embark on a road trip to round up Drew's old basketball squad and prove that a group of septuagenarians can still win the big one.

programme.title: I Can Do Bad All by Myself
programme.desc: Madea catches teenage Jennifer and her two younger brothers looting her home. She decides to take matters into her own hands and delivers the young delinquents to the only relative they have, their aunt April, who wants nothing to do with the kids.

programme.title: Diary of a Mad Black Woman
programme.desc: A woman must put her life back together after her husband of 18 years abruptly kicks her out of the house.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's A Madea Family Funeral
programme.desc: A joyous reunion in small-town Georgia turns into an unexpected nightmare when Madea, Joe, Aunt Bam and other family members gather for an anniversary party that turns out to be a sham. Instead of fun and relaxation, Madea and the gang soon find themselves attending an elaborate funeral that doesn't quite go according to plan.

programme.title: Madea's Big Happy Family
programme.desc: When Shirley (Loretta Devine), Madea's niece, receives distressing news about her health, the only thing she wants is her family gathered around her. However, Shirley's three adult children (Shad "Bow Wow" Moss, Shannon Kane, Natalie Desselle-Reid) are too preoccupied with their own troubled lives to pay attention to their mother. It is up to Madea (Tyler Perry), with the help of rowdy Aunt Bam (Cassi Davis), to bring the clan together and help Shirley deal with her crisis.

Desperate to win the tournament and the cash prize, Dax stumbles upon the man, the myth, the legend Uncle Drew and convinces him to return to the court one more time. The two men embark on a road trip to round up Drew's old basketball squad and prove that a group of septuagenarians can still win the big one.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Daddy's Little Girls
programme.desc: Monty (Idris Elba), a mechanic, struggles to make ends meet and raise his three young daughters alone. When his drug-dealing ex-wife wins custody of the girls in court, he enlists the help of Julia (Gabrielle Union), a successful attorney, to get the girls back. Romance unexpectedly blooms between the pair, but the couple must come to terms with their very different lives and find a way to keep Monty's family together.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Good Deeds
programme.desc: For all his life, wealthy businessman Wesley Deeds (Tyler Perry) has done what's expected of him and has settled into a predictable routine. His life begins to change, however, when he meets Lindsey Wakefield (Thandie Newton), a struggling single mother who has just been evicted. Wesley offers to help Lindsey get back on her feet and, though he's already engaged, romantic sparks begin to fly. Suddenly, Wesley finds himself torn between what is expected of him and what he really wants.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's the Family That Preys

Then secrets, greed and scandal surrounding both their families throw the women's lives into turmoil. Charlotte and Alice set out on a road trip across the country, hoping to gain perspective and save the situation from ruin.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Meet the Browns
programme.desc: Single mother Brenda (Angela Bassett) suddenly loses her job, then she receives news that the father she never met is dead. With nothing to lose, she gathers her brood and heads to Georgia, where she meets her father's uproarious family for the first time and finds the tentative beginnings of a new romance.

programme.title: The Single Moms Club
programme.desc: When their children face expulsion because of rule infractions, five single mothers must agree to organize the school's upcoming dance and fundraiser. Although they range from alpha professional to fast-food worker, the women find they have one thing in common: a need for support and an understanding ear. They form the Single Moms Club to help ease one another's burdens and reclaim their freedom. As their stress begins to lessen, the women find that finding love may be possible again.

Friends since childhood, the devoted couple dream of a future together, but their plans are derailed when Fonny is arrested for a crime he did not commit.

programme.title: Uncovering Near Eastern Civilization
programme.desc: Egypt, Greece and Rome may be better known to the public; more written evidence survives from Mesopotamia; embarking on a journey through over 3,000 years of history; learning why Mesopotamia's rediscovery is so valuable.

programme.title: Natufian Villagers and Early Settlements
programme.desc: The enormous value of plant and animal domestication; the theories about the transition from a hunter-gatherer lifestyle to agriculture; the challenges that farming presents; a perspective on the cultural sophistication of pre-agrarian peoples.

programme.title: The Land of Canaan
programme.desc: What is meant by "holy land"; the difference between archeology and history; how reliable the Hebrew Bible is as a window into life in ancient Israel; answers to these and other questions; the region's earliest recorded inhabitants, the Canaanites.

programme.title: The Arrival of the Israelites
programme.desc: What archeologists uncover about the arrival of the Israelites into Canaan; an ancient Egyptian stele with the earliest reference to Israel; the remains of Jericho's walls; a Philistine temple similar to the one Samson destroys in the book of Judges.

programme.title: The New Testament-An Overview

programme.title: Paul-Our Earliest Christian Author
programme.desc: The Epistles of Paul are the earliest books of the New Testament, predating even the Gospels; the realities of writing a letter in the ancient world; issues that affect how one understands Paul's Epistles and the other writings of the New Testament.

programme.title: Biblical Israel - The Story of a People
programme.desc: Entering the world of biblical Israel with a historical overview; an examination of how the Bible gives insights into the daily life of ancient Israelites; considering the context for how the Bible comes into being.

programme.title: By the Rivers of Babylon - Exile
programme.desc: A look at the Babylonian exile; the exiled Judeans begin asking themselves who they are as a people and why they are conquered; as the Bible begins to be compiled in this time of exile, it offers two vantage points for understanding its history.

programme.title: The New Testament-An Overview

programme.title: Paul-Our Earliest Christian Author
programme.desc: The Epistles of Paul are the earliest books of the New Testament, predating even the Gospels; the realities of writing a letter in the ancient world; issues that affect how one understands Paul's Epistles and the other writings of the New Testament.

programme.title: The Pauline Epistles
programme.desc: This lecture looks at some of the major teachings of Paul's Epistles; showing how he shapes his theological and ethical views in light of the problems that emerge in his burgeoning Christian communities.

programme.title: The Problem of Pseudonymity
programme.desc: This lecture considers the broad problem of pseudonymity, or forgery, in the ancient world; applying one's findings to the Pauline letters of the New Testament to see if any, in fact, are written by Paul's followers rather than Paul himself.

programme.title: Creation Stories and Why They Matter
programme.desc: The nature of creation stories.

programme.title: Reading Metaphor in Creation Stories
programme.desc: Metaphor and symbol are integral to creation stories, as they form a crucial part of the language of myth.

programme.title: Mesopotamian Creation: Enuma elish
programme.desc: Enuma Elish, also called the Seven Tablets of Creation, is a masterpiece of Mesopotamian literature.

programme.title: The Mesopotamian Flood: The Atrahasis Epic
programme.desc: Examining key Mesopotamian texts referencing a catastrophic flood which decimates humanity.

programme.title: Egyptian Gods of Creation
programme.desc: Take account of funerary texts that contain allusions to the ancient Egyptian conceptions of creation.

programme.title: Egyptian Approaches to Creation
programme.desc: Within ancient Egyptian culture, explore the means by which the gods created the world and humanity.

programme.title: The Storm God's Supremacy in the Baal Cycle
programme.desc: This ancient Syrian text, though it lacks an overt description of creation, resonates with key themes of other creation stories of the ancient Near East.

programme.title: Hittite Creation in the Kumarbi Cycle
programme.desc: Here, encounter the Hurrians and Hittites, two lesser known but important peoples of the ancient Near East.

programme.title: A Meditation on Empire
programme.desc: What makes a true "empire"; how empires rise and flourish; how they decline and fall; discovering pointed answers to these and other fundamental questions about the study of empires.

programme.title: Lands, Seas, and Sources
programme.desc: The geography of the ancient Near East plays a decisive role in the region's fascinating empires; looking at the kinds of archeological and documentary evidence like discoveries from excavations of ancient sites help in understanding the period.

programme.title: Sargon and the Dawn of Empire
programme.desc: Charting the rise and the eventual fall of the Akkadian Empire, established by Sargon and strengthened by his grandson, Naram-Sin; learning how they forged the administrative pattern that future Mesopotamian empires follow, pivoting the king.

programme.title: The Third Dynasty of Ur
programme.desc: Professor Dise discusses the brief rise and the eventual disintegration of the imperial dynasty of Ur III in Sumer in the late 22nd century B.C., analyzing how the dynasty's ruler Ur-Nammu introduced tyrannical taxes and economic systems.

programme.title: The Empire of Hammurabi
programme.desc: King Hammurabi fills in the power vacuum left in Mesopotamia after Ur III; establishing the First Dynasty of Babylon, he administers rule through a detailed code of law; the First Dynasty swiftly collapses after Hammurabi's death.

programme.title: Mitanni and the Kassites
programme.desc: Investigating the histories of two Mesopotamian empires that emerged after the First Dynasty of Babylon; the Mitanni of the north follows a decentralized state, like a feudal society; the Kassites in the south bring about socio-economic changes.

programme.title: The Rise of Hatti
programme.desc: The first Near Eastern empire expanding beyond the river valleys of the Nile and Mesopotamia is Hatti, the Hittite kingdom. It originated in the early second millennium B.C. Anatolia, facing crises that threatened its stability.

programme.title: The Government of Hatti
programme.desc: Focusing on the elements of the Hittite government and paying particular attention to the central role played by the Great King in judicial matters, Hatti's intricate imperial system blends hierarchy, bureaucracy and feudalism.

programme.desc: What makes a true "empire"; how empires rise and flourish; how they decline and fall; discovering pointed answers to these and other fundamental questions about the study of empires.

programme.title: Lands, Seas, and Sources
programme.desc: The geography of the ancient Near East plays a decisive role in the region's fascinating empires; looking at the kinds of archeological and documentary evidence like discoveries from excavations of ancient sites help in understanding the period.

programme.title: Sargon and the Dawn of Empire
programme.desc: Charting the rise and the eventual fall of the Akkadian Empire, established by Sargon and strengthened by his grandson, Naram-Sin; learning how they forged the administrative pattern that future Mesopotamian empires follow, pivoting the king.

programme.title: The Third Dynasty of Ur
programme.desc: Professor Dise discusses the brief rise and the eventual disintegration of the imperial dynasty of Ur III in Sumer in the late 22nd century B.C., analyzing how the dynasty's ruler Ur-Nammu introduced tyrannical taxes and economic systems.

programme.title: The Empire of Hammurabi
programme.desc: King Hammurabi fills in the power vacuum left in Mesopotamia after Ur III; establishing the First Dynasty of Babylon, he administers rule through a detailed code of law; the First Dynasty swiftly collapses after Hammurabi's death.

programme.title: Mitanni and the Kassites
programme.desc: Investigating the histories of two Mesopotamian empires that emerged after the First Dynasty of Babylon; the Mitanni of the north follows a decentralized state, like a feudal society; the Kassites in the south bring about socio-economic changes.

programme.title: The Rise of Hatti
programme.desc: The first Near Eastern empire expanding beyond the river valleys of the Nile and Mesopotamia is Hatti, the Hittite kingdom. It originated in the early second millennium B.C. Anatolia, facing crises that threatened its stability.

programme.title: The Government of Hatti
programme.desc: Focusing on the elements of the Hittite government and paying particular attention to the central role played by the Great King in judicial matters, Hatti's intricate imperial system blends hierarchy, bureaucracy and feudalism.

programme.title: Creation Stories and Why They Matter
programme.desc: The nature of creation stories.

programme.title: Reading Metaphor in Creation Stories
programme.desc: Metaphor and symbol are integral to creation stories, as they form a crucial part of the language of myth.

programme.title: Mesopotamian Creation: Enuma elish

programme.title: The Mesopotamian Flood: The Atrahasis Epic
programme.desc: Examining key Mesopotamian texts referencing a catastrophic flood which decimates humanity.

programme.title: Egyptian Gods of Creation
programme.desc: Take account of funerary texts that contain allusions to the ancient Egyptian conceptions of creation.

programme.title: Egyptian Approaches to Creation
programme.desc: Within ancient Egyptian culture, explore the means by which the gods created the world and humanity.

programme.title: The Storm God's Supremacy in the Baal Cycle
programme.desc: This ancient Syrian text, though it lacks an overt description of creation, resonates with key themes of other creation stories of the ancient Near East.

programme.desc: The dynamic civilizations that emerge in the Aegean; the scope of the human drama that is played out there; some of the towering figures and remarkable sites to encounter; Professor Hale's recommendations for traveling this world as the ancients did.

programme.title: Athens - Around the Acropolis and Parthenon
programme.desc: The Acropolis is a symbol of Athens; the path of the ancient annual procession honoring Athena; the history and meanings of the site's iconic buildings; the superlative architectural features of the Parthenon and its surprising original uses.

programme.title: Around Attica - Temples and Mysteries
programme.desc: Visiting sacred monuments of Greece's beautiful Attica region; the Amphiareion is a shrine of a prophet deity; ancient oracle and healing practices; imposing shrines to Artemis and Poseidon; Eleusis is the site of mystical religious rituals.

Though the two get off on the wrong foot, they become unlikely friends, with Simon teaching Monty some important life lessons. Although Monty's roommates, including his buddy, Everett Calloway (Patrick Dempsey), initially dislike having Simon around, they grow to appreciate him, too.

The problem is that he can't remember whether he committed the murders or not. For one brief moment, he is convinced that he has gone completely mad. Murdoch seeks to unravel the twisted riddle of his identity. As he edges closer to solving the mystery, he stumbles upon a fiendish underworld controlled by a group of ominous beings collectively known as the Strangers.

programme.desc: Impressed by high school student David's (Tobey Maguire) devotion to a 1950s family TV show, a mysterious television repairman (Don Knotts) provides him with a means to escape into the black-and-white program with his sister, Jennifer (Reese Witherspoon). While David initially takes to the simplistic, corny world of the show, Jennifer sets about jolting the characters with doses of reality that unexpectedly bring a little color into their drab existence.

programme.title: Beyond the Poseidon Adventure

programme.desc: With only a recreation center to distract them, most of the teenagers in the drab planned community of New Granada have turned to drugs and delinquency. Carl (Michael Kramer), the son of a town councilman, is an exception, but he can't seem to help falling in with a charismatic and troubled classmate, Richie (Matt Dillon). Soon after, a trigger-happy sheriff (Harry Northrup) shoots Richie, and sole witness Carl has to go on the run, eventually inciting a dramatic teenage riot.

Traveling from Hong Kong to Ukraine to Australia, Chan aims to bust up the terrorist plot using his fists as much as his brains, doing battle underwater, on stilts and across mountain tops.

programme.desc: Cameron McCormick helps golfers make more putts. Most recreational golfers are missing putts because they do not focus on the putting triad - line, speed, and read.

programme.title: PhD Putting
programme.desc: Improving putting by using specific drills and games that allow you to self-detect tendencies in your game and then identify skill improvement opportunities to help you make more putts.

programme.title: Masters Edition Volume 2

programme.title: Chapter 6: Slice and Hook Cures
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal show which setup, swing, and equipment adjustments translate into stopping slices and hooks. Martin shares some of his favorite drills on finding the proper grip, maintaining balance, and swinging on the proper plane.

programme.title: Chapter 7: Dial In Your Wedges
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the best wedge tips for around the green. Learn how to set up for success, use tees to improve contact, and how to control distance like Dustin Johnson with the use of a clock.

programme.title: Chapter 8: Lessons From The Masters
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the shots needed for success in The Masters; Martin shares a driving tip he learned playing golf with Dustin Johnson and a distance drill used by Jack Nicklaus; a top college player gives a guest lesson.

programme.title: Chapter 9: Putting Class
programme.desc: Martin Hall explains how to become a better putter ASAP; those four letters standing for aim, stability, arc, and pace. Martin shares drills for each letter from putting gurus including Dave Stockton, Phil Kenyon, and the late Frank Thomas.

programme.title: Chapter 10: The Golden Bear
programme.desc: 18-time Major Champion Jack Nicklaus speaks with Martin Hall about being coached at an early age by Jack Grout, his number one swing fundamental, and how to maximize distance with the driver. Favorite drills inspired by The Golden Bear.

programme.title: Chapter 11: Tempo and Rhythm
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal demonstrate how to improve on tempo and rhythm. Martin discusses the difference between the two and shares tips used by Hall of Famers such as Tom Watson, Ernie Els, Vijay Singh, and Nick Faldo.

programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the shots needed for success in the U.S. Open. Jack Nicklaus joins for an exclusive interview and shares the ball striking skill that helped him become a 4-time U.S. Open champion.
